CL:0000999.description: CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-positive dendritic cell is a conventional dendritic cell that is CD11b-positive, CD4-positive and is CD205-negative and CD8-alpha-negative.

CL:0000998.label: CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell
CL:0000998.description: CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a conventional dendritic cell that is CD11b-negative, CD4-negative CD8-alpha-negative and is CD205-positive. This cell is able to cross- present antigen to CD8-alpha-positive T cells.

CL:0002010.label: pre-conventional dendritic cell
CL:0002010.description: A lin-negative, MHC-II-negative, CD11c-positive, FLT3-positive cell with intermediate expression of SIRP-alpha.

CL:0002465.label: CD11b-positive dendritic cell
CL:0002465.description: A conventional dendritic cell that expresses CD11b (ITGAM).

CL:0001000.label: CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell
CL:0001000.description: CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a conventional dendritic cell that is CD11b-negative, CD4-negative and is CD205-positive and CD8-alpha-positive.

CL:0001001.label: immature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell
CL:0001001.description: Immature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0001002.label: mature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell
CL:0001002.description: Mature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0001003.label: mature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-positive dendritic cell
CL:0001003.description: Mature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-positive dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-positive dendritic cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0001004.label: immature CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell
CL:0001004.description: Immature CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0001005.label: mature CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell
CL:0001005.description: Mature CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0001006.label: dermal dendritic cell
CL:0001006.description: Dermal dendritic cell is a conventional dendritic cell that is CD11b-positive, CD205-positive and CD8 alpha-negative.

CL:0001007.label: interstitial dendritic cell
CL:0001007.description: Interstitial dendritic cell is a conventional dendritic cell that is CD11b-positive, CD1a-positive, CD206-positive, CD209-positive, and CD36-positive.

CL:0001008.label: Kit and Sca1-positive hematopoietic stem cell
CL:0001008.description: A hematopoietic stem cell that has plasma membrane part Kit-positive, SCA-1-positive, CD150-positive and CD34-negative.

CL:0001024.label: CD34-positive, CD38-negative hematopoietic stem cell
CL:0001024.description: CD133-positive hematopoietic stem cell is a hematopoietic stem cell that is CD34-positive, CD90-positive, and CD133-positive.

CL:0001009.label: immature dermal dendritic cell
CL:0001009.description: Immature dermal dendritic cell is a dermal dendritic cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0001010.label: mature dermal dendritic cell
CL:0001010.description: Mature dermal dendritic cell is a dermal dendritic cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0001011.label: immature interstitial dendritic cell
CL:0001011.description: Immature interstitial dendritic cell is a interstitial dendritic cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0001027.label: CD7-negative lymphoid progenitor cell
CL:0001027.description: CD7-negative lymphoid progenitor cell is a lymphoid progenitor cell that is CD34-positive, CD7-negative and CD45RA-negative.

CL:0001013.label: mature interstitial dendritic cell
CL:0001013.description: Mature interstitial dendritic cell is a interstitial dendritic cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0001014.label: CD1a-positive Langerhans cell
CL:0001014.description: CD1a-positive Langerhans cell is a Langerhans_cell that is CD1a-positive and CD324-positive.

CL:0001015.label: CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell
CL:0001015.description: CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell is a Langerhans cell that is CD205-high and is CD8-alpha-low.

CL:0001016.label: immature CD1a-positive Langerhans cell
CL:0001016.description: Immature CD1a-positive Langerhans cell is a CD1a-positive Langerhans cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0001017.label: mature CD1a-positive Langerhans cell
CL:0001017.description: Mature CD1a-positive Langerhans cell is a CD1a-positive Langerhans cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0001018.label: immature CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell
CL:0001018.description: Immature CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell is a CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0001019.label: CD115-positive monocyte OR common dendritic progenitor

CL:0001022.label: CD115-positive monocyte
CL:0001022.description: CD115-positive monocyte is a monocyte that is CD115-positive and CD11b-positive.

CL:0001020.label: mature CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell
CL:0001020.description: Mature CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell is a CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell that that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0002043.label: CD34-positive, CD38-negative multipotent progenitor cell
CL:0002043.description: A hematopoietic multipotent progenitor cell that is CD34-positive, CD38-negative, CD45RA-negative, and CD90-negative.

CL:0001025.label: Kit-positive, Sca1-positive common lymphoid progenitor
CL:0001025.description: A common lymphoid progenitor that is Kit-low, FLT3-positive, IL7ralpha-positive, and SCA1-low.

CL:0002001.label: CD34-positive, CD38-positive granulocyte monocyte progenitor
CL:0002001.description: A granulocyte monocyte progenitor is CD34-positive, CD38-positive, IL-3receptor-alpha-positive and is CD45RA-negative.

CL:0001023.label: Kit-positive, CD34-positive common myeloid progenitor
CL:0001023.description: A common myeloid progenitor that is Kit-positive and CD34-positive, Il7ra-negative, and is SCA1-low and Fcgr2-low and Fcgr3-low.

CL:0001059.label: common myeloid progenitor, CD34-positive
CL:0001059.description: A progenitor cell committed to myeloid lineage, including the megakaryocyte and erythroid lineages. These cells are CD34-positive, and express Gata1, Gata2, C/EBPa, and Pu.1.

CL:0001030.label: CD117-positive common myeloid progenitor OR CD217-positive common lymphoid progenitor

CL:0001028.label: CD7-positive lymphoid progenitor cell
CL:0001028.description: CD7-positive lymphoid progenitor cell is a lymphoid progenitor cell that is CD34-positive, CD7-positive and is CD45RA-negative.

CL:0001031.label: cerebellar granule cell
CL:0001031.description: An excitatory granule cell with a soma located in the granular layer of cerebellar cortex. A mature cerebellar granule cell has short dendrites with a characteristic claw-like appearance and a long axon that ascends to the molecular layer where it bifurcates (except in non-teleost fish, where it does not bifurcate) and extends mediolaterally to form parallel fibers.

CL:2000028.label: cerebellum glutamatergic neuron
CL:2000028.description: Any glutamatergic neuron that is part of a cerebellum.

CL:0002362.label: cerebellar granule cell precursor
CL:0002362.description: A cell located in the outermost proliferative zone of the external germinal layer that can differentiate into astroglial cells and granule cells. This cell type is glial fibrillary acidic protein-positive and HNK1-positive.

CL:0001032.label: cortical granule cell
CL:0001032.description: Granule cell that is part of the cerebral cortex.

CL:0010012.label: cerebral cortex neuron
CL:0010012.description: A CNS neuron of the cerebral cortex.

CL:0001033.label: hippocampal granule cell
CL:0001033.description: Granule cell with a soma found in the hippocampus.

CL:0002608.label: hippocampal neuron
CL:0002608.description: A neuron with a soma found in the hippocampus.

CL:0001039.label: terminally differentiated osteoblast
CL:0001039.description: Osteoblast that is terminally differentiated, located adjacent to acellular or cellular bone tissue within periosteum, and is capable of mineralizing the matrix.

CL:0001041.label: CD8-positive, CXCR3-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell
CL:0001041.description: A CD8-positive alpha-beta-positive T cell with the phenotype CXCR3-positive and having suppressor function. They are capable of producing IL-10, suppressing proliferation, and suppressing IFN-gamma production.
synonyms: CD8-positive, CXCR3-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T lymphocyte

CL:0001042.label: T-helper 22 cell
CL:0001042.description: CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell that produces IL-22.

CL:0001043.label: activated CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell, human
CL:0001043.description: A recently activated CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype HLA-DRA-positive, CD38-positive, CD69-positive, CD62L-negative, CD127-negative, and CD25-positive.
synonyms: activated CD4-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte, human

CL:0001044.label: effector CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:0001044.description: A CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CCR7-negative, CD45RA-positive.

CL:0001045.label: naive CCR4-positive regulatory T cell
CL:0001045.description: A naive regulatory T cell with the phenotype CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CD127lo, CCR4-positive, and CD45RO-negative.

CL:0002677.label: naive regulatory T cell
CL:0002677.description: A regulatory T cell that has not encountered antigen.

CL:0001047.label: CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell
CL:0001047.description: A CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell with the additional phenotype CCR4-positive.
synonyms: CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T lymphocyte
CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T-cell
CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T-lymphocyte

CL:0001046.label: memory CCR4-positive regulatory T cell
CL:0001046.description: A memory regulatory T cell with phenotype CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CD127lo, CCR4-positive, and CD45RO-positive.

CL:0002678.label: memory regulatory T cell
CL:0002678.description: A CD4-positive, CD25-positive alpha-beta regulatory T cell that has encountered antigen.

CL:0001048.label: activated CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell, human
CL:0001048.description: A CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta T regulatory cell with the phenotype HLA-DRA-positive, indicating recent activation.
synonyms: activated CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T lymphocyte
activated CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T-cell
activated CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T-lymphocyte

CL:0001049.label: activated CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell, human
CL:0001049.description: A recently activated CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype HLA-DRA-positive, CD38-positive, CD69-positive, CD62L-negative, CD127-negative, CCR7-negative, and CD25-positive.
synonyms: activated CD8-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte, human

CL:0001050.label: effector CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:0001050.description: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CCR7-negative, CD45RA-positive.

CL:0001054.label: CD14-positive monocyte
CL:0001054.description: A monocyte that expresses CD14 and is negative for the lineage markers CD3, CD19, and CD20.

CL:0001055.label: CD14-positive, CD16-low monocyte
CL:0001055.description: An intermediate monocyte that is CD14-positive and with low amounts of CD16.

CL:0002397.label: CD14-positive, CD16-positive monocyte
CL:0002397.description: A CD14-positive monocyte that is also CD16-positive and CCR2-negative.

CL:0001056.label: dendritic cell, human
CL:0001056.description: A dendritic cell with the phenotype HLA-DRA-positive.

CL:0001057.label: myeloid dendritic cell, human
CL:0001057.description: A myeloid dendritic cell with the phenotype HLA-DRA-positive.

CL:0001058.label: plasmacytoid dendritic cell, human
CL:0001058.description: A plasmacytoid dendritic cell with the phenotype HLA-DRA-positive, CD123-positive, and CD11c-negative.

CL:0001061.label: abnormal cell
CL:0001061.description: A cell found in an organism or derived from an organism exhibiting a phenotype that deviates from the expected phenotype of any native cell type of that organism. Abnormal cells are typically found in disease states or disease models.

CL:0001062.label: effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell, terminally differentiated
CL:0001062.description: A CD8-positive, alpha beta memory T cell with the phenotype CD45RA-positive, CD45RO-negative, and CCR7-negative.

CL:4030002.label: effector memory CD45RA-positive, alpha-beta T cell, terminally differentiated
CL:4030002.description: An alpha-beta memory T cell with the phenotype CD45RA-positive.
synonyms: terminally differentiated effector memory CD45RA+ T cells
terminally differentiated effector memory cells re-expressing CD45RA

CL:0001063.label: neoplastic cell
CL:0001063.description: An abnormal cell exhibiting dysregulation of cell proliferation or programmed cell death and capable of forming a neoplasm, an aggregate of cells in the form of a tumor mass or an excess number of abnormal cells (liquid tumor) within an organism.

CL:0001064.label: malignant cell
CL:0001064.description: A neoplastic cell that is capable of entering a surrounding tissue

CL:0001065.label: innate lymphoid cell
CL:0001065.description: A lymphocyte that lacks characteristic T cell, B cell, myeloid cell, and dendritic cell markers, that functions as part of the innate immune response to produce cytokines and other effector responses.

CL:0001066.label: erythroid progenitor cell, mammalian
CL:0001066.description: A progenitor cell committed to the erythroid lineage. This cell is ter119-positive but lacks expression of other hematopoietic lineage markers (lin-negative).

CL:0001068.label: ILC1
CL:0001068.description: A group 1 innate lymphoid cell that is non-cytotoxic.

CL:0001069.label: group 2 innate lymphoid cell
CL:0001069.description: An innate lymphoid cell that is capable of producing T-helper 2-cell associated cytokines upon stimulation.

CL:0001070.label: beige adipocyte
CL:0001070.description: An adipocyte that is beige in color, thermogenic, and which differentiates in white fat tissue from a Myf5-negative progenitor.

CL:0001071.label: group 3 innate lymphoid cell
CL:0001071.description: An innate lymphoid cell that constituitively expresses RORgt and is capable of expressing IL17A and/or IL-22.

CL:0001072.label: CD34-negative, CD117-positive innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001072.description: An innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype CD34-negative, CD117-positive, and a precusor to NK cells, ILC2 cells, and ILC3 cells.
synonyms: CD34-negative, CD117-positive innate lymphoid cell precusor

CL:0001074.label: CD34-positive, CD56-positive, CD117-positive common innate lymphoid precursor, human
CL:0001074.description: An innate lymphoid cell precursor in the human with the phenotype CD34-positive, CD56-positive, CD117-positive.Thie cell type may include precusors to NK cells and ILC3 cells.

CL:0001073.label: CD34-negative, CD56-positive, CD117-positive innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001073.description: An innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype CD34-negative, CD56-positive, CD117-positive.Thie cell type may include precusors to NK cells and ILC3 cells.
synonyms: CD34-negative, CD56-positive, CD117-positive innate lymphoid cell precursor

CL:0001075.label: KLRG1-positive innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001075.description: An innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype KLRG1-positive that is a precusor for ILC2 cells.

CL:0001076.label: NKp46-positive innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001076.description: An innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype NKp46-positive that is a precusor for NK cells and ILC3 cells.

CL:0001077.label: ILC1, human
CL:0001077.description: An ILC1 cell in the human with the phenotype CD56-negative, IL-7Ralpha-positive, T-bet-positive.

CL:0001078.label: group 3 innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001078.description: A group 3 innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype IL-7Ralpha-positive.

CL:0001079.label: NKp44-positive group 3 innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001079.description: A group 3 innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype IL-7Ralpha-positive, and NKp44-positive.

CL:0001080.label: NKp44-negative group 3 innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001080.description: A group 3 innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype IL-7Ralpha-positive, and NKp44-negative.

CL:0001081.label: group 2 innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001081.description: A group 2 innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype CD25-positive, CD127-positive, CD161-positive, and GATA-3-positive.

CL:0001087.label: effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell, terminally differentiated
CL:0001087.description: A CD4-positive, alpha beta memory T cell with the phenotype CD45RA-positive, CD45RO-negative, and CCR7-negative.

CL:0001200.label: lymphocyte of B lineage, CD19-positive
CL:0001200.description: A lymphocyte of B lineage that is CD19-positive.

CL:0001658.label: visual pigment cell (sensu Nematoda and Protostomia)

CL:0002000.label: Kit-positive erythroid progenitor cell
CL:0002000.description: An erythroid progenitor cell is Kit-positive, Ly6A-negative, CD41-negative, CD127-negative, and CD123-negative. This cell type is also described as being lin-negative, Kit-positive, CD150-negative, CD41-negative, CD105-positive, and FcgR-negative.

CL:0002006.label: Kit-positive, CD34-negative megakaryocyte erythroid progenitor cell
CL:0002006.description: A megakaryocyte erythroid progenitor cell that is Kit-positive and is Sca1-negative, CD34-negative, CD90-negative, IL7r-alpha-negative and Fcgr II/III-low.

CL:0002002.label: Kit-positive granulocyte monocyte progenitor
CL:0002002.description: A granulocyte monocyte progenitor that is Kit-positive, CD34-positive, Fc-gamma receptor II/II-positive, and is Sca-1-negative, Il7ra-negative, Cxc3r1-negative, and CD90-negative.

CL:0002003.label: CD34-positive, GlyA-negative erythroid progenitor cell
CL:0002003.description: An erythroid progenitor cell that is CD34-positive and is GlyA-negative.

CL:0002005.label: CD34-positive, CD38-positive megakaryocyte erythroid progenitor cell
CL:0002005.description: A megakaryocyte erythroid progenitor cell is CD34-positive, CD38-positive and is IL3-receptor alpha-negative and CD45RA-negative.

CL:0002004.label: CD34-negative, GlyA-negative proerythroblast
CL:0002004.description: A proerythoblast that is CD34-negative and GlyA-negative.

CL:0002007.label: Kit-low, CD34-positive eosinophil progenitor cell
CL:0002007.description: A lineage marker-negative, CD34-positive, IL5r-alpha-positive, and Sca1-negative eosinophil progenitor cell.

CL:0002008.label: CD34-positive, CD38-positive eosinophil progenitor cell
CL:0002008.description: A lineage marker-negative, CD34-positive, CD38-positive, IL3r-alpha-positive, IL5r-alpha-positive, and CD45RA-negative eosinophil progenitor cell.

CL:0002011.label: Kit-positive macrophage dendritic cell progenitor
CL:0002011.description: A progenitor cell that can give rise to plasmacytoid and myeloid dendritic cells, and to monocytes and macrophages. Marker for this cell is Kit-high, CD115-positive, CD135-positive, Cx3cr1-positive, and is Il7ra-negative.

CL:0002012.label: Kit-low proerythroblast
CL:0002012.description: A proerythoblast that is Kit-low, Lyg76-positive, and CD71-positive.

CL:0002013.label: GlyA-positive basophilic erythroblast
CL:0002013.description: A basophilic erythroblast that is GlyA-positive.

CL:0002014.label: Kit-negative, Ly-76 high basophilic erythroblast
CL:0002014.description: A basophilic erythroblast that is Lyg 76-high and is Kit-negative.

CL:0002015.label: Kit-negative, Ly-76 high polychromatophilic erythroblast
CL:0002015.description: A polychromatophilic erythroblast that is Lyg 76-high and is Kit-negative.

CL:0002016.label: CD71-low, GlyA-positive polychromatic erythroblast
CL:0002016.description: A polychromatiic erythroblast that is Gly-A-positive and CD71-low.

CL:0002017.label: Kit-negative, Ly-76 high orthochromatophilic erythroblasts
CL:0002017.description: An orthochromatophilic erythroblast that is ter119-high, CD71-low, and Kit-negative.

CL:0002018.label: CD71-negative, GlyA-positive orthochromatic erythroblast
CL:0002018.description: An erythroblast that is GlyA-positive and CD71-negative.

CL:0002019.label: Ly-76 high reticulocyte
CL:0002019.description: A reticulocyte that is Ly76-high and is Kit-negative.

CL:0002021.label: GlyA-positive erythrocyte
CL:0002021.description: An enucleate erythrocyte that is GlyA-positive.

CL:0002022.label: Ly-76 high positive erythrocyte
CL:0002022.description: An enucleate erythrocyte that is Lyg-76-high.

CL:0002023.label: CD34-positive, CD41-positive, CD42-positive megakaryocyte progenitor cell
CL:0002023.description: A megakaroycotye progenitor cell that is CD34-positive, CD41-positive and CD42-positive on the cell surface.

CL:0002025.label: CD34-positive, CD41-positive, CD42-negative megakaryocyte progenitor cell
CL:0002025.description: A megakaryocyte progenitor cell that is CD34-positive, CD41-positive, and CD42-negative.

CL:0002024.label: Kit-positive megakaryocyte progenitor cell
CL:0002024.description: A megakaryocyte progenitor cell that is Kit-positive, CD41-positive, CD9-positive, Sca-1-negative, IL7ralpha-negative, CD150-negative, and Fcgamma receptor II/III-low.

CL:0002026.label: CD34-negative, CD41-positive, CD42-positive megakaryocyte cell
CL:0002026.description: A megakaryocyte progenitor cell that is CD34-negative, CD41-positive and CD42-positive.

CL:0002027.label: CD9-positive, CD41-positive megakaryocyte cell
CL:0002027.description: A megakaryocyte cell with is CD9-positive and CD41-positive.

CL:0002029.label: Fc-epsilon RIalpha-low mast cell progenitor
CL:0002029.description: A lineage-negative, Kit-positive, CD45-positive mast cell progenitor that is Fc-epsilon RIalpha-low.

CL:0002044.label: Kit-positive, integrin beta7-high basophil mast progenitor cell
CL:0002044.description: A basophil mast progenitor cell that is Beta-7 integrin-high, Kit-positive FcRgammaII/III-positive and Sca1-negative.

CL:0002030.label: Fc-epsilon RIalpha-high basophil progenitor cell
CL:0002030.description: A lineage negative, Sca1-negative basophil progenitor cell that is Fc epsilon RIalpha-high.

CL:0002033.label: short term hematopoietic stem cell
CL:0002033.description: A hematopoietic stem cell capable of rapid replenishment of myeloerythroid progenitors and limited self renewal capability. This cell is Kit-positive, Sca1-positive, CD34-positive, CD150-positive, and is Flt3-negative.

CL:0002034.label: long term hematopoietic stem cell
CL:0002034.description: A hematopoietic stem cell with long term self renewal capability. This cell is Kit-positive, Sca1-positive, CD150-positive, CD90-low, CD34-negative and Flt3-negative.

CL:0002036.label: Slamf1-positive multipotent progenitor cell
CL:0002036.description: A hematopoietic progenitor that has some limited self-renewal capability. Cells are lin-negative, Kit-positive, CD34-positive, and Slamf1-positive.

CL:0002037.label: CD2-positive, CD5-positive, CD44-positive alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell
CL:0002037.description: Intraepithelial T cells with a memory phenotype of CD2-positive, CD5-positive, and CD44-positive.

CL:0002038.label: T follicular helper cell
CL:0002038.description: A CD4-positive, CXCR5-positive, CCR7-negative alpha-beta T cell located in follicles of secondary lymph nodes that is BCL6-high, ICOS-high and PD1-high, and stimulates follicular B cells to undergo class-switching and antibody production.

CL:0002039.label: immature NK T cell stage I
CL:0002039.description: A CD24-high, CD4-low, CD8-low, CD44-negative, NK1.1-negative NK T cell.

CL:0002040.label: immature NK T cell stage II
CL:0002040.description: A CD24-low, CD44-negative, NK1.1-negative NK T cell.

CL:0002041.label: immature NK T cell stage III
CL:0002041.description: A CD24-low, CD44-positive, DX5-low, NK1.1-negative NK T cell.

CL:0002045.label: fraction A pre-pro B cell
CL:0002045.description: A pro-B cell that is CD45R/B220-positive, CD43-positive, HSA-low, BP-1-negative and Ly6c-negative. This cell type is also described as being lin-negative, AA4-positive, Kit-positive, IL7Ra-positive and CD45R-positive.

CL:0002046.label: early pro-B cell
CL:0002046.description: A pro-B cell that is CD22-positive, CD34-positive, CD38-positive and TdT-positive (has TdT activity). Pre-BCR is expressed on the cell surface. Cell is CD19-negative, CD20-negative, complement receptor type 2-negative and CD10-low. D-to-J recombination of the heavy chain occurs at this stage.

CL:0002047.label: fraction B precursor B cell
CL:0002047.description: A precursor B cell that is CD45RA-positive, CD43-positive, CD24-positive and BP-1-negative.

CL:0002400.label: fraction B/C precursor B cell
CL:0002400.description: A precursor B cell that is AA4-positive, IgM-negative, CD19-positive, CD43-positive and HSA-positive.

CL:0002048.label: late pro-B cell
CL:0002048.description: A pre-B cell precursor is CD19-low, CD22-positive , CD34-positive, CD38-positive.

CL:0002049.label: fraction C precursor B cell
CL:0002049.description: A precursor B cell that is CD45R-positive, CD43-positive, CD24-positive, and BP-positive. Intracellularly expression of surrogate light chain, Rag1 and Rag2, TdT, occurs while there is no expression of mu heavy chain.

CL:0002050.label: fraction C' precursor B cell
CL:0002050.description: A pre-BCR-positive precursor B cell that is CD24-high, CD25-positive, CD43-positive, CD45R-positive and BP-positive.

CL:0002051.label: CD38-high pre-BCR positive cell
CL:0002051.description: A pre-BCR positive B cell that is CD38-high.

CL:0002052.label: fraction D precursor B cell
CL:0002052.description: A pre-B cell that is pre-BCR-negative, and the kappa- and lambda- light immunoglobulin light chain-negative, CD43-low, and is BP-1-positive, CD45R-positive and CD25-positive. This cell type is also described as being AA4-positive, IgM-negative, CD19-positive, CD43-low/negative, and HSA-positive.

CL:0002053.label: CD22-positive, CD38-low small pre-B cell
CL:0002053.description: A small pre-B cell that is CD22-positive and CD38-low.

CL:0002054.label: fraction E immature B cell
CL:0002054.description: An immature B cell that is IgM-positive, CD45R-positive, CD43-low, CD25-negative, and CD127-negative. This cell type has also been described as being AA4-positive, IgM-positive, CD19-positive, CD43-low/negative, and HSA-positive.

CL:0002055.label: CD38-negative immature B cell
CL:0002055.description: An immature B cell that is CD38-negative, CD10-low, CD21-low, and CD22-high.

CL:0002057.label: CD14-positive, CD16-negative classical monocyte
CL:0002057.description: A classical monocyte that is CD14-positive, CD16-negative, CD64-positive, CD163-positive.

CL:0002058.label: Gr1-low non-classical monocyte
CL:0002058.description: A resident monocyte that is Gr-1 low, CD43-positive, and CX3CR1-positive.

CL:0002398.label: Gr1-positive, CD43-positive monocyte
CL:0002398.description: An intermediate monocyte that is Gr1-positive, CD43-positive.

CL:0002059.label: CD8-alpha-positive thymic conventional dendritic cell
CL:0002059.description: A conventional thymic dendritic cell that is CD8-alpha-positive.

CL:0002060.label: melanophage
CL:0002060.description: A melanin-containing macrophage that obtains the pigment by phagocytosis of melanosomes.

CL:0002061.label: T-helper 9 cell
CL:0002061.description: A T-helper cell that is characterized by secreting interleukin 9 and responding to helminth infections. This cell-type can derives from Th2 cells in the presence of TGF-beta and IL-4. Th2 cytokine production is surpressed.

CL:0002062.label: pulmonary alveolar type 1 cell
CL:0002062.description: A squamous pulmonary alveolar epithelial cell that is flattened and branched. A pulmonary alveolar type 1 cell covers more than 98% of the alveolar surface. This large cell has thin (50-100 nm) cytoplasmic extensions to form the air-blood barrier essential for normal gas exchange.

CL:0002063.label: pulmonary alveolar type 2 cell
CL:0002063.description: A pulmonary alveolar epithelial cell that modulates the fluid surrounding the alveolar epithelium by secreting and recycling surfactants via specialized organelles called alveolar lamellar bodies. This cell type also contributes to tissue repair and can differentiate after injury into a pulmonary alveolar type 1 cell. This cuboidal cell is thicker than squamous alveolar cells, has a rounded apical surface that projects above the level of the surrounding epithelium, and its free surface is covered by short microvilli.

CL:1000272.label: lung secretory cell
CL:1000272.description: Any secretory cell that is part of some lung.

CL:4040003.label: fetal pre-type II pulmonary alveolar epithelial cell
CL:4040003.description: Precursor of type II pneumocyte. These cells do not have lamellar bodies, which are a marker of type II pneumocyte maturity.
synonyms: fetal alveolar pre-type II epithelial cell
fetal pre-type II alveolar epithelial cell

CL:0002064.label: pancreatic acinar cell
CL:0002064.description: A secretory cell found in pancreatic acini that secretes digestive enzymes and mucins. This cell is a typical zymogenic cell, have a basal nucleus and basophilic cytoplasm consisting of regular arrays of granular endoplasmic reticulum with mitochondria and dense secretory granules.

CL:1001599.label: pancreas exocrine glandular cell
CL:1001599.description: Glandular cell of exocrine pancreas epithelium. Example: pancreatic acinar cell, glandular cells in pancreatic canaliculi, glandular cells in pancreatic ducts.

CL:0002066.label: Feyrter cell
CL:0002066.description: A neuroendocrine cell found in the epithelium of the lungs and respiratory tract. This cell type is rounded or elliptical in shape, situated mainly in the basal part of the epithelium; regulates bronchial secretion, smooth muscle contraction, lobular growth, ciliary activity and chemoreception. Cell has an electron-lucent cytoplasm, contains numerous dense-cored vesicles with a clear halo between the core and the limiting membrane.

CL:0002068.label: Purkinje myocyte
CL:0002068.description: Specialized cardiac myocyte that is subendocardially interspersed with the regular cardiac muscle cell. They are uninucleate cylindrical cells, associated end-to-end in long rows, continue from the node to the atrioventricular bundle; relatively short compared to ordinary myocytes but are nearly twice their diameter.

CL:0002086.label: specialized cardiac myocyte
CL:0002086.description: A cardiac myocyte that is an excitable cells in the myocardium, specifically in the conducting system of heart.

CL:0002069.label: type II vestibular sensory cell
CL:0002069.description: Mostly cylindrical, resemble Type 1 in their contents and the presence of a kinocilium and stereocilium apically; much greater variation in size, some almost span the entire thickness of the sensory epithelium, while others are smaller than Type 1; receive multiple efferent nerve boutons around their bases as well as afferent endings, which are small expansions rather than chalices.

CL:0002070.label: type I vestibular sensory cell
CL:0002070.description: Bottle-shaped with narrow neck; broad, rounded basal portion where nucleus is located; stereocilia and a single kinocilium is present apically; receive nerve bouton at their base from an afferent cup-shaped (chalice or calyx) nerve ending.

CL:0002071.label: enterocyte of epithelium of large intestine
CL:0002071.description: Columnar cell which populate the epithelium of large intestine and absorb water. This cell is the most numerous of the epithelial cell types in the large intestine; bear apical microvilli, contain secretory granules in their apical cytoplasm; secretion appears to be largely mucins, but is also rich in antibodies of the IgA type.

CL:0002253.label: epithelial cell of large intestine
CL:0002253.description: An epithelial cell of the lining of the large intestine.

CL:0002072.label: nodal myocyte
CL:0002072.description: A specialized cardiac myocyte in the sinoatrial and atrioventricular nodes. The cell is slender and fusiform confined to the nodal center, circumferentially arranged around the nodal artery.

CL:0002073.label: transitional myocyte
CL:0002073.description: Specialized cardiac myocyte which is in the internodal tract and atrioventricular node. The cell is more slender than ordinary atrial myocytes and has more myofibrils than nodal myocytes.

CL:0002074.label: myocardial endocrine cell
CL:0002074.description: The myoendocrine cellis a specialized myocyte localized mainly in the right and left atrial appendages, and also scattered within other areas of the atria and along the conductive system in the ventricular septum. The most conspicuous feature distinguishing myoendocrine cells from other atrial myoctyes is the presence of membane-bounded secretory granules (these granules contain precursor of cardiodilatins or atrial natriuretic polypeptides).

CL:0002075.label: brush cell of tracheobronchial tree
CL:0002075.description: A rare type of columnar epithelial cell that is part of the tracheobronchial epithelium. This cell is characterized by a distinctive tuft of apical microvilli, which extends into the cytoplasm, and a pear-shaped morphology, broad at the base and tapering to a narrow apex. It plays vital roles in chemosensation, producing cytokines like IL-25, and enhancing mucociliary clearance through acetylcholine release to support mucus movement and airway defense.

CL:0002204.label: tuft cell
CL:0002204.description: An epithelial cell found in various organs, including the gastrointestinal and respiratory tracts, characterized by a tuft of 120-140 blunt microvilli on its apical surface. This cell exhibits diverse functions depending on its location, which includes chemosensation, initiation of immune responses, contribution to mucociliary clearance, and defense against parasites.

CL:0002079.label: pancreatic ductal cell
CL:0002079.description: Epithelial cell found in the ducts of the pancreas. This cell type contributes to the high luminal pH.

CL:1001433.label: epithelial cell of exocrine pancreas
CL:1001433.description: An epithelial cell of the exocrine pancreas.

CL:0002080.label: pancreatic centro-acinar cell
CL:0002080.description: A cubodial epithelial cell that is continuous with the lining of intercalated ducts that drain the acinus. This cell type secretes a high pH solution to aid in activation of zymogens, and can differentiate into endocrine and exocrine pancreatic cell types.

CL:0002081.label: type II cell of carotid body
CL:0002081.description: This cell resembles a glia cell, express the glial marker S100 and act as a supporting cell to type I cell. This cell is located in a small cluster of type I and type II cells near the fork of the carotid artery.

CL:0002256.label: supporting cell of carotid body
CL:0002256.description: A supportive cell that has characteristics of glial cell. Processes of this cell envelope the junctions between glomus cells and nerve endings.

CL:0002082.label: type II cell of adrenal medulla
CL:0002082.description: A chromaffin cell of the adrenal medulla that produces epinephrine.
synonyms: adrenal secreting cell of the adrenal medulla
epiniphrine secreting cell of the adrenal medulla

CL:0002083.label: type I cell of adrenal medulla
CL:0002083.description: A chromaffin cell of the adrenal medulla that produces norepinephrine.

CL:0002084.label: Boettcher cell
CL:0002084.description: A Boettcher cell is a polyhedral cells on the basilar membrane of the cochlea, and is located beneath Claudius cells. A Boettcher cell is considered a supporting cell for the organ of Corti, and is present only in the lower turn of the cochlea. These cells interweave with each other, and project microvilli into the intercellular space. Because of their structural specialization, a Boettcher cell is believed to play a significant role in the function of the cochlea. They demonstrate high levels of calmodulin, and may be involved in mediating Ca(2+) regulation and ion transport.

CL:0002088.label: interstitial cell of Cajal
CL:0002088.description: This is a cell found in the gastrointestinal tract of mammals and serves as a pacemaker that triggers gut contraction. ICCs mediate inputs from the enteric nervous system to smooth muscle cells and are thought to be the cells from which gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GISTs) arise.

CL:0002089.label: group 2 innate lymphoid cell, mouse
CL:0002089.description: A group 2 innate lymphoid cell in the mouse capable of secreting IL-13 in response to a helminth infection. This cell is lineage-negative, ICOS-positive, IL1RL1-positive, IL7Ralpha-positive, and IL17Br-positive.

CL:0002090.label: polar body
CL:0002090.description: One of two small cells formed by the first and second meiotic division of oocytes.

CL:0002091.label: primary polar body
CL:0002091.description: A small cell formed by the first meiotic division of oocytes.

CL:0002092.label: bone marrow cell
CL:0002092.description: A cell found in the bone marrow. This can include fibroblasts, macrophages, adipocytes, osteoblasts, osteoclasts, endothelial cells and hematopoietic cells.

CL:0002093.label: secondary polar body
CL:0002093.description: A small cell formed by the second meiotic division of oocytes. In mammals, the second polar body may fail to form unless the ovum has been penetrated by a sperm cell.

CL:0002094.label: interstitial cell of ovary
CL:0002094.description: A cell that makes up the loose connective tissue of the ovary.

CL:0002095.label: hilus cell of ovary
CL:0002095.description: A cell in the hilum of the ovary that produces androgens.

CL:0002096.label: internodal tract myocyte
CL:0002096.description: A specialised myocyte that lies between the sinoatrial node and the atrioventricular node and is involved in the conduction of electrical signals.

CL:0008009.label: transversely striated visceral muscle cell
CL:0008009.description: A visceral muscle that is transversely striated.  Examples include the visceral muscle cells of arthropods.

CL:0002097.label: cortical cell of adrenal gland
CL:0002097.description: A cell of the adrenal cortex. Cell types include those that synthesize and secrete chemical derivatives (steroids) of cholesterol.

CL:1001601.label: adrenal gland glandular cell
CL:1001601.description: Hormone secreting cell located in the cortex of adrenal gland. Glandular cells in the adrenal cortex secrete mineralocorticoids, glucocorticoids and androgens.

CL:0002098.label: regular cardiac myocyte
CL:0002098.description: A cardiac myocyte that is connected to other cardiac myocytes by transverse intercalated discs (GO:0014704) at a regular interval.

CL:0002099.label: type I cell of adrenal cortex
CL:0002099.description: A small, polyhedral, cell found in rounded groups or curved columns with deeply staining nuclei, scanty basophilic cytoplasm and a few lipid droplets. This cell in the zona glomerulosa produces mineralocorticoids.
synonyms: epithelial cell of zona glomerulosa of adrenal gland

CL:0002100.label: regular interventricular cardiac myocyte
CL:0002100.description: A regular cardiac myocyte of the interventricular region of the heart.

CL:0002101.label: CD38-positive naive B cell
CL:0002101.description: A CD38-positive naive B cell is a mature B cell that has the phenotype CD38-positive, surface IgD-positive, surface IgM-positive, and CD27-negative, and that has not yet been activated by antigen in the periphery.

CL:0002102.label: CD38-negative naive B cell
CL:0002102.description: A CD38-negative naive B cell is a mature B cell that has the phenotype CD38-negative, surface IgD-positive, surface IgM-positive, and CD27-negative, that has not yet been activated by antigen in the periphery.

CL:0002103.label: IgG-positive double negative memory B cell
CL:0002103.description: An IgG-positive double negative memory B cell is a double negative memory B cell with the phenotype IgG-positive, IgD-negative, and CD27-negative.
synonyms: IgG+ double negative memory B cell
IgG+ double negative memory B lymphocyte
IgG-positive double negative memory B lymphocyte

CL:0002104.label: IgG-negative double negative memory B cell
CL:0002104.description: An IgG-negative double negative memory B cell is a double negative memory B cell with the phenotype IgG-negative, IgD-negative, and CD27-negative.
synonyms: IgG- double negative memory B cell
IgG- double negative memory B lymphocyte
IgG-negative double negative memory B lymphocyte

CL:0002105.label: CD38-positive IgG memory B cell
CL:0002105.description: A CD38-positive IgG memory B cell is a class switched memory B cell that expresses IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype CD38-positive and IgG-positive.

CL:0002106.label: IgD-positive CD38-positive IgG memory B cell
CL:0002106.description: An IgD-positive CD38-positive IgG memory B cell is a CD38-positive IgG-positive class switched memory B cell that has class switched and expresses IgD on the cell surface with the phenotype IgD-positive, CD38-positive, and IgG-positive.

CL:0002107.label: IgD-negative CD38-positive IgG memory B cell
CL:0002107.description: An IgD-negative CD38-positive IgG memory B cell is a CD38-positive IgG-positive that has class switched and lacks expression of IgD on the cell surface with the phenotype IgD-negative, CD38-positive, and IgG-positive.

CL:0002108.label: CD38-negative IgG memory B cell
CL:0002108.description: A CD38-negative IgG memory B cell is a IgG-positive class switched memory B cell that has class switched and expresses IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype CD38-negative, IgD-negative, and IgG-positive.

CL:0002109.label: B220-positive CD38-positive naive B cell
CL:0002109.description: A B220-positive CD38-positive naive B cell is a CD38-positive naive B cell that has the phenotype B220-positive, CD38-positive, surface IgD-positive, surface IgM-positive, and CD27-negative, and that has not yet been activated by antigen in the periphery.

CL:0002110.label: B220-low CD38-positive naive B cell
CL:0002110.description: A B220-low CD38-positive naive B cell is a CD38-positive naive B cell that has the phenotype B220-low, CD38-positive, surface IgD-positive, surface IgM-positive, and CD27-negative, that has not yet been activated by antigen in the periphery.

CL:0002111.label: CD38-negative unswitched memory B cell
CL:0002111.description: An CD38-negative unswitched memory B cell is an unswitched memory B cell that has the phenotype CD38-negative, IgD-positive, CD138-negative, and IgG-negative.

CL:0002112.label: B220-positive CD38-negative unswitched memory B cell
CL:0002112.description: A B220-positive CD38-negative unswitched memory B cell is a CD38-negative unswitched memory B cell that has the phenotype B220-positive, CD38-negative, IgD-positive, CD138-negative, and IgG-negative.

CL:0002113.label: B220-low CD38-negative unswitched memory B cell
CL:0002113.description: A B220-low CD38-negative unswitched memory B cell is a CD38-negative unswitched memory B cell that has the phenotype B220-low, CD38-negative, IgD-positive, CD138-negative, and IgG-negative.

CL:0002114.label: CD38-positive unswitched memory B cell
CL:0002114.description: A CD38-positive unswitched memory B cell is an unswitched memory B cell that has the phenotype CD38-positive, IgD-positive, CD138-negative, and IgG-negative.

CL:0002115.label: B220-positive CD38-positive unswitched memory B cell
CL:0002115.description: A B220-positive CD38-positive unswitched memory B cell is a CD38-positive unswitched memory B cell that has the phenotype B220-positive, CD38-positive, IgD-positive, CD138-negative, and IgG-negative.

CL:0002116.label: B220-low CD38-positive unswitched memory B cell
CL:0002116.description: A B220-low CD38-positive unswitched memory B cell is a CD38-positive unswitched memory B cell that has the phenotype B220-low, CD38-positive, IgD-positive, CD138-negative, and IgG-negative.

CL:0002117.label: IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
CL:0002117.description: A class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface.
synonyms: IgG- class switched memory B cell
IgG- class switched memory B lymphocyte
IgG-negative class switched memory B lymphocyte

CL:0002118.label: CD38-negative IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
CL:0002118.description: A CD38-negative IgG-negative memory B cell is a IgG-negative class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype CD38-negative and IgG-negative.

CL:0002119.label: CD38-positive IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
CL:0002119.description: A CD38-positive IgG-negative memory B cell is an IgG-negative class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype CD38-positive and IgG-negative.

CL:0002120.label: CD24-positive CD38-negative IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
CL:0002120.description: An CD24-positive CD38-negative IgG-negative memory B cell is a CD38-negative IgG-negative class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype CD24-positive, CD38-negative, and IgG-negative.

CL:0002121.label: CD24-negative CD38-negative IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
CL:0002121.description: A CD24-negative CD38-negative IgG-negative memory B cell is a CD38-negative IgG-negative class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype CD24-negative, CD38-negative, and IgG-negative.

CL:0002122.label: B220-positive CD38-positive IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
CL:0002122.description: A B220-positive CD38-positive IgG-negative memory B cell is a CD38-positive IgG-negative class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype B220-positive, CD38-positive, and IgG-negative.

CL:0002123.label: B220-low CD38-positive IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
CL:0002123.description: A B220-low CD38-positive IgG-negative memory B cell is a CD38-positive IgG-negative class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype B220-low, CD38-positive, and IgG-positive.

CL:0002124.label: CD27-positive gamma-delta T cell
CL:0002124.description: A circulating gamma-delta T cell that is CD27-positive and capable of producing IFN-gamma.

CL:0002126.label: CD25-positive, CD27-positive immature gamma-delta T cell
CL:0002126.description: A CD25-positive, CD27-positive immature gamma-delta T cell found in the thymus that has an immature phenotype (i.e. CD24-high, CD25-high, CD62L-high, CD44-high, CD2-low, CD5-low).

CL:0002125.label: CD27-negative gamma-delta T cell
CL:0002125.description: A circulating gamma-delta T cell that expresses RORgamma(t), is CD27-negative and is capable of IL-17 secretion.

CL:0002127.label: innate effector T cell
CL:0002127.description: A T cell with a receptor of limited diversity that is capable of immediate effector functions upon stimulation.

CL:0002128.label: Tc17 cell
CL:0002128.description: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell that has the phenotype CXCR3-negative, CCR6-positive, CCR5-high, CD45RA-negative, and capable of producing IL-17 and some IFNg.

CL:0002129.label: regular atrial cardiac myocyte
CL:0002129.description: Regular cardiac myocyte of a cardiac atrium.
synonyms: regular cardiac muscle cell of atrium

CL:0002130.label: regular interatrial cardiac myocyte
CL:0002130.description: A cardiac myocyte of the interatrial region of the heart.

CL:0002131.label: regular ventricular cardiac myocyte
CL:0002131.description: Regular cardiac myocyte of a cardiac ventricle.
synonyms: regular cardiac muscle cell of ventricle

CL:0002133.label: stromal cell of ovarian cortex
CL:0002133.description: A stromal cell of the ovarian cortex.

CL:0002134.label: stromal cell of ovarian medulla
CL:0002134.description: A stromal cell of the ovarian medulla.

CL:0002135.label: nonkeratinized cell of epidermis
CL:0002135.description: Epidermal cells that do not contain keratin. Cell type is usually associated with moist epidermal tissues.

CL:0002136.label: type II cell of adrenal cortex
CL:0002136.description: A cell in the zona fasciculata that produce glucocorticoids, e.g cortisol.
synonyms: type II cortical cell of adrenal gland

CL:0002137.label: type III cell of adrenal cortex
CL:0002137.description: A cell in the zona reticularis that produce sex hormones.

CL:0002138.label: endothelial cell of lymphatic vessel
CL:0002138.description: A endothelial cell of a lymphatic vessel. The border of the oak leaf-shaped endothelial cell of initial lymphatics are joined by specialized buttons. The discontinuous feature of buttons distinguishes them from zippers in collecting lymphatics, but both types of junctions are composed of proteins typical of adherens junctions and tight junctions found in the endothelium of blood vessels. Buttons seal the sides of flaps of the oak leaf-shaped endothelial cell, leaving open the tips of flaps as routes for fluid entry without disassembly and reformation of intercellular junctions.

CL:0005022.label: vascular lymphangioblast
CL:0005022.description: Lymphatic progenitor cells, derived from the veins, that give rise to lymphatic endothelial cells.

CL:0002140.label: skin sebocyte
CL:0002140.description: An acinar cell that is part of a skin sebaceous gland. This cell produces and secretes sebum into hair follicles.
synonyms: acinar cell of skin sebaceous gland

CL:0002141.label: active chief cell of parathyroid gland
CL:0002141.description: A parathyroid chief cell that is actively secreting hormone. Have large Golgi complexes with numerous vesicles and small membrane-bound granules; secretory granules are rare, cytoplasmic glycogen sparse, much of the cytoplasm being occupied by flat sacs of granular endoplasmic reticulum in parallel arrays; in normal humans, inactive chief cells outnumber active chief cells in a ratio of 3-5:1

CL:0002142.label: dark cell of eccrine sweat gland
CL:0002142.description: A cell pyramidal in shape, with their broad ends facing and forming the greater extent of the lining of the main lumen. Secretes glycoproteins associated with mucus.

CL:1000448.label: epithelial cell of sweat gland
CL:1000448.description: An epithelial cell that is part of the sweat gland.

CL:0002143.label: dark chief cell of parathyroid gland
CL:0002143.description: A chief cell that is smaller than light chief cells and has a smaller and darker nucleus and a finely granular cytoplasm with many granules.

CL:0002144.label: capillary endothelial cell
CL:0002144.description: An endothelial cell found in capillaries.

CL:2000008.label: microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000008.description: Any blood vessel endothelial cell that is part of a microvascular endothelium.

CL:0002145.label: multiciliated columnar cell of tracheobronchial tree
CL:0002145.description: A multi-ciliated epithelial cell located in the trachea and bronchi, characterized by a columnar shape and motile cilia on its apical surface. These cilia facilitate mucociliary clearance by moving mucus and trapped particles toward the pharynx.
synonyms: ciliated columnar cell of tracheobronchial tree

CL:4030034.label: respiratory tract multiciliated cell
CL:4030034.description: A multiciliated epithelial cell located in the respiratory tract epithelium, characterized by a columnar shape and motile cilia on its apical surface. This cell develops through a highly orchestrated process, transitioning from a basal progenitor via an intermediate deuterosomal cell stage that generates centrioles essential for ciliogenesis.
synonyms: ciliated cell of the respiratory tract

CL:0002209.label: intermediate epitheliocyte
CL:0002209.description: An epithelial cell present in the trachea and bronchi; columnar in shape; generally lack cilia; immature forms of ciliated or secretory cells which have been formed from stem cells.
synonyms: undifferentiated columnar cell of tracheobronchial tree

CL:0002146.label: clear cell of eccrine sweat gland
CL:0002146.description: A sweat producing cell of eccrine sweat glands. Pyramidal in shape, with its base resting on the basal lamina or myoepitheliocytes, and its microvillus-covered apical plasma membrane line up the intercellular canaliculi. Cell is not stained by hematoxylin or eosin.

CL:0002147.label: clear chief cell of parathyroid gland
CL:0002147.description: A chief cell of parathyroid glands that does not stain with hematoxylin or eosin. This cell is larger, has a larger nucleus and fewer secretory granules than dark chief cells.
synonyms: clear chief cell of parathyroid cell

CL:0002149.label: epithelial cell of uterus
CL:0002149.description: An epithelial cell of the uterus. This cell has a mesodermal origin.

CL:0002150.label: epithelioid macrophage
CL:0002150.description: Epithelioid macrophage is an activated macrophage that resembles an epithelial cell with finely granular, pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and central, ovoid nucleus (oval or elongate). This cell type is able to merge into one another to form aggregates. The presence of such aggregates may characterize some pathologic conditions, mainly granulomatous inflammation.

CL:0002151.label: late promyelocyte
CL:0002151.description: A promyelocyte that is considerably smaller, with more condensed chromatin, and nucleoli are no longer conspicuous.

CL:0002152.label: columnar cell of endocervix
CL:0002152.description: A simple columnar epithelial cell located in the endocervix.

CL:0002535.label: epithelial cell of cervix
CL:0002535.description: An epithelial cell of the cervix.
synonyms: cervical canal of uterus epithelial cell
epithelial cell of cervical canal of uterus
epithelial cell of cervix of uterus
epithelial cell of neck of uterus

CL:0002153.label: corneocyte
CL:0002153.description: The dead keratin-filled squamous cell of the stratum corneum. This cell type lacks a nucleus.

CL:0002154.label: early promyelocyte
CL:0002154.description: A promyelocyte with a nucleus that is indented and contains more marginated heterochromatin compared to its precursor cell (myeloblast); cytoplasm is deeply basophilic and contains numerous mitochondria and meandering cysternae of endoplasmic reticulum; largest of the granulocyte lineages.

CL:0002155.label: echinocyte
CL:0002155.description: A crenated erythrocyte with 30+ crenations, bumps or spurs that are the result of damage due to age or disease.

CL:0002157.label: endosteal cell
CL:0002157.description: A cell type that makes up the highly vascular membrane lining the marrow cavity of long bones.

CL:0002158.label: external epithelial cell of tympanic membrane
CL:0002158.description: Epithelial cell found on the external side of the tympanic membrane

CL:0002160.label: basal external epithelial cell of tympanic membrane
CL:0002160.description: A cell type found in the basal epithelial layer on the external side of the tympanic membrane. Cell type is flattened with intracellular spaces of variable dimensions.

CL:0002161.label: superficial external epithelial cell of tympanic membrane
CL:0002161.description: A cell type found on the superficial layer of the external side of the tympanic membrane. This cell-type lacks a nucleus.

CL:0002162.label: internal epithelial cell of tympanic membrane
CL:0002162.description: An extremely flattened cell type found on the inner side of the tympanic membrane. The surface of this cell type carries sparse pleomorphic microvilli that are more common near the junctional zones.

CL:0002163.label: internal pillar cell of cochlea
CL:0002163.description: A rod-shpaed cell that forms a single row adjacent to and supporting the inner hair cells.

CL:1000191.label: pillar cell
CL:1000191.description: A rod-like cell in the inner ear, having their heads joined and their bases on the basilar membrane widely separated so as to form a spiral tunnel known as the tunnel of Corti.

CL:0002164.label: external pillar cell of cochlea
CL:0002164.description: A rod-shaped cell found in 3 or 4 rows that lie adjacent to and support the outer hair cells.

CL:0002166.label: epithelial cell of Malassez
CL:0002166.description: An epithelial cell that remains from the disintegration of the epithelial root sheath involved in the development of teeth.

CL:0002631.label: epithelial cell of upper respiratory tract
CL:0002631.description: Any epithelial cell that is part of some upper respiratory tract epithelium.

CL:0002168.label: border cell of cochlea
CL:0002168.description: A border cell is a slender columnar cell on the medial portion of the basilar membrane.

CL:0002169.label: basal cell of olfactory epithelium
CL:0002169.description: An epithelial cell located on the basal lamina of the olfactory epithelium.

CL:0002170.label: keratinized cell of the oral mucosa
CL:0002170.description: A keratinized cell located in the hard palate or gingiva.

CL:0002336.label: buccal mucosa cell
CL:0002336.description: An endothelial cell that lines the oral cavitiy including the mucosa of the gums, the palate, the lip, and the cheek.

CL:0002171.label: globose cell of olfactory epithelium
CL:0002171.description: A rounded or elliptical epithelial cell, with pale-staining open face nucleus and pale cytoplasm rich in free ribosomes and clusters of centrioles; form a distinct basal zone spaced slightly from the basal surface of the epithelium.

CL:0002172.label: interdental cell of cochlea
CL:0002172.description: A long, spindle-shaped supporting cells arranged in parallel rows that secretes components of the tectorial membrane and potassium ions into the endolymph.

CL:0002173.label: extraglomerular mesangial cell
CL:0002173.description: A cell that is a specialized type of pericyte providing structural support for the capillary loops of kidney. A flat, elongated cell with extensive fine cytoplasmic processes found outside the kidney glomerulus near the macula densa and bound laterally by afferent and efferent arterioles. Being phagocytic, this cell participates in the continuous turnover of the basal lamina by removing its outer portion containing residues of filtration, while the lamina is renewed on its inner surface by the endothelial cells.

CL:1001318.label: renal interstitial pericyte
CL:1001318.description: A pericyte cell located in the kidney interstitium.

CL:0002175.label: primary follicular cell of ovary
CL:0002175.description: A cell within the primary follicle of the ovary.

CL:0002176.label: secondary follicular cell of ovary
CL:0002176.description: A cell of a secondary follicile within the ovary.

CL:0002177.label: folliculostellate cell of pars distalis of adenohypophysis
CL:0002177.description: A supporting cell of the anterior pituitary gland involved in trophic and catabolic processes; expresses a broad spectrum of cytokeratins indicative of their epithelial nature.
synonyms: folliculostellate cell of pars anterior of adenohypophysis

CL:0002178.label: epithelial cell of stomach
CL:0002178.description: An epithelial cell found in the lining of the stomach.

CL:0002251.label: epithelial cell of alimentary canal
CL:0002251.description: An epithelial cell of the musculomembranous digestive tube extending from the mouth to the anus.

CL:0002179.label: foveolar cell of stomach
CL:0002179.description: A simple columnar cell that populates the entire luminal surface including the gastric pits. This cell types secrete mucus to form a thick protective, lubricant layer over the gastric wall.

CL:0002180.label: mucous cell of stomach
CL:0002180.description: An epithelial cell of the stomach. This cell produces mucous.

CL:0002182.label: obsolete surface mucosal cell of stomach
CL:0002182.description: OBSOLETE. A simple columnar cell that populates the entire luminal surface including the gastric pits. This cell types secrete mucus to form a thick protective, lubricant layer over the gastric wall.
comments: Duplicate with foveolar cell of stomach

CL:0002183.label: stem cell of gastric gland
CL:0002183.description: A stomach epithelial cell that is olumnar in form with a few short apical microvilli; relatively undifferentiated mitotic cell from which other types of gland are derived; few in number, situated in the isthmus region of the gland and base of the gastric pit.

CL:0002184.label: basal proper cell of olfactory epithelium
CL:0002184.description: A flat or angular epithelial cell with condensed nuclei and darkly staining cytoplasm containing numerous intermediate filaments inserted into desmosomes contacting surrounding supporting cells; lie in contact with the basal lamina of olfactory epithelium.

CL:0002187.label: basal cell of epidermis
CL:0002187.description: A mitotically active, columnar-shaped keratinocyte located in the stratum basale of the epidermis and attached to the basement membrane. This cell exhibits heterogeneity, encompassing stem and progenitor subpopulations with distinct molecular and proliferative characteristics (Haensel et al., 2020), and serves as the primary source of new keratinocytes for epidermal renewal, homeostasis, and regeneration.

CL:1000428.label: stem cell of epidermis
CL:1000428.description: A somatic stem cell that is part of the epidermis.

CL:0002188.label: glomerular endothelial cell
CL:0002188.description: An endothelial cell that is part of the glomerulus of the kidney. This cell is flattened, highly fenestrated, and plays a vital role in the formation of glomerular ultrafiltrate.

CL:0002681.label: kidney cortical cell
CL:0002681.description: A cell that is part of a cortex of kidney.

CL:0002189.label: granular cell of epidermis
CL:0002189.description: A keratinocyte located in the stratum granulosum of the epidermis, characterized by the presence of keratohyalin granules containing filaggrin—which aggregate keratin filament —and by lamellar granules that secrete lipids and enzymes essential for forming the skin’s waterproof barrier. As these cells progress toward the surface, they adopt a flattened morphology and initiate keratinization to become corneocyte and form the protective stratum corneum. In human epidermis, granular keratinocytes are transcriptomically distinguished by high expression of differentiation markers such as DSC1, KRT2, IVL, and TGM3 (Wang et al., 2020), and LOR, FLG, and SPINK5 (Cheng et al., 2018).

CL:0002190.label: squamous cell of epidermis
CL:0002190.description: A flat keratinocyte immediately below the cornified layer.

CL:0002195.label: hepatic stem cell
CL:0002195.description: A stem cell that can give rise to the cells of the liver. The term usually refers to the self-renewing pool of hepatocyte precursors in the adult liver (differently from 'hepatoblast', often used for fetal precursors of hepatocytes).

CL:0002196.label: hepatic oval stem cell
CL:0002196.description: A transient hepatic stem cell observed after liver injury with a high nuclear to cytoplasm ratio that can differentiate into mature hepatocytes and bile duct cells. Arises from more than one tissue.

CL:0002197.label: inactive chief cell of parathyoid gland
CL:0002197.description: A parathyroid chief cell that is not actively secreting hormone. Contains small Golgi complexes with only a few grouped vesicles and membrane-bound secretory granules; glycogen and many lipofuscin granules abound but sacs of granular endoplasmic reticulum are rare and dispersed. In normal humans, inactive chief cells out number active chief cells in a ratio of 3-5:1.

CL:0002198.label: oncocyte
CL:0002198.description: A large epithelial cell with an extremely acidophilic and granular cytoplasm, containing vast numbers of mitochondria; such cells may undergo neoplastic transformation. From the Greek word onkos meaning swelling, this cell type is found in parathyroid, salivary and thyroid glands.

CL:0002199.label: oxyphil cell of parathyroid gland
CL:0002199.description: An oncocyte located in the parathyroid gland.

CL:0002260.label: epithelial cell of parathyroid gland
CL:0002260.description: An epithelial cell of the parathyroid gland.

CL:0002200.label: oxyphil cell of thyroid
CL:0002200.description: An oncocyte located in the thyroid.

CL:0002201.label: renal beta-intercalated cell
CL:0002201.description: A renal intercalated cell that secretes base and reabsorbs acid in the distal segments of the kidney tubule to maintain acid/base balance.

CL:0005010.label: renal intercalated cell
CL:0005010.description: A cuboidal epithelial cell of the kidney that regulates acid/base balance.

CL:0002203.label: tuft cell of large intestine
CL:0002203.description: A tuft cell that is part of the epithelium of large intestine.
synonyms: brush cell of epithelium proper of large intestine
tuft cell of epithelium of large intestine

CL:0019032.label: intestinal tuft cell
CL:0019032.description: A tuft cell that is part of the intestinal epithelium, characterized by a distinctive apical tuft and lateral cytospinules connecting to neighbouring cells. This cell senses luminal stimuli via taste receptors and succinate signalling, initiating type 2 immune responses through the secretion of interleukin-25 while modulating epithelial regeneration through prostaglandin synthesis. It expresses key molecular markers such as doublecortin-like kinase 1 (DCLK1) in mice (Hendel et al., 2022), and KIT proto-oncogene in humans (Huang et al., 2024). Developed from intestinal crypt stem cells, this cell requires transcription factor POU2F3 for its development.

CL:0002205.label: brush cell of lobular bronchiole
CL:0002205.description: A brush cell found in the epithelium of lobular bronchiole.

CL:0002206.label: brush cell of terminal bronchiole
CL:0002206.description: A brush cell of the epithelium in the terminal bronchiole.

CL:0002207.label: brush cell of trachea
CL:0002207.description: Brush cell of the epithelium in the trachea.

CL:0002208.label: brush cell of bronchus
CL:0002208.description: A brush cell found in the epithelium of bronchus.

CL:0002328.label: bronchial epithelial cell
CL:0002328.description: An epithelial cell of the bronchus.

CL:0002210.label: red muscle cell
CL:0002210.description: A slow muscle cell that contains high levels of myoglobin and oxygen storing proteins giving the cell a red appearance.

CL:0002211.label: type I muscle cell
CL:0002211.description: A slow muscle cell that has large amounts of myoglobin, stores energy as triglycerides, generates ATP by the oxidative method and is resistant to fatigue.

CL:0002212.label: type II muscle cell
CL:0002212.description: A fast muscle fiber cell that stores energy in the form of glycogen and creatine phosphate.

CL:0002213.label: white muscle cell
CL:0002213.description: A muscle cell with low content of myoglobin and other oxygen storing proteins. This muscle cell has a white appearance.

CL:0002214.label: type IIa muscle cell
CL:0002214.description: A type II muscle cell that contains large amounts of myoglobin, has many mitochondria and very many blood capillaries. Type II A cells are red, have a very high capacity for generating ATP by oxidative metabolic processes, split ATP at a very rapid rate, have a fast contraction velocity and are resistant to fatigue.
synonyms: fatigue resistant fast twitch muscle cell

CL:0002215.label: type IIb muscle cell
CL:0002215.description: A type II muscle cell that contains a low content of myoglobin, relatively few mitochondria, relatively few blood capillaries and large amounts of glycogen. Type II B fibres are white, geared to generate ATP by anaerobic metabolic processes, not able to supply skeletal muscle fibres continuously with sufficient ATP, fatigue easily, split ATP at a fast rate and have a fast contraction velocity.

CL:0002216.label: intermediate muscle cell
CL:0002216.description: An intermediate muscle cell that has characteristics of both fast and slow muscle cells.

CL:0002217.label: intermediate trophoblast cell
CL:0002217.description: A trophoblast that leaves the placenta and invades the endometrium and myometrium. This cell type is crucial in increasing blood flow to the fetus.

CL:0002218.label: immature dendritic epithelial T cell precursor
CL:0002218.description: A double negative thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain that has as part a Vgamma3 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive. This cell-type is found in the fetal thymus with highest numbers occurring at E17-E18.

CL:0002404.label: fetal thymocyte
CL:0002404.description: A thymocyte found in the fetal thymus.

CL:0002219.label: anchoring trophoblast
CL:0002219.description: A trophoblast found at the junction of the placenta. This cell type makes a unique fibronectin-trophouteronectin junction that helps mediate attachment of the placenta to the uterus. This cell type is also found junction of the chorion layer of the external membranes and the decidua.

CL:0002220.label: interstitial cell of pineal gland
CL:0002220.description: A cell located between the pinealocytes.

CL:0002221.label: keratinized squamous cell of esophagus
CL:0002221.description: A squamous cell that has keratin in the esophagus.

CL:0002252.label: epithelial cell of esophagus
CL:0002252.description: An epithelial cell of the lining of the esophagus.

CL:0002222.label: vertebrate lens cell
CL:0002222.description: A cell comprising the transparent, biconvex body separating the posterior chamber and vitreous body, and constituting part of the refracting mechanism of the mammalian eye.

CL:0002223.label: anterior lens cell
CL:0002223.description: A cell of the transparent layer of simple cuboidal epithelium over the anterior surface of the lens; transform into lens fiber(s).

CL:0002224.label: lens epithelial cell
CL:0002224.description: A cell of the cuboidal epithelium that covers the lens. The cells of the lens epithelium regulate most of the homeostatic functions of the lens. As ions, nutrients, and liquid enter the lens from the aqueous humor, Na+/K+ ATPase pumps in the lens epithelial cells pump ions out of the lens to maintain appropriate lens osmolarity and volume, with equatorially positioned lens epithelium cells contributing most to this current. The activity of the Na+/K+ ATPases keeps water and current flowing through the lens from the poles and exiting through the equatorial regions. The cells of the lens epithelium also serve as the progenitors for new lens fibers. It constantly lays down fibers in the embryo, fetus, infant, and adult, and continues to lay down fibers for lifelong growth.

CL:0002225.label: secondary lens fiber
CL:0002225.description: A lens fiber cell that develops from primary lens fiber; located towards the center of lens; cell organelles are normally degraded or in the process of being degraded.

CL:0011004.label: lens fiber cell
CL:0011004.description: A vetebrate lens cell that is any of the elongated, tightly packed cells that make up the bulk of the mature lens in a camera-type eye.

CL:0002228.label: primary lens fiber
CL:0002228.description: An elongating cell that rapidly obliterates the lumen of the lens vesicle. Subsequently, differentiation of this cell type at the lens equator leads to the formation of secondary fiber cells that come to overlie the primary fibers.

CL:0002226.label: non-nucleated secondary lens fiber
CL:0002226.description: A secondary lens fiber cell that lacks a nucleus.

CL:0002227.label: nucleated secondary lens fiber
CL:0002227.description: A secondary fiber cell that contains a nucleus.

CL:0002229.label: light chief cell of parathyroid gland
CL:0002229.description: A chief cell that is bigger than dark chief cells and has a larger and lighter nucleus and a cytoplasm with few granules.

CL:0002325.label: lactocyte
CL:0002325.description: A milk-producing glandular epithelial cell that is part of a mammary gland alveolus and differentiates from a luminal adaptive secretory precursor cell during secretory differentiation (also termed lactogenesis I). Following secretory activation (also termed lactogenesis II), a lactocyte is involved in the synthesis and/or transport of milk constituents including proteins, oligosaccharides, lactose, micronutrients, fat, hormones, immunoglobulins, and cytokines into the lumen of the lactating mammary gland.
synonyms: luminal cell of alveolus of lactiferous gland

CL:0002231.label: epithelial cell of prostate
CL:0002231.description: An epithelial cell of the prostate.

CL:0002232.label: epithelial cell of prostatic duct
CL:0002232.description: An epithelial cell of prostatic duct.

CL:0002233.label: epithelial cell of prostatic acinus
CL:0002233.description: An epithelial cell of the prostatic acinus.

CL:0002234.label: basal cell of prostatic acinus
CL:0002234.description: A cell of the basal layer of the epithelium in the prostatic acinus.
synonyms: basal epithelial cell of prostatic acinus

CL:0002341.label: basal cell of prostate epithelium
CL:0002341.description: An undifferentiated cell of the prostate epithelium that lacks secretory activity.

CL:0002235.label: luminal cell of prostatic acinus
CL:0002235.description: A cell of the luminal layer of the epithelium in the prostatic acinus.

CL:0002340.label: luminal cell of prostate epithelium
CL:0002340.description: The exocrine cell of the prostate, this epithelial cell secretes prostatic acid phosphotase and PSA, and is dependent on androgen hormones for survival.

CL:0002236.label: basal epithelial cell of prostatic duct
CL:0002236.description: A cell that constitutes the basal layer of epithelium in the prostatic duct.

CL:0002237.label: luminal epithelial cell of prostatic duct
CL:0002237.description: A cell that constitutes the luminal layer of epithelium of prostatic duct.

CL:0002238.label: male gonocyte
CL:0002238.description: A primordial germ cell that is destined to become a male germ cell.

CL:0002239.label: ooblast
CL:0002239.description: A primordial cell from which an oocyte (ovum) ultimately is developed.

CL:0002240.label: marrow fibroblast
CL:0002240.description: A fibroblast in the bone marrow.

CL:0010001.label: stromal cell of bone marrow
CL:0010001.description: A stromal cell that is part_of a bone marrow.

CL:0002241.label: pulmonary interstitial fibroblast
CL:0002241.description: A fibroblasts found in interstitial spaces in the pulmonary tract. Greater numbers of these cells are found in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

CL:0002243.label: smooth muscle cell of sphincter of pupil
CL:0002243.description: A circular smooth muscle cell of the iris, innervated by the ciliary nerves (parasympathetic), and acting to contract the pupil. This muscle cell derives from neuroectoderm. This smooth muscle cell results from transformation of epithelial cells to smooth muscle cells.
synonyms: smooth muscle fiber of sphincter of pupil

CL:0002244.label: squamous cell of ectocervix
CL:0002244.description: A stratified squamous epithelial cell located in the ectocervix.

CL:1001575.label: uterine cervix squamous cell
CL:1001575.description: Squamous cell of uterine cervix epithelium.

CL:0002245.label: obsolete null lymphocyte
CL:0002245.description: OBSOLETE: A lymphocyte that lacks T or B cell surface markers.

CL:0002246.label: peripheral blood stem cell
CL:0002246.description: A hematopoeitic stem cell found in the blood. Normally found in very limited numbers in the peripheral circulation (less than 0.1% of all nucleated cells).

CL:0002247.label: pleural macrophage
CL:0002247.description: A tissue macrophage that is in the pleural space.

CL:0002248.label: pluripotent stem cell
CL:0002248.description: A pluripotent stem cell has the ability to form cells from all three germ layers (ectoderm, mesoderm, and endoderm). However, unlike totipotent stem cells, they cell can not generate all the cells of the whole organism such as placenta.

CL:0002249.label: primitive cardiac myocyte
CL:0002249.description: A stem cell that can differentiate into a cardiac myocyte.

CL:0002250.label: intestinal crypt stem cell
CL:0002250.description: A stem cell located in epithelium the based of the crypt of Lieberkuhn. Division of these cells serve both to maintain the stem cell population and produce the transit amplifying cells that are all precursors of all cell types that populate the intestinal epithelium.
synonyms: stem cell of intestinal crypt of Lieberkuhn

CL:0002254.label: epithelial cell of small intestine
CL:0002254.description: An epithelial cell of the lining of the small intestine.

CL:0002255.label: stromal cell of endometrium
CL:0002255.description: A stromal cell of the endometrium, characterized by its fibroblast-like morphology, regenerative capacity, and ability to undergo decidualization. It differentiates into a decidual stromal cell during pregnancy, essential for embryo implantation and maintenance. This cell is involved in tissue proliferation, remodeling, and breakdown, responding to hormonal changes, particularly estrogen and progesterone.

CL:2000002.label: decidual cell
CL:2000002.description: A specialized, enlarged, connective tissue cell of the decidua with enlarged nucleus, dense membrane‐bound secretory granules and cytoplasmic accumulation of glycogen and lipid droplets. These cells develop by the transformation of endometrial stromal cells during decidualization.

CL:0002259.label: neuroepithelial stem cell
CL:0002259.description: The stem cell from which glial precursor cell arises from.

CL:0002261.label: endothelial cell of viscerocranial mucosa
CL:0002261.description: An endothelial cell found in the mucosa associated with the facial skeleton.

CL:0002262.label: endothelial cell of sinusoid
CL:0002262.description: An endothelial cell that lines any of the venous cavities through which blood passes in various glands and organs such as the spleen and liver.

CL:0002263.label: transitional cell of parathyroid gland
CL:0002263.description: One of three types of epithelial cells that populate the parathyroid gland; cytological characteristics intermediate between those of the chief cell and of the oxyphil cell. Because only one hormone is produced, the three cell forms are widely believed to be different phases in the life cycle of a single cell type, with the chief cell being its physiologically active stage.

CL:0002264.label: type A cell of stomach
CL:0002264.description: A type of enteroendocrine cell found in the stomach that secretes glucagon.

CL:1001517.label: stomach enteroendocrine cell
CL:1001517.description: The various hormone- or neurotransmitter-secreting cells present throughout the mucosa of the stomach.

CL:0002265.label: type D cell of colon
CL:0002265.description: A D cell located in the colon.

CL:0009042.label: enteroendocrine cell of colon
CL:0009042.description: An enteroendocrine cell that is located in the colon.

CL:1001588.label: colon glandular cell
CL:1001588.description: Glandular cell of colon epithelium. Example: Goblet cells; enterocytes or absorptive cells; enteroendocrine and M cells.
