CL:0002266.label: type D cell of small intestine
CL:0002266.description: A type D cell of the small intestine.

CL:0009006.label: enteroendocrine cell of small intestine
CL:0009006.description: An enteroendocrine cell that is located in the small intestine.

CL:0002267.label: type D cell of stomach
CL:0002267.description: A type D cell found in the stomach.

CL:1000222.label: stomach neuroendocrine cell
CL:1000222.description: A specialised neuroendocrine cell located in the gastric mucosa that regulates digestive processes including acid secretion and gut motility. This cell stores hormones in large dense core vesicles and synaptic-like microvesicles.

CL:0002268.label: P/D1 enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002268.description: An enteroendocrine cell that stores and secretes Ghrelin.

CL:0002269.label: vasoactive intestinal peptide secreting cell
CL:0002269.description: An endocrine cell that secretes vasoactive intestinal peptide.

CL:0002270.label: type EC2 enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002270.description: A type EC enteroendocrine cell in the duodenum and jejunum that stores and secretes motilin and 5-hydroxytryptamine.

CL:0002272.label: motilin secreting cell
CL:0002272.description: A cell that secretes motilin, a gastric hormone that at low pH inhibits gastric motor activity, whereas at high pH has a stimulating effect.

CL:1001516.label: intestinal enteroendocrine cell
CL:1001516.description: The various hormone- or neurotransmitter-secreting cells present throughout the mucosa of the intestinal tract.

CL:0002271.label: type EC1 enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002271.description: A type EC enteredocrine cell in the intestines that stores and secretes substance P and 5-hydroxytryptamine.

CL:0002273.label: type ECL enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002273.description: A type EC enteroendocrine cell type that is numerous in the fundus of the stomach; stores 5-hydroxytryptamine and histamine.

CL:0002275.label: pancreatic PP cell
CL:0002275.description: A PP cell located in the islets of the pancreas.

CL:0002276.label: obsolete PP cell of pancreatic acinus
CL:0002276.description: OBSOLETE: A PP cell located in the pancreatic acinus. Obsoleted due to a lack of published evidence that this cell type is actually found in the pancreatic acinus.
synonyms: type F cell of pancreatic acinus

CL:0002277.label: type I enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002277.description: An enteroendocrine cell commonest in the duodenum and jejunum, rare in ileum, that secretes cholecystokinin. This cell type is involved in the regulation of digestive enzymes and bile.

CL:0002278.label: GIP cell
CL:0002278.description: An enteroendocrine cell of duodenum and jejunum that produces gastric inhibitory peptide.

CL:0002279.label: type L enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002279.description: A enteroendocrine cell type that is numerous in ileum, present in jejunum and large intestine, few in duodenum. This cell type produces glucagon-like immunoreactants (glicentin, glucagon-37, glucagon-29, GLP-1 and -2) and PYY.

CL:0002280.label: type N enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002280.description: An enteroendocrine cell found in the ileum and jejunum that produces neurotensin.

CL:0002281.label: type S enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002281.description: Scattered in duodenojejunal mucosa, this enteroendocrine cell secretes secretin and serotonin.

CL:0002282.label: type TG enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002282.description: An enteroendocrine cell which produces a gastrin- and cholecystokinin-like peptide. The apical microvilli-rich plasma membrane is in open contact with the small intestine mucosa. This cell type is devoid of gastrin-17 but contains other fragments of the gastrin polypeptide.

CL:0002283.label: ecto-epithelial cell of viscerocranial mucosa
CL:0002283.description: An epithelial cell of the mucosa associated with facial skeleton.

CL:0002284.label: type X enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002284.description: An enteroendocrine cell found in the fundus and pylorus; this cell type has dense round secretory granules that contain ghrelin.

CL:0005018.label: ghrelin secreting cell
CL:0005018.description: A cell that secretes ghrelin, the peptide hormone that stimulates hunger.

CL:0002285.label: type III taste bud cell
CL:0002285.description: A taste receptor cell that is characterized by morphologically identifiable synaptic contacts with the gustatory nerve fibers and expression of the synaptic membrane protein-25 (SNAP-25) and NCAM.

CL:0002286.label: type II taste cell
CL:0002286.description: A taste receptor cell that has a short microvilli, a projecting apical region, a large rounded nucleus, and expresses taste chemoreceptors thus making them the transducing cell for taste qualities.

CL:0002287.label: type IV taste receptor cell
CL:0002287.description: A rounded, mitotically active stem cell which is the source of new cells of the taste bud; located basally.

CL:0002288.label: type V taste receptor cell
CL:0002288.description: A cell type that forms the boundary with the surrounding epithelium.

CL:0002289.label: type I taste bud cell
CL:0002289.description: A densely staining taste receptor cell that contains many dense vacuoles in their apical regions which project into the apical space and bear microvilli. This cell type serves as a supporting cell by surrounding and isolating the other cell types from each other; secrete a dense amorphous material that surrounds the microvilli in the taste pore. This cell type expresses a glial glutumate transporter, GLAST.

CL:0002290.label: Y chromosome-bearing sperm cell
CL:0002290.description: A sperm bearing a Y chromosome. Chromosomal and genetic sex is established at fertilization in mammals and depends upon whether an X-bearing sperm or a Y-bearing sperm fertilizes the X-bearing ovum.

CL:0002291.label: X chromosome-bearing sperm cell
CL:0002291.description: A sperm bearing an X chromosome. Chromosomal and genetic sex is established at fertilization in mammals and depends upon whether an X-bearing sperm or a Y-bearing sperm fertilizes the X-bearing ovum.

CL:0002292.label: type I cell of carotid body
CL:0002292.description: A round or oval neuroepithelial cell that contacts other type I cells or capillaries. They occur in clusters that are surrounded by sheath cells (type-II cells) in the carotid body. This cell type is capable of secreting a number of neurotransmitters.

CL:0002293.label: epithelial cell of thymus
CL:0002293.description: An epithelial cell of the thymus. Epithelial reticular cells are pleomorphic, stellate, non-phagocytic cells which seem to be supportive in function and are held together by desmosomes. They replace the fibroblastoid reticular cells found in other lymphoid organs. Other epithelial cells in the medulla have the ultrastructure of secretory cells. Although different epithelial cells throughout the thymus appear alike by light microscopy their ultrastructure and function varies.

CL:0002294.label: type-1 epithelial cell of thymus
CL:0002294.description: An epithelial cell with a well defined Golgi apparatus that makes up the continuous layer of cells bordering the thymic tissue beneath the capsule.

CL:0002364.label: cortical thymic epithelial cell
CL:0002364.description: An epithelial cell of the cortical portion of the thymus. Epithelial cells in this region are required for positive selection of CD8-positive T cells.

CL:0002295.label: type-6 epithelial cell of thymus
CL:0002295.description: A thymic epithelial cell that has an eccentric, round, or irregularly shaped hetero or euchromatic nucleus. The hallmark of this cell type is the presence of vacuoles, which are clustered in one area of the cytoplasm in the vicinity of the nucleus. The vacuoles are small and acquire a grape-like form, occasionally showing delicate internal microvillous projections.

CL:0002365.label: medullary thymic epithelial cell
CL:0002365.description: An epithelial cell of the medullary thymus. This cell type expresses a diverse range of tissue-specific antigens. This promiscuous gene expression is a cell-autonomous property of medullary epithelial cells and is maintained during the entire period of thymic T cell output.

CL:0002296.label: type-4 epithelial cell of thymus
CL:0002296.description: An epithelial cell with high nuclear and cytoplasmic electron-density. This cell type is found in the deeper portions of the cortex but is more abundant in the medulla of the thymus.

CL:0002297.label: type-3 epithelial cell of thymus
CL:0002297.description: A thymic epithelial cell with moderate nuclear and cytoplasmic electron-density. Scattered in the cortex, this cell type is predominant in the mid and deep cortex.

CL:0002298.label: type-5 epithelial cell of thymus
CL:0002298.description: A thymic epithelial cell type with low nuclear and cytoplasmic electrondensity; has a round, euchromatic nucleus and occurs in small groups at the corticomedullary junction or scattered singly in the medulla.

CL:0002299.label: type-2 epithelial cell of thymus
CL:0002299.description: An epithelial cell scattered in the cortex, predominant in the outer cortex with a large pale nucleus and a prominent nucleolus.

CL:0002300.label: type-7 epithelial cell of thymus
CL:0002300.description: A small medullary thymic epithelial cell with a spindle shape, often arranged in groups and connected to each other by large desmosomes and interdigitations. The cytoplasm is sparse, with scanty organelles and thick bundles of cytokeratin.
synonyms: spindle shaped medullary thymic epithelial cell

CL:0002301.label: type B synovial cell
CL:0002301.description: A resident stromal cell located in the synovial membrane and responsible for the production of immune-related cytokines and chemokines. This cell type secretes glycoproteins and hyaluronic acid, has abundant granular endoplasmic reticulum, but contains fewer vacuoles and vesicles.

CL:0002302.label: type A synovial cell
CL:0002302.description: A synovial cell that is macrophage-like, characterized by surface ruffles or lamellipodia, plasma membrane invaginations and associated micropinocytotic vesicles, Golgi apparatus and little granular endoplasmic reticulum.

CL:0002303.label: pigmented ciliary epithelial cell
CL:0002303.description: A cell that is part of pigmented ciliary epithelium. This cell type uptakes sodium and chloride ions from stromal interstitium and passes the ions to non-pigmented ciliary epithelial cells via gap junctions.

CL:0002304.label: non-pigmented ciliary epithelial cell
CL:0002304.description: A cell that is part of non-pigmented ciliary epithelium. This cell type participates in aqueous humor formation by releasing solute, principally sodium and chloride ions received from pigmented epithelial cells via gap junctions, into the aqueous humor of the eye.

CL:0002305.label: epithelial cell of distal tubule
CL:0002305.description: An epithelial cell of the distal convoluted tubule of the kidney that helps regulate systemic levels of potassium, sodium, calcium, and pH.

CL:1000494.label: nephron tubule epithelial cell
CL:1000494.description: An epithelial cell that is part of a nephron tubule.

CL:1000615.label: kidney cortex tubule cell
CL:1000615.description: Any kidney tubule cell that is part of some renal cortex tubule.

CL:0002306.label: epithelial cell of proximal tubule
CL:0002306.description: An epithelial cell of the proximal tubule of the kidney.

CL:0002307.label: brush border cell of the proximal tubule
CL:0002307.description: A brush border epithelial cell located in the proximal tubule of the kidney, essential for reabsorbing substances like glucose and amino acids from the glomerular filtrate. These cells also secrete organic ions, playing a crucial role in maintaining kidney homeostasis, including electrolyte and acid-base balance, and excreting metabolic waste.

CL:0002309.label: corticotroph
CL:0002309.description: A basophil chromphil cell of the anterior pitiutary gland that produce adrenocorticotropic hormone, melanocyte-stimulating hormone and lipotropin. This cell type is irregular in shape and has short dendritic processes which are inserted among other neighboring cells;

CL:0002310.label: mammosomatotroph
CL:0002310.description: An acidophil cell of the anterior pituitary gland that produces both prolactin and growth hormone.

CL:0002311.label: mammotroph
CL:0002311.description: An acidophilic cell of the anterior pituitary that produces prolactin.

CL:0002312.label: somatotroph
CL:0002312.description: An acidophilic cell of the anterior pituitary that produces growth hormone, somatotropin.

CL:0002313.label: endocrine-paracrine cell of prostate gland
CL:0002313.description: An ecto-epithelial cell of the prostate gland that secretes hormones.

CL:0002314.label: external supporting cell of vestibular epithelium
CL:0002314.description: An auditory epithelial support cell located in the vestibular epithelium that has many hallmarks of glial cells. This cell type express glial markers such as vimentin, S100, glutamate-aspartate transporter, low affinity neurotrophin receptor p75, glial fibrillary acidic protein, and proteolipid protein.

CL:0002316.label: supporting cell of vestibular epithelium
CL:0002316.description: A supporting cell of the vestibular epithelium.

CL:0005014.label: auditory epithelial supporting cell
CL:0005014.description: A non-sensory cell that extends from the basement membrane to the apical surface of the auditory epithelium and provides support for auditory hair cells.

CL:0002317.label: external limiting cell of vestibular epithelium
CL:0002317.description: An external limiting cell found in the vestibular epithelium.

CL:0002318.label: peripheral blood mesothelial cell
CL:0002318.description: A mesothelial cell capable of circulating in the blood by first losing its squamous character. This cell can incorporate into the regenerating mesothelium.

CL:0002322.label: embryonic stem cell
CL:0002322.description: A stem cell of embryonic origin.

CL:0002323.label: amniocyte
CL:0002323.description: A cell of a fetus which is suspended in the amniotic fluid. Amniocytes are considered to arise from several tissues including fetal skin, the fetal urinary tract, umbilical cord, and the inner amniotic surface.

CL:0002324.label: basal-myoepithelial cell of mammary gland
CL:0002324.description: A myoepithelial cell that is part of a mammary gland and is located in the basal layer. During lactation, a basal-myoepithelial cell of mammary gland contracts under the stimulation of oxytocin. In humans, a basal-myoepithelial cell of mammary gland can be identified by high levels of CD49f and low levels of EpCAM.

CL:0002327.label: mammary gland epithelial cell
CL:0002327.description: An epithelial cell of the mammary gland.

CL:1001586.label: mammary gland glandular cell
CL:1001586.description: Glandular cell of mammary epithelium. Example: glandular cells of large and intermediate ducts, glandular cells in terminal ducts.

CL:4033057.label: luminal adaptive secretory precursor cell of mammary gland
CL:4033057.description: A luminal epithelial cell of the mammary gland that can proliferate and has the potential to differentiate into a lactocyte during pregnancy. In humans, a luminal adaptive secretory precursor cell can be identified by high levels of the markers EpCAM and CD49f, and in mice it can be identified by low levels of CD29 and high levels of CD14, Kit, CD61, and Tspan8.

CL:0002326.label: luminal epithelial cell of mammary gland
CL:0002326.description: A mammary epithelial cell that occurs in the lumen of the ductal and alveoli structure in the breast.

CL:0009116.label: progenitor cell of mammary luminal epithelium
CL:0009116.description: A progenitor cell with the potential to differentiate into luminal epithelial cells of mammary glands. In mouse, CD61 and c-kit were found to be coexpressed by the majority of, but not all, committed luminal progenitor cells.
synonyms: progenitor cell of luminal mammary epithelium

CL:0002329.label: basal epithelial cell of tracheobronchial tree
CL:0002329.description: An epithelial cell type that lacks the columnar shape typical for other respiratory epithelial cells. This cell type is able to differentiate into other respiratory epithelial cells in response to injury.

CL:0002330.label: undifferentiated cell of bronchus epithelium
CL:0002330.description: An undifferentiated columnar cell of the bronchus epithelium

CL:1000349.label: basal cell of epithelium of bronchus
CL:1000349.description: A basal cell found in the bronchus epithelium.

CL:0002332.label: multiciliated epithelial cell of the bronchus
CL:0002332.description: A multi-ciliated epithelial cell located in the bronchus epithelium, characterized by a columnar shape and motile cilia on its apical surface.
synonyms: ciliated epithelial cell of the bronchus

CL:0002333.label: neural crest derived adipocyte
CL:0002333.description: An adipocyte derived from a neural crest cell.

CL:0002337.label: keratinocyte stem cell
CL:0002337.description: A stem cell found in the basal layer of the epidermis, hair follicle, and sebaceous gland, characterised by its quiescent nature, high proliferative potential, and capacity for long-term self-renewal. This cell maintains epidermal homeostasis by producing transit-amplifying cells that differentiate to replenish the stratified squamous epithelium.

CL:0002338.label: CD56-positive, CD161-positive immature natural killer cell, human
CL:0002338.description: A natural killer cell that is developmentally immature, has the phenotype CD34-negative, CD56-positive, CD117-positive, CD122-positive,and CD161-positive.

CL:0002344.label: CD56-negative, CD161-positive immature natural killer cell, human
CL:0002344.description: A natural killer cell that is developmentally immature, has the phenotype CD34-negative, CD56-negative, CD117-positive, CD122-positive,and CD161-positive.

CL:0002339.label: prostate stem cell
CL:0002339.description: A prostate epithelial cell that is CD133-positive, CD44-positive, integrin A2beta3-high. This cell is a stem cell for the prostate epithelium.

CL:0002342.label: circulating endothelial cell
CL:0002342.description: A circulating endothelial cell of the phenotype CD146-positive, CD105-positive, CD45-negative. This cell type is indicative of recent vascular damage.

CL:0002343.label: decidual natural killer cell, human
CL:0002343.description: A natural killer cell subset that is found in the decidual of the uterus and is CD56-high, Galectin-1-positive and CD16-negative. This cell type represents the most abundant immune cell type in the decidual during the first trimester of pregnancy.

CL:4052028.label: uterine natural killer cell
CL:4052028.description: A natural killer cell that is part of the uterus, specifically within the endometrium during the non-pregnant state and in the decidua during pregnancy. This cell exhibits dynamic changes in frequency throughout the menstrual cycle, with lower levels during menstruation and a significant increase during the mid-secretory phase and early pregnancy.

CL:0002345.label: CD27-low, CD11b-low immature natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002345.description: An immature natural killer cell that is NK1.1-positive, DX5-positive, Ly49-positive, CD27-low and CD11b-low. This cell type is found in high numbers in the liver.

CL:0002346.label: Dx5-negative, NK1.1-positive immature natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002346.description: An immature natural killer cell that is NK1.1-positive and DX-5 negative.

CL:0002347.label: CD27-high, CD11b-high natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002347.description: A mature natural killer cell that is CD27-high and CD11b-high. This cell type is capable of interferon-gamma secretion.

CL:0002349.label: CD27-high, CD11b-low natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002349.description: A natural killer cell that is CD27-high and CD11b-low.

CL:0002348.label: CD27-low, CD11b-high natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002348.description: A CD27-low, CD11b-high natural killer cell that has a higher threshold of activation due to higher expression of inhibitory receptors.

CL:0002350.label: endocardial cell
CL:0002350.description: An endothelial cell that lines the intracavitary lumen of the heart, separating the circulating blood from the underlying myocardium. This cell type releases a number of vasoactive substances including prostacyclin, nitrous oxide and endothelin.

CL:0010008.label: cardiac endothelial cell
CL:0010008.description: Any endothelial cell that is part of some heart.

CL:0002352.label: gestational hematopoietic stem cell
CL:0002352.description: A hematopoietic stem cell that exists during embryogenesis.

CL:0002353.label: fetal liver hematopoietic progenitor cell
CL:0002353.description: A hematopoietic stem cell that resides in the fetal liver. In mice, this cell type is first observed at E10.5. This cell type is MHC-positive, HSA-positive, AA4.1-positive, CD45-positive, Sca-1 positive, CD150-positive, CD48-negative and CD244-negative.

CL:0002354.label: yolk sac hematopoietic stem cell
CL:0002354.description: A hematopoietic stem found in the yolk sac. In mice, this cell type is Sca-1-negative, CD45-negative, MHC-negative, HSA-positive, AA4.1-positive, CD44-positive.

CL:0002355.label: primitive red blood cell
CL:0002355.description: A large nucleated basophilic erythrocyte found in mammalian embryos. This cell type arises from the blood islands of yolk sacs and expresses different types of hemoglobins (beta-H1, gamma-1 and zeta) than adult erythrocytes. Considered a type of erythroblast as this cell type can enucleate in circulation.

CL:0002417.label: primitive erythroid lineage cell
CL:0002417.description: An immature or mature cell of the first erythroid lineage to arise during embryonic development.

CL:0002361.label: primitive erythroid progenitor
CL:0002361.description: A progenitor cell that is capable of forming colonies of primitive erythrocytes in the blood island of the yolk sac. First arrive at E7.5 in mouse and expresses CD41.

CL:0002356.label: primitive reticulocyte
CL:0002356.description: A primitive erythrocyte that has undergone enucleation. This cell type is 3-6 fold bigger than the fetal derived erythrocytes that they co-circulate with during fetal development. Expresses epsilon-gamma hemoglobin chains.

CL:0002357.label: fetal derived definitive erythrocyte
CL:0002357.description: A fetal liver derived enucleated erythrocyte. This erythrocyte resembles adult erythrocytes in that they are small (3- to 6- times smaller than primitive erythrocytes) and produce adult hemaglobins.

CL:0002358.label: pyrenocyte
CL:0002358.description: Derived from the Greek word pyren (the pit of a stone fruit), this is a transient nucleated cell type that results from exclusion of the nucleus from the primitive erythrocyte.

CL:0002359.label: placental hematopoietic stem cell
CL:0002359.description: A hematopoietic stem cell of the placenta. This cell type is first observed E10.5 This cell type may give rise to fetal liver hematopoietic stem cells.

CL:0002360.label: AGM hematopoietic stem cell
CL:0002360.description: A hematopoietic stem cell from the aorta-gonad-mesonephros region of the developing embryo. First seen at E10.5 in mouse embryos. May give rise to fetal liver HSC.

CL:0002418.label: hemangioblast
CL:0002418.description: A pluripotent cell in the yolk sac that can give rise to mesenchymal cells including erythrocytes and endothelial cells.

CL:0002363.label: keratocyte
CL:0002363.description: A keratocyte is a specialized fibroblast residing in the cornea stroma that has a flattened, dendritic morphology; located between the lamellae with a large flattened nucleus, and lengthy processes which communicate with neighboring cells. This corneal layer, representing about 85-90% of corneal thickness, is built up from highly regular collagenous lamellae and extracellular matrix components. Keratocytes play the major role in keeping it transparent, healing its wounds, and synthesizing its components. This cell type secretes collagen I, V, VI, and keratan sulfate.

CL:0002366.label: myometrial cell
CL:0002366.description: A smooth muscle cell of the myometrium that enlarges and stretches during pregnancy, and contracts in response to oxytocin.

CL:0002601.label: uterine smooth muscle cell
CL:0002601.description: A smooth muscle cell of the uterus.

CL:0002367.label: trabecular meshwork cell
CL:0002367.description: A cell that lines the trabecular meshwork, which is an area of tissue in the eye located around the base of the cornea, near the ciliary body, and is responsible for draining the aqueous humor from the eye via the anterior chamber (the chamber on the front of the eye covered by the cornea). This cell may play a role in regulating intraocular pressure.

CL:0002368.label: respiratory tract epithelial cell
CL:0002368.description: An epithelial cell of the respiratory tract epithelium.  These cells have an endodermal origin.

CL:0002370.label: respiratory tract goblet cell
CL:0002370.description: A simple columnar epithelial cell that secretes mucin. Rough endoplasmic reticulum, mitochondria, the nucleus, and other organelles are concentrated in the basal portion. The apical plasma membrane projects microvilli to increase surface area for secretion.

CL:0002371.label: obsolete somatic cell
CL:0002371.description: OBSOLETE. A cell of an organism that does not pass on its genetic material to the organism's offspring (i.e. a non-germ line cell).

CL:0002373.label: growth hormone releasing hormone secreting cell
CL:0002373.description: A peptide hormone secreting cell that secretes growth hormone releasing hormone.

CL:0002375.label: Schwann cell precursor
CL:0002375.description: A multipotent progenitor cell that develops from a migratory neural crest cell. The schwann cell precursor is embedded among axons, with minimal extracellular space separating them from nerve cell membranes. This cell lacks a basal lamina, which distinguishes it from more mature Schwann cells. In rodents, cadherin-19 (Cdh19) serves as a specific marker for this developmental stage.

CL:0002378.label: immature Vgamma2-positive fetal thymocyte
CL:0002378.description: A double negative thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing a Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive and is found in the fetal thymus.

CL:0002379.label: meningothelial cell
CL:0002379.description: A neurecto-epithelial cell found in the arachnoid villi of dura mater. This cell type facilitates flow of cerebrospinal fluid into the blood.

CL:0002380.label: oospore
CL:0002380.description: An asexual spore formed by Oomycetes; formed upon fertilization of an oosphere.

CL:0002382.label: multinucleate conidium
CL:0002382.description: A conidium that has more than one nucleus.

CL:0002383.label: conidium of conidiophore head
CL:0002383.description: A uninucleate spore formed on specialized cells or projections, sterigma, of a conidiophore head.

CL:0002384.label: uninucleate macroconidium
CL:0002384.description: A macroconidium that has only one nucleus.

CL:0002385.label: blastoconidium
CL:0002385.description: An oblong or round asexual spore formed from conidial chains.

CL:0002386.label: multinucleate macroconidium
CL:0002386.description: A macroconidium that has more than one nucleus.

CL:0002387.label: arthroconidium
CL:0002387.description: Cylindrical spore formed by development and compartmentation of hyphae; the hyphae are often supporting blastoconidiophores.

CL:0002388.label: multinucleate arthroconidium
CL:0002388.description: An arthroconidium that has more than one nucleus.

CL:0002389.label: uninucleate arthroconidium
CL:0002389.description: An arthroconidium that has only one nucleus.

CL:0002390.label: uninucleate blastconidium
CL:0002390.description: A blastoconidium that has only one nucleus.

CL:0002391.label: multinucleate blastoconidium
CL:0002391.description: A blastoconidium that has more than one nucleus.

CL:0002392.label: obsolete plant spore
CL:0002392.description: Obsolete. Use PO:0025017 from Plant Ontology instead. A plant cell that arises through meiosis and develops into a gametophyte.

CL:0002394.label: CD141-positive myeloid dendritic cell
CL:0002394.description: A myeloid dendritic cell found in the blood, lymph nodes, tonsil, bone marrow, and spleen that is CD141-positive (BDCA-3), XCR1-positive, and Clec9A-positive. This cell-type can cross-present antigen to CD8-positive T cells and can produce inteferon-beta.

CL:0002395.label: Gr1-high classical monocyte
CL:0002395.description: A resident monocyte that is Gr-1 high, CD43-negative, CX3CR1-negative, CD115-positive, and B220-negative.

CL:0002396.label: CD14-low, CD16-positive monocyte
CL:0002396.description: A patrolling monocyte that is CD14-low and CD16-positive.

CL:0002399.label: CD1c-positive myeloid dendritic cell
CL:0002399.description: A myeloid dendritic cell that is CD1c-positive.

CL:0002402.label: Peyer's patch B cell
CL:0002402.description: A resting mature B cell within the Peyer's patch that is CD19-positive, B220-positive, IgM-positive, AA4-negative, CD23-positive, CD43-negative, and CD5-negative.

CL:0009014.label: Peyer's patch lymphocyte
CL:0009014.description: A lymphocyte that is part of a Peyer's patch. These cells have a major role in driving the immune response to antigens sampled from the intestinal lumen, and in regulating the formation of follicle-associated epithelium and M cells in Peyer's patches by converting intestitial enterocytes into M cells.

CL:0002403.label: mature Vgamma2-positive fetal thymocyte
CL:0002403.description: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative. This cell-type is found in the fetal thymus.

CL:0002405.label: gamma-delta thymocyte
CL:0002405.description: A post-natal thymocyte expressing components of the gamma-delta T cell receptor. This cell type is always double-negative (i.e. CD4-negative, CD8-negative).

CL:0002406.label: immature Vgamma2-positive thymocyte
CL:0002406.description: A double negative post-natal thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing a Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive.

CL:0002407.label: mature Vgamma2-positive thymocyte
CL:0002407.description: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative.

CL:0002408.label: immature Vgamma2-negative thymocyte
CL:0002408.description: A double negative post-natal thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain that does not contain a Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive.

CL:0002409.label: mature Vgamma2-negative thymocyte
CL:0002409.description: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain that does not contain the Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative.

CL:0002410.label: pancreatic stellate cell
CL:0002410.description: A cell that is found in the periacinar space of the exocrine pancreas and in perivascular and periductal regions of the pancreas, and has long cytoplasmic processes that encircle the base of the acinus. Expresses several intermediate filament proteins including vimentin and nestin. Shares many of the characteristics of hepatatic stellate cells, but not stellate cells of the central nervous system. Upon activation, this cell type undergoes morphological and gene expression changes that make the cell suggestive of being a type of myofibroblast.

CL:0002574.label: stromal cell of pancreas
CL:0002574.description: A stromal cell of the pancreas.

CL:0002411.label: Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte
CL:0002411.description: A gamma-delta receptor that expresses Vgamma1.1 but does not express Vdelta6.3 chains in the T-cell receptor.

CL:0002412.label: Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte
CL:0002412.description: A gamma-delta receptor that expresses Vgamma1.1-Vdelta6.3 chains in the T-cell receptor.

CL:0002413.label: mature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte
CL:0002413.description: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte that is CD24-negative.

CL:0002414.label: immature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte
CL:0002414.description: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte that is CD24-positive.

CL:0002415.label: immature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte
CL:0002415.description: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte that is CD24-positive.

CL:0002416.label: mature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte
CL:0002416.description: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte that is CD24-negative.

CL:0002423.label: DN2a thymocyte
CL:0002423.description: A DN2 thymocyte that is Kit-hi.

CL:0002424.label: DN2b thymocyte
CL:0002424.description: A DN2 thymocyte that is Kit-low.

CL:0002426.label: CD11b-positive, CD27-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002426.description: A mature natural killer cell that is CD11b-positive and CD27-positive.

CL:0002438.label: NK1.1-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002438.description: A mature NK cell that is NK1.1-positive.

CL:0002427.label: resting double-positive thymocyte
CL:0002427.description: A double-positive, alpha-beta thymocyte that is small and not proliferating.

CL:0002428.label: double-positive blast
CL:0002428.description: A double-positive thymocyte that is large (i.e. has a high forward scatter signal in flow cytometry) and is actively proliferating.

CL:0002429.label: CD69-positive double-positive thymocyte
CL:0002429.description: A double-positive thymocyte that is CD69-positive and has begun positive selection.

CL:0002430.label: CD4-intermediate, CD8-positive double-positive thymocyte
CL:0002430.description: A double-positive thymocyte that is undergoing positive selection, has high expression of the alpha-beta T cell receptor, is CD69-positive, and is in the process of down regulating the CD4 co-receptor.

CL:0002431.label: CD4-positive, CD8-intermediate double-positive thymocyte
CL:0002431.description: A double-positive thymocyte that is undergoing positive selection, has high expression of the alpha-beta T cell receptor, is CD69-positive, and is in the process of down regulating the CD8 co-receptor.

CL:0002432.label: CD24-positive, CD4 single-positive thymocyte
CL:0002432.description: A CD4-positive, CD8-negative thymocyte that is CD24-positive and expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor.

CL:0002433.label: CD69-positive, CD4-positive single-positive thymocyte
CL:0002433.description: A CD4-positive, CD8-negative thymocyte that expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor and is CD69-positive.

CL:0002434.label: CD24-positive, CD8 single-positive thymocyte
CL:0002434.description: A CD8-positive, CD4-negative thymocyte that is CD24-positive and expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor.

CL:0002435.label: CD69-positive, CD8-positive single-positive thymocyte
CL:0002435.description: A CD8-positive, CD4-negative thymocyte that expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor and is CD69-positive.

CL:0002439.label: NKGA2-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002439.description: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is NKGA2-positive.

CL:0002440.label: Ly49D-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002440.description: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49D-positive.

CL:0002441.label: CD94-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002441.description: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-positive.

CL:0002442.label: CD94-negative, Ly49CI-negative natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002442.description: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-negative and Ly49Cl-negative.

CL:0002443.label: Ly49CI-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002443.description: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49Cl-positive.

CL:0002444.label: Ly49H-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002444.description: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49H-positive.

CL:0002445.label: Ly49D-negative natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002445.description: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49D-negative.

CL:0002446.label: Ly49CI-negative natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002446.description: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49Cl-negative.

CL:0002447.label: CD94-negative natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002447.description: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-negative.

CL:0002448.label: Ly49H-negative natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002448.description: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49H-negative.

CL:0002449.label: CD94-positive Ly49CI-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002449.description: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-positive and Ly49Cl-positive.

CL:0002450.label: tether cell
CL:0002450.description: A specialized hair cell that has an elongated kinocilium upon which an otolith accretes. The tether cell then anchors the otolith in place.

CL:0002451.label: mammary stem cell
CL:0002451.description: A multi-fate stem cell that is the source of cells for growth of the mammary gland during puberty and gestation. This cell type gives rise to both the luminal and myoepithelial cell types of the gland, and have been shown to have the ability to regenerate the entire organ in mice. This cell type also plays an important role in carcinogenesis of the breast. This cell type is Lin-, CD24-positive, CD29-hi.

CL:4023059.label: committed oligodendrocyte precursor
CL:4023059.description: An oligodendrocyte precursor cell that is committed to differentiate.

CL:0002454.label: CD4-negative, CD8-alpha-negative, CD11b-positive dendritic cell
CL:0002454.description: CD4-negative, CD8-alpha-negative, CD11b-positive dendritic cell is a conventional dendritic cell that is CD11b-positive, CD4-negative, CD8-alpha-negative and is CD205-positive.

CL:0002455.label: CD8-alpha-negative plasmacytoid dendritic cell
CL:0002455.description: A CD11c-low plasmacytoid dendritic cell that is CD8-alpha-negative and CD4-positive.

CL:0002456.label: CD8-alpha-positive plasmacytoid dendritic cell
CL:0002456.description: A CD11c-low plasmacytoid dendritic cell that is CD8-alpha-positive and CD4-positive.

CL:0002457.label: epidermal Langerhans cell
CL:0002457.description: A Langerhans cell that is in the epidermis and is CD45-positive, MHCII-positive, and CD11b-positive.

CL:0002458.label: langerin-positive dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002458.description: A dermal dendritic cell that is langerin-positive and CD103-positive.

CL:0002461.label: CD103-positive dendritic cell
CL:0002461.description: A conventional dendritic cell that is CD103-positive. This cell type is usually found in non-lymphoid tissue.

CL:0002459.label: langerin-negative dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002459.description: A dermal dendritic cell that is langerin-negative, CD103-negative, and CD11b-positive.

CL:0002460.label: CD8-alpha-negative thymic conventional dendritic cell
CL:0002460.description: A conventional thymic dendritic cell that is CD8-alpha-negative.

CL:0002462.label: adipose dendritic cell
CL:0002462.description: A F4/80-negative dendritic cell located in adipose tissue.

CL:0002463.label: SIRPa-positive adipose dendritic cell
CL:0002463.description: An adipose dendritic cell that is SIRPa-positive.

CL:0002464.label: SIRPa-negative adipose dendritic cell
CL:0002464.description: An adipose dendritic cell that is SIRPa-negative.

CL:0002466.label: small intestine serosal dendritic cell
CL:0002466.description: A CD11b-positive dendritic cell located in the serosal portion of the small intestine epithelium. This cell type is CD45-positive, MHC-II-positive, CD11c-low, CD103-negative.

CL:0002467.label: Gr1-high myeloid suppressor cell
CL:0002467.description: A myeloid suppressor cell that is Gr1-high and CD11c-negative.

CL:0002468.label: Gr1-low myeloid suppressor cell
CL:0002468.description: A myeloid suppressor cell that is Gr1-low and CD11c-positive.

CL:0002469.label: MHC-II-negative classical monocyte
CL:0002469.description: Gr1-high monocyte that lacks MHC-II receptor complex.

CL:0002470.label: MHC-II-positive classical monocyte
CL:0002470.description: Gr1-high monocyte that has a MHC-II receptor complex.

CL:0002471.label: MHC-II-negative non-classical monocyte
CL:0002471.description: Gr1-low non-classical monocyte that lacks expression of a MHC-II complex.

CL:0002472.label: MHC-II-low non-classical monocyte
CL:0002472.description: Gr1-low non-classical monocyte that has low to intermediate expression of the MHC-II complex.

CL:0002473.label: MHC-II-high non-classical monocyte
CL:0002473.description: Gr1-low non-classical monocyte that has high surface expression of a MHC-II complex.

CL:0002474.label: lymphoid MHC-II-negative classical monocyte
CL:0002474.description: A MHC-II-negative classical monocyte located in lymphoid tissue that is F4/80-positive, CD11c-negative, and CD11b-high.

CL:0002475.label: lymphoid MHC-II-negative non-classical monocyte
CL:0002475.description: A MHC-II-negative classical monocyte located in lymphoid tissue that is F4/80-positive, CD11c-intermediate, and CD11b-high.

CL:0002476.label: bone marrow macrophage
CL:0002476.description: A tissue-resident macrophage located in the bone marrow. This cell type is B220-negative, CD3e-negative, Ly-6C-negative, CD115-positive, F4/80-positive.

CL:0010004.label: mononuclear cell of bone marrow
CL:0010004.description: A mononuclear cell that is part_of a bone marrow.

CL:0002477.label: adipose macrophage
CL:0002477.description: A macrophage located in adipose tissue that is CD45-positive, CD11c-positive, and SIRPa-positive.

CL:0002478.label: F4/80-negative adipose macrophage
CL:0002478.description: An adipose macrophage that does not express F4/80but is MHC-II-positive. This cell type exhibits autofluorescence under typical flow cyometry conditions.

CL:0002479.label: F4/80-positive adipose macrophage
CL:0002479.description: An adipose macrophage that does not express MHC-II but is F4/80-positive.

CL:0002480.label: nasal mucosa goblet cell
CL:0002480.description: A goblet cell located in the nasal epithelium.

CL:0002481.label: peritubular myoid cell
CL:0002481.description: The flattened smooth myoepithelial cells of mesodermal origin that lie just outside the basal lamina of the seminiferous tubule.

CL:0002482.label: dermal melanocyte
CL:0002482.description: A melanocyte that produces pigment in the dermis.

CL:1000458.label: melanocyte of skin
CL:1000458.description: A melanocyte that is part of the skin of body.

CL:0002483.label: hair follicle melanocyte
CL:0002483.description: A melanocyte that produces pigment within the hair follicle.

CL:0002559.label: hair follicle cell
CL:0002559.description: An animal cell that is part of a hair follicle.

CL:2000000.label: epidermal melanocyte
CL:2000000.description: Any melanocyte that is part of a epidermis.

CL:0002484.label: epithelial melanocyte
CL:0002484.description: A melanocyte that produces pigment in the epithelium.

CL:0002485.label: retinal melanocyte
CL:0002485.description: A melanocyte of the retina. This cell type is distinct from pigmented retinal epithelium.

CL:0002486.label: strial intermediate cell
CL:0002486.description: A melanocyte located between the epithelial marginal cell layer and the mesodermal basal cell layer within the intrastrial space; the predominant cellular component of the electrogenic machinery that generates an endocochlear potential (80-100 mV) .

CL:0002491.label: auditory epithelial cell
CL:0002491.description: A specialized cell involved in auditory sensory perception.

CL:0002487.label: cutaneous/subcutaneous mechanoreceptor cell
CL:0002487.description: A neuronal receptor that respond to mechanical pressure or distortion in the skin.

CL:0002488.label: trophoblast giant cell
CL:0002488.description: A trophoblast cell that has a large volume of cytoplasm, is polyploid and is usually mononuclear but is also occasionally multi-nucleate. This cell type is important in establishing maternal physiology and remodeling of the vasculature of the placenta.

CL:0002492.label: strial marginal cell
CL:0002492.description: A polarized columnar cell that covesr the lateral surface of the cochlear duct, secretes potassium ions and forms a continuous sheet in contact with the endolymph; marginal cells form extensive interdigitations with the basal and intermediate cells in the normal adult stria.

CL:0002493.label: strial basal cell
CL:0002493.description: A polarized cell that is juxtaposed to fibrocytes in the underlying spiral ligament. This cell type secretes potassium ions derived from fibrocytes through gap junctions.

CL:0002495.label: fetal cardiomyocyte
CL:0002495.description: A fetal and neonatal heart cell that undergoes proliferation and is not yet terminally differentiated into a binucleate or a multinucleate cardiac myocyte.

CL:0002497.label: primary trophoblast giant cell
CL:0002497.description: A trophoblast giant cell derived from the mural trophectoderm.

CL:0002498.label: secondary trophoblast giant cell
CL:0002498.description: A trophoblast giant cell that is derived from ectoplacental cone and, later in gestation, the spongiotrophoblast.

CL:0002499.label: spongiotrophoblast cell
CL:0002499.description: A trophoblast cell that arises in the junctional zone (basal plate) of the placenta.

CL:0002500.label: P enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002500.description: A P/D1 enteroendocrine cell that is Grimelius positive and stores bombesin-like polypeptide.

CL:0002501.label: type D1 enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002501.description: A P/D1 enteroendocrine cell that is argyrophilic and stores vasoactive intestinal polypeptide.

CL:0002502.label: type M enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002502.description: An enteroendocrine cell of the small intestine that secretes motilin.

CL:0002503.label: adventitial cell
CL:0002503.description: A cell of the adventitial layer of ductal structures such as the uterer, defent duct, biliary duct, etc

CL:0002504.label: enteric smooth muscle cell
CL:0002504.description: A smooth muscle cell of the intestine.

CL:0002505.label: liver CD103-negative dendritic cell
CL:0002505.description: A CD11b-positive dendritic cell that is CD11b-high, CD45-positive, MHC-II-positive and CD103-negative.

CL:0002506.label: liver CD103-positive dendritic cell
CL:0002506.description: A CD11b-positive dendritic cell that is CD11b-low, CD45-positive, MHC-II-high and CD103-positive that is located in the liver.

CL:0002507.label: langerin-positive lymph node dendritic cell
CL:0002507.description: A dermal dendritic cell isolated from skin draining lymph nodes that is langerin-positive, MHC-II-positive, and CD4-negative and CD8a-negative.

CL:0002508.label: langerin-negative, CD103-negative lymph node dendritic cell
CL:0002508.description: A dermal dendritic cell isolated from skin draining lymph nodes that is langerin-negative, MHC-II-positive, and CD4-negative and CD8a-negative.

CL:0002509.label: CD103-positive, langerin-positive lymph node dendritic cell
CL:0002509.description: A langerin-positive lymph node dendritic cell that is CD103-positive and CD11b-low.

CL:0002510.label: CD103-negative, langerin-positive lymph node dendritic cell
CL:0002510.description: A langerin-positive lymph node dendritic cell that is CD103-negative and CD11b-high.

CL:0002511.label: CD11b-low, CD103-negative, langerin-negative lymph node dendritic cell
CL:0002511.description: A langerin-negative lymph node dendritic cell that is CD103-negative and CD11b-low.

CL:0002512.label: CD11b-high, CD103-negative, langerin-negative lymph node dendritic cell
CL:0002512.description: A langerin-negative lymph node dendritic cell that is CD103-negative and CD11b-high.

CL:0002513.label: Vgamma5-positive CD8-alpha alpha positive gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell
CL:0002513.description: A CD8-alpha alpha positive gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell that expresses a TCR encoded in part by the Vgamma5 gene segment.

CL:0002514.label: Vgamma5-negative CD8-alpha alpha positive gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell
CL:0002514.description: A CD8-alpha alpha positive gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell that does not express a TCR partially encoded by the Vgamma5 gene segment.

CL:0002515.label: interrenal norepinephrine type cell
CL:0002515.description: An interrenal chromaffin cell found in teleosts that contain heterogeneous vesicles with electron-dense granules located asymmetrically within the vesicular membrane.

CL:0002516.label: interrenal chromaffin cell
CL:0002516.description: A chromaffin cell interspersed among the interrenal epithelial layer of the anterior kidney of teloest fish.

CL:0002517.label: interrenal epinephrin secreting cell
CL:0002517.description: An interrenal chromaffin cell found in teleosts that contain small, homogeneous electron-lucent granules that are separated from the vesicular membrane by a visible halo.

CL:0002518.label: kidney epithelial cell
CL:0002518.description: An epithelial cell of the kidney.

CL:1000497.label: kidney cell
CL:1000497.description: A cell that is part of a kidney.

CL:0002519.label: interrenal epithelial cell
CL:0002519.description: An interrenal epithelial kidney cell is an epithelial cell found in the anterior kidney of teleosts fish. This cell type is arranged in layers around the posterior cardinal vein and contains many mitochondria with tubulovesicular cristae. Interrenal chromaffin cells are interspersed among the tissue layer created by this cell type.

CL:0002521.label: subcutaneous adipocyte
CL:0002521.description: An adipocyte that is part of subcutaneous adipose tissue.

CL:0002523.label: mesonephric podocyte
CL:0002523.description: A specialized epithelial cell that contains "feet" that interdigitate with the "feet" of other glomerular epithelial cells in the mesonephros.

CL:0002524.label: disseminated nephrocyte
CL:0002524.description: A disseminated nephrocyte is a nephrocyte that filters hemolymph and is found at scattered locations in the fat body or other tissues.

CL:0002525.label: metanephric podocyte
CL:0002525.description: A specialized epithelial cell that contains "feet" that interdigitate with the "feet" of other glomerular epithelial cells in the metanephros.

CL:0002526.label: CD14-positive dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002526.description: A dermal dendritic cell that is CD1a-negative and CD14-positive.

CL:0002527.label: immature CD14-positive dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002527.description: An immature CD14-positive dermal dendritic cell is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0002528.label: mature CD14-positive dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002528.description: A mature CD14-positive dermal dendritic cell is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0002529.label: CD1a-positive dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002529.description: A dermal dendritic cell that is CD1a-positive and CD14-negative.

CL:0002530.label: immature CD1a-positive dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002530.description: An immature CD1a-positive dermal dendritic cell is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0002531.label: mature CD1a-positive dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002531.description: A mature CD1a-positive dermal dendritic cell is CD80-high, CD83-positive, CD86-high, and MHCII-high.

CL:0002532.label: CD16-positive myeloid dendritic cell
CL:0002532.description: A myeloid dendritic cell found in the blood that is CD16-positive.

CL:0002533.label: immature CD16-positive myeloid dendritic cell
CL:0002533.description: An immature CD16-positive myeloid dendritic cell is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0002534.label: mature CD16-positive myeloid dendritic cell
CL:0002534.description: A mature CD16-positive myeloid dendritic cell is CD80-high, CD83-positive, CD86-high, and MHCII-high.

CL:0002536.label: epithelial cell of amnion
CL:0002536.description: An epithelial cell that is part of the amnion.

CL:0002537.label: amnion mesenchymal stem cell
CL:0002537.description: A mesenchymal stem cell of the amnion membrane.

CL:0002538.label: intrahepatic cholangiocyte
CL:0002538.description: An epithelial cell of the intrahepatic portion of the bile duct. These cells are flattened or cuboidal in shape, and have a small nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio relative to large/extrahepatic cholangiocytes.

CL:1000488.label: cholangiocyte
CL:1000488.description: An epithelial cell that is part of the bile duct. Cholangiocytes contribute to bile secretion via net release of bicarbonate and water. They are cuboidal epithelium in the small interlobular bile ducts, but become columnar and mucus secreting in larger bile ducts approaching the porta hepatis and the extrahepatic ducts.

CL:0002539.label: aortic smooth muscle cell
CL:0002539.description: A smooth muscle cell of the aorta.

CL:0019018.label: blood vessel smooth muscle cell
CL:0019018.description: A smooth muscle cell that is part of any blood vessel.
synonyms: smooth muscle cell of blood vessel

CL:0002540.label: mesenchymal stem cell of the bone marrow
CL:0002540.description: A mesenchymal stem cell that is part of the bone marrow.

CL:0002541.label: chorionic membrane mesenchymal stem cell
CL:0002541.description: A mesenchymal stem cell of the chorionic membrane.

CL:1000413.label: endothelial cell of artery
CL:1000413.description: A blood vessel endothelial cell that is part of an arterial endothelium.

CL:0002543.label: vein endothelial cell
CL:0002543.description: An endothelial cell that is part of the vein.

CL:0002544.label: aortic endothelial cell
CL:0002544.description: An arterial endothelial cell that is part of the aorta endothelium.

CL:0002545.label: thoracic aorta endothelial cell
CL:0002545.description: An endothelial cell that is part of the thoracic endothelium.

CL:0002546.label: embryonic blood vessel endothelial progenitor cell
CL:0002546.description: An endothelial progenitor cell that participates in angiogenesis during development.

CL:0002547.label: fibroblast of the aortic adventitia
CL:0002547.description: A fibroblast of the aortic adventitia.

CL:1000306.label: fibroblast of tunica adventitia of artery
CL:1000306.description: A fibroblast that is part of the tunica adventitia of artery.

CL:0002548.label: fibroblast of cardiac tissue
CL:0002548.description: A fibroblast that is part of the heart.

CL:0002549.label: fibroblast of choroid plexus
CL:0002549.description: A fibroblast that is part of the choroid plexus.

CL:0002550.label: fibroblast of the conjunctiva
CL:0002550.description: A fibroblast that is part of the conjuctiva of the eye.

CL:0002551.label: fibroblast of dermis
CL:0002551.description: Any skin fibroblast that is part of some dermis.

CL:0002552.label: fibroblast of gingiva
CL:0002552.description: Any fibroblast that is part of some gingiva.

CL:0002553.label: fibroblast of lung
CL:0002553.description: A fibroblast that is part of lung.

CL:0002554.label: fibroblast of lymphatic vessel
CL:0002554.description: A fibroblast of the lymphatic system.

CL:0002576.label: perineurial cell
CL:0002576.description: A glial cell that is part of the perineurium. This cell type has thin long bipolar cytoplasmic processes, pinocytotic vesicles, fragments of external lamina and/or external lamina-like material, attachment plaques, and desmosome-like junctions. Perineurial cells historically have been referred to as fibroblasts because of shape; however, unlike fibroblasts, a perineurial cell: does not have a compact nucleus and large endoplasmic reticulum; does have a double basement membrane opposed to a single basal lamina; is carefully joined to other perineurial cells by tight junctions into a single sheet as opposed to arranged in a large mass; and finally, can surround a small axon bundle at a nerve terminal whereas a fibroblast cannot.

CL:0002638.description: A respiratory stem cell found at the junction of the terminal (conductive) bronchiole and the respiratory bronchiole. This cell types gives rise to alveolar cell types and club cells in response to lung injury. This cell type expresses markers Scgb1a1 and Sftpc.

CL:0002639.description: An amniotic stem cell is a mesenchymalstem cell extracted from amniotic fluid. Amniotic stem cells are able to differentiate into various tissue type such as skin, cartilage, cardiac tissue, nerves, muscle, and bone

CL:0002649.description: An ecto-epithelial cell of the gingival region of the viscerocranial mucosa.

CL:0002650.description: An ecto-epithelial cell of the paranasal region of the viscerocranial mucosa.

CL:0002651.label: endothelial cell of venous sinus of spleen
CL:0002651.description: An endothelial cell that is part of the venous sinus of spleen. This endothelial cell has an elongated, spindle-shaped, flattened morphology that is parallel to long axis of sinus. This cell type rests on a basement membrane interrupted by numerous narrow slits.

CL:0002652.label: endothelial cell of high endothelial venule
CL:0002652.description: A venule endothelial cell that is cubodial, expresses leukocyte-specific receptors, and allows for passage of lymphocytes into bloodstream.

CL:1000414.label: endothelial cell of venule
CL:1000414.description: An endothelial cell that is part of the venule.

CL:0002655.label: epithelial cell of stratum spinosum of esophageal epithelium
CL:0002655.description: An epithelial cell of stratum spinosum of esophageal epithelium.

CL:0002656.label: glandular endometrial unciliated epithelial cell
CL:0002656.description: A glandular epithelial cell of the endometrium. Following ovulation, these cells secrete a glycogen-rich substance known as histotroph or uterine milk, which nourishes the embryo if implantation occurs.

CL:0009084.label: glandular epithelial cell of endometrium
CL:0009084.description: An epithelial cell that is part of an endometrium glandular epithelium.

CL:1001591.label: oviduct secretory cell

CL:0002660.description: A luminal epithelial cell of mammary gland located in acinus of structure.

CL:0002661.label: luminal cell of lactiferous terminal ductal lobular unit
CL:0002661.description: A luminal cell of terminal ducts, i.e.e the terminal branch of a lactiferous duct which alveolar cells drain into.

CL:0002662.label: luminal cell of lactiferous duct
CL:0002662.description: A luminal epithelial cell of the lactiferous duct. This cuboidal epithelial cell expresses keratin-18 and is estrogen-receptor alpha positive.

CL:0002663.label: myocardial endocrine cell of atrium
CL:0002663.description: A myocardial endocrine cell that is part of the atrium.

CL:0002664.label: cardioblast
CL:0002664.description: A stem cell that can give rise to multiple cell types (i.e. smooth muscle, endothelial) in the developing heart.

CL:0002665.label: otic fibrocyte
CL:0002665.description: A fibrocyte of the cochlea that has specialized structural and molecular adaptions.

CL:0002666.label: type 2 otic fibrocyte
CL:0002666.description: An otic fibrocyte that underlies the spiral prominence and is part of a mesenchymal gap junction network that regulates ionic homeostasis of the endolymph.

CL:0002667.label: type 5 otic fibrocyte
CL:0002667.description: An otic fibrocyte that resides above the stria vasularis and is part of a mesenchymal gap junction network that regulates ionic homeostasis of the endolymph.

CL:0002668.label: type 4 otic fibrocyte
CL:0002668.description: An otic fibrocyte that is lateral to the basilar membrane and anchoris it to the lateral wall.

CL:0002669.label: type 3 otic fibrocyte
CL:0002669.description: An otic fibrocyte that lines the otic capsule.

CL:0002670.label: type 1 otic fibrocyte
CL:0002670.description: An otic fibrocyte that underlies the stria vascularis and is part of a mesenchymal gap junction network that regulates ionic homeostasis of the endolymph.

CL:0002671.label: endothelial stalk cell
CL:0002671.description: An endothelial stalk cell is a specialized endothelial cell that follows behind the tip cell of an angiogenic sprout.

CL:0002673.label: tongue muscle cell
CL:0002673.description: A skeletal muscle cell that is part of the tongue.

CL:0002674.label: H minus

CL:0002675.label: H plus
CL:0002675.description: A S. pombe cell type determined by mat1-Pc and mat1-Pi on the mat1 locus.

CL:0002679.label: natural helper lymphocyte
CL:0002679.description: A lymphocyte found in adipose tissue that lacks lineage markers of other lymphocytes but is capable of mediating TH2 cytokine responses. This cell type is found in fat associated lymphoid clusters, proliferates in response to IL2 and produce large amounts of TH2 cytokines such as IL5, IL6 and IL13

CL:0002680.label: PP cell of intestine

CL:0003001.label: bistratified retinal ganglion cell

CL:0004247.description: A neuron that stratifies dendrites at two and only two locations.

CL:0003002.description: A retinal ganglion cell that has a small dendritic field and a medium dendritic arbor with post sympatic terminals in sublaminar layer S3.

CL:0003003.description: A mono-stratified retinal ganglion cell that has a small dendritic field and a sparse dendritic arbor with post sympatic terminals in sublaminar layer S3.

CL:0003004.description: A bistratified retinal ganglion cell that has a small dendritic field with sparse density that terminates at the intersection of the S4-S5 sublaminar level, and a second dendrite field that is medium in size and degree of arborization that terminates in sublaminar layer S2.

CL:0003005.label: G4 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003005.description: A mono-stratified retinal ganglion cell that has a small dendritic field and dense dendritic arbor.

CL:0003006.label: G4-ON retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003006.description: A G4 retinal ganglion cell that has post sympatic terminals in sublaminar layers S3 and S4 and is depolarized by illumination of its receptive field center.

CL:0003007.label: G4-OFF retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003007.description: A G4 retinal ganglion cell that has post sympatic terminals in sublaminar layers S2 and S3 and is depolarized by decreased illumination of their receptive field center

CL:4023033.label: OFF retinal ganglion cell
CL:4023033.description: A retinal ganglion cell that is depolarized by decreased illumination of their receptive field center.

CL:0003009.label: G6 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003009.description: A mono-stratified retinal ganglion cell that has a medium dendritic field and a sparse dendritic arbor with post sympatic terminals in sublaminar layer S4 and S5.

CL:0003010.label: G7 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003010.description: A bistratified retinal ganglion cell that has a dendrite field that terminates in sublaminar layer S2 and a second dendrite field that terminates in sublaminar layer S4.

CL:0003011.label: G8 retinal ganglion cell

CL:0003012.label: G9 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003012.description: A mono-stratified retinal ganglion cell that has a large dendritic field and a medium dendritic arbor with post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S1 and S2.

CL:0003013.label: G10 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003013.description: A mono-stratified retinal ganglion cell that has a large dendritic field, a medium dendritic arbor, and a long secondary dendrite shaft with post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S4.

CL:0003014.label: G11 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003014.description: A mono-stratified retinal ganglion cell that has a large dendritic field, a medium dendritic arbor, and a medium length secondary dendrite shaft.

CL:0003015.description: A G11 retinal ganglion cell that has post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S4 and is depolarized by illumination of its receptive field center.

CL:0003016.label: G11-OFF retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003016.description: A G11 retinal ganglion cell that has post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S2 and is depolarized by decreased illumination of their receptive field center

CL:0003017.label: retinal ganglion cell B3 outer
CL:0003017.description: A retinal ganglion B cell that has post synaptic terminals in S2.

CL:0003026.description: A bistratified retinal ganglion cell that has a small dendrite fields with a sparse dendrite arbor terminating in S2 and S3.

CL:0003027.description: A bistratified retinal ganglion cell D cell that has medium dendritic arbor and a large dendritic field that terminates in S2 and S4.

CL:0003028.label: M1 retinal ganglion cell

CL:0003029.label: M2 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003029.description: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell that has a small soma, a small dendrite field with a dense dendrite arbor, and post synaptic terminals in sublaminer layer S2 and S3.

CL:0003031.description: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell that has post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S4 and is depolarized by illumination of its receptive field center.

CL:0003032.description: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell that has post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S2 and is depolarized by decreased illumination of their receptive field center

CL:0003034.label: M5 retinal ganglion cell

CL:0003035.description: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell that contains opsin.

CL:0003039.label: M8 retinal ganglion cell

CL:0003040.label: M9 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003040.description: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell with large soma and large dendritic field, with medium dendritic arbor, and has dendrites in layers 1 and 5.

CL:0003041.description: An M9 retinal ganglion cells with synaptic terminals in S2 and is depolarized by illumination of its receptive field center.

CL:0003049.label: M cone cell
