CL:0004119.description: A retinal ganglion cell B that has medium body size, medium dendritic field and dense dendritic arbor, and has post synaptic terminals in S2.

CL:0004120.label: retinal ganglion cell A1
CL:0004120.description: A retinal ganglion A cell found in the retina with large somata, often polygonal in shape. The dendritic fields consist of three to seven stout dendrites that are sparce near soma. Dendrites terminate in S4.

CL:0004121.label: retinal ganglion cell B2
CL:0004121.description: A retinal ganglion cell B that has a very small but very dense dendritic field, and has post synaptic terminals in S2.

CL:0004124.label: retinal ganglion cell C1
CL:0004124.description: A retinal ganglion cell C inner that has medium dendritic diversity.

CL:0004125.label: retinal ganglion cell C2 inner
CL:0004125.description: A retinal ganglion cell C inner that has dense dendritic diversity.

CL:0004126.label: retinal ganglion cell C2 outer
CL:0004126.description: A retinal ganglion cell C outer that has symmetrical and dense dendritic dendritic tree with a large dendritic field.

CL:0004137.label: retinal ganglion cell A2 inner
CL:0004137.description: A retinal ganglion A2 cell with dendrites terminating in S4.

CL:0004138.label: retinal ganglion cell A2
CL:0004138.description: A retinal ganglion A cell with dense arbor near soma.

CL:0004139.label: retinal ganglion cell A2 outer
CL:0004139.description: A retinal ganglion A2 cell with dendrites terminating in S2.

CL:0004161.label: 510 nm-cone
CL:0004161.description: A cone whose sensitivity measurements have an average spectral peak of 510 nm. These cones are described in rat.

CL:0004162.label: 360 nm-cone
CL:0004162.description: A cone whose sensitivity measurements have an average spectral peak of 358.2 nm. These cones are described in rat.

CL:0004213.label: type 3a cone bipolar cell
CL:0004213.description: A type of type 3 cone bipolar cell with distinctive curly dendrites.

CL:0004214.label: type 3b cone bipolar cell
CL:0004214.description: A type of type 3 cone bipolar cell with distinctive crescent-shaped dendrites.

CL:0004215.label: type 5a cone bipolar cell
CL:0004215.description: A type 5 cone bipolar cell with narrowly stratified post synaptic terminals.

CL:0004216.label: type 5b cone bipolar cell
CL:0004216.description: A type 5 cone bipolar cell with diffuse axonal branches.

CL:0004217.label: H1 horizontal cell
CL:0004217.description: A horizontal cell with a large cell body, thick dendrites, and a large dendritic arbor.

CL:0004218.label: H2 horizontal cell
CL:0004218.description: A horizontal cell with a small cell body, thin dendrites, and small dendritic arbor.

CL:0004219.label: A2 amacrine cell
CL:0004219.description: A bistratifed retinal amacrine cell with a small dendritic field, dendrite stratification in S1-S2, and a second dendrite stratification in S5. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter glycine.

CL:0004250.label: bistratified retinal amacrine cell
CL:0004250.description: An amicrine that stratifies dendrites at two and only two locations.

CL:0004251.label: narrow field retinal amacrine cell
CL:0004251.description: An amicrine that has a narrow dendritic field.

CL:4030028.label: glycinergic amacrine cell
CL:4030028.description: An amacrine cell that uses glycine as a neurotransmitter.

CL:0004220.label: flag amacrine cell
CL:0004220.description: An amacrine cell with a small, asymteric dendritic field.

CL:0004221.label: flag A amacrine cell
CL:0004221.description: A flag amacrine cell with post-synaptic terminals in S2 and S3. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter glycine.

CL:0004222.label: flag B amacrine cell
CL:0004222.description: A flag amacrine cell with post-synaptic terminals in S3, S4, and S5. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter glycine.

CL:0004223.label: AB diffuse-1 amacrine cell
CL:0004223.description: A amacrine cell with a small dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S1, S2, S3, and S4. AB diffuse-1 amacrine cells have a tent-shaped dendritic arbor and undulate dendrites.

CL:0004224.label: AB diffuse-2 amacrine cell
CL:0004224.description: A broadly stratifying amacrine cell that has a small dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S2 and S3. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter glycine.

CL:0004225.label: spider amacrine cell
CL:0004225.description: A broadly stratifying amacrine cell with a small dendritic field, straight dendrites and post-synaptic terminals in S1, S2, and S3.

CL:0004226.label: monostratified amacrine cell
CL:0004226.description: An amacrine cell with a small dendritic field with post-synaptic terminals in S3 and S4.

CL:0004246.label: monostratified cell
CL:0004246.description: A central nervous system neuron that stratifies at one and only one location.

CL:0004227.label: flat bistratified amacrine cell
CL:0004227.description: A bistratified amacrine cell with a small dendritic field. Flat bistratified amacrine cells have post-synaptic terminals both on the border of S1 and S2, and on the border of S3 and S4. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter glycine.

CL:0004228.label: broad diffuse amacrine cell
CL:0004228.description: An amacrine cell with a small dendritic field that has post-synaptic terminals in S1, S2, S3, and S4.

CL:0004229.label: A2-like amacrine cell
CL:0004229.description: A bistratified amacrine cell with a small dendritic field that has dendrite stratification in S2, and in S3 and S4.

CL:0004230.label: diffuse bistratified amacrine cell
CL:0004230.description: A bistratified amacrine cell with a small dendritic field that has post-synaptic terminals in S1 and the border of S1-S2, and termination of a second arbor within the border of S2-S3 and S3.

CL:0004231.label: recurving diffuse amacrine cell
CL:0004231.description: A broadly stratifying amacrine cell with a small dendritic field and a complex dendritic arbor. Recurving diffuse amacrine cells have post-synaptic terminals in S2, S3, and S4.

CL:0004232.label: starburst amacrine cell
CL:0004232.description: An amacrine cell with a flat dendritic arbor and a medium dendritic field. Starburst amacrine cells have post-synaptic terminals in S2. This cell type releases the neurotransmitters gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) and acetylcholine.

CL:0008061.label: GABA-Chol neuron
CL:0008061.description: A neuron that releases both gamma-aminobutyric acid and acetylcholine as vesicular neurotransmitters.  Examples include some types of striatal interneuron.

CL:4030027.label: GABAergic amacrine cell
CL:4030027.description: An amacrine cell that uses GABA as a neurotransmitter.

CL:0004233.label: DAPI-3 amacrine cell
CL:0004233.description: An amacrine cell with a medium dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals that stratify at S2, with a second stratification that occurs in S3 and S4. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter glycine.

CL:0004252.label: medium field retinal amacrine cell
CL:0004252.description: An amicrine that has a medium dendritic field.

CL:0004234.label: diffuse multistratified amacrine cell
CL:0004234.description: An amacrine cell with a medium dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S2, and in S3-S4.

CL:0004235.label: AB broad diffuse-1 amacrine cell
CL:0004235.description: An amacrine cell with a medium dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S2 and S3. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA).

CL:0004236.label: AB broad diffuse-2 amacrine cell
CL:0004236.description: An amacrine cell with a medium dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S2, S3, and S4. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA).

CL:0004237.label: fountain amacrine cell
CL:0004237.description: A retinal amacrine cell with a medium dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S1, S2, S3, and S4. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA).

CL:0004238.label: asymmetric bistratified amacrine cell
CL:0004238.description: A bistratified amacrine cell with a medium dendritic field, a flat and sparse dendritic arbor, and post-synaptic terminals at the intersections of S1 and S2, and S3 and S4.

CL:0004239.label: wavy bistratified amacrine cell
CL:0004239.description: A bistratified amacrine cell with a medium dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S1-S2, and S4.

CL:0004240.label: WF1 amacrine cell
CL:0004240.description: An amacrine cell with a wide dendritic field, dendrites in S1, and post-synaptic terminals in S1.

CL:0004253.label: wide field retinal amacrine cell
CL:0004253.description: An amicrine that has a wide dendritic field.

CL:0004241.label: WF2 amacrine cell
CL:0004241.description: An amacrine cell with a wide dendritic field, dendrites in S2, and post-synaptic terminals in S1.

CL:0004242.label: WF3-1 amacrine cell
CL:0004242.description: An amacrine cell with a wide dendritic field, dendrites in S3, and post-synaptic terminals in S3. Dendrites of this cell type are straight and minimally branched.

CL:0004243.label: WF3-2 amacrine cell
CL:0004243.description: An amacrine cell with a wild dendritic field, dendrites in S3, and post-synaptic terminals in S3. Dendrites have spikes, cross over each other, and cover a larger volume than dendrties of W3-1 retinal amacrine cells.

CL:0004244.label: WF4 amacrine cell
CL:0004244.description: An amacrine cell with a wide dendritic field, dendrites in S4, and post-synaptic terminals in S4.

CL:0004245.label: indoleamine-accumulating amacrine cell
CL:0004245.description: An amacrine cell with a wide dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S5. This cell type releases the neurotransmitters gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) and serotonin.

CL:0005006.label: ionocyte
CL:0005006.description: Specialized epithelial cells involved in the maintenance of osmotic homeostasis. They are characterized by abundant mitochondria and ion transporters. In amniotes, they are present in the renal system. In freshwater fish, ionocytes in the skin and gills help maintain osmotic homeostasis by absorbing salt from the external environment.

CL:0005007.label: Kolmer-Agduhr neuron
CL:0005007.description: Kolmer-Agduhr neurons are ciliated GABAergic neurons that contact the central canal of the spinal cord and have ipsilateral ascending axons.

CL:0005008.label: macular hair cell
CL:0005008.description: An auditory hair cell located in the macula that is sensitive to auditory stimuli.

CL:0005009.label: renal principal cell
CL:0005009.description: A cuboidal epithelial cell of the kidney which regulates sodium and potassium balance. The activity of sodium and potassium channels on the apical membrane of the cell is regulated by aldosterone and vasopressin. In mammals this cell type is located in the renal collecting duct system.

CL:1000449.label: epithelial cell of nephron
CL:1000449.description: An epithelial cell that is part of the nephron.

CL:0005011.label: renal alpha-intercalated cell
CL:0005011.description: A cuboidal epithelial cell of the kidney which secretes acid and reabsorbs base to regulate acid/base balance.

CL:0005012.label: multiciliated epithelial cell
CL:0005012.description: A columnar/cuboidal epithelial cell with multiple motile cilia on its apical surface. These cells facilitate the movement of liquids such as mucus or cerebrospinal fluid across the epithelial surface.

CL:0005013.label: single ciliated epithelial cell
CL:0005013.description: A ciliated epithelial cell with a single cilium.

CL:0005015.label: inner phalangeal cell
CL:0005015.description: An auditory epithelial support cell that surrounds the nerve fibers and synapses of the auditory inner hair cells.

CL:0005016.label: obsolete apical cell
CL:0005016.description: Obsolete. Use PO:0030007 from Plant Ontology instead. The apical cell is the upper cell formed after the first division of a plant zygote.

CL:0005017.label: obsolete plant basal cell
CL:0005017.description: Obsolete. Use PO:0002002 from Plant Ontology instead. The lower cell formed after the first division of a plant zygote.

CL:0005019.label: pancreatic epsilon cell
CL:0005019.description: Ghrelin secreting cells found in the endocrine pancreas.

CL:0005021.label: mesenchymal lymphangioblast
CL:0005021.description: Mesenchymal derived lymphatic progenitor cells that give rise to the superficial lymphatics.

CL:0005023.label: branchiomotor neuron
CL:0005023.description: Cranial motor neuron which innervates muscles derived from the branchial (pharyngeal) arches.

CL:0015000.label: cranial motor neuron
CL:0015000.description: Motor neuron that innervate muscles that control eye, jaw, and facial movements of the vertebrate head and parasympathetic neurons that innervate certain glands and organs.

CL:0005024.label: somatomotor neuron
CL:0005024.description: A motor neuron that innervates a skeletal muscle.  These motor neurons are all excitatory and cholinergic.

CL:0005025.label: visceromotor neuron
CL:0005025.description: A motor neuron that synapses to parasympathetic neurons that innervate tear glands, sweat glands, and the smooth muscles and glands of the pulmonary, cardiovascular, and gastrointestinal systems.

CL:0011102.label: parasympathetic neuron
CL:0011102.description: Parasympathetic neurons are part of the parasympathetic nervous sysem and the cell bodies lie in the brain and sacral region of the spinal cord. The neurons are mainly cholinergic.

CL:0007001.label: skeletogenic cell
CL:0007001.description: Cell that has the potential to form a skeletal cell type (e.g. cells in periosteum, cells in marrow) and produce extracellular matrix (often mineralized) and skeletal tissue (often mineralized).

CL:0007005.label: notochordal cell
CL:0007005.description: Cell that is part of the notochord.

CL:0007006.label: chordamesodermal cell
CL:0007006.description: Mesodermal cell that is axially located and gives rise to the cells of the notochord.

CL:0007007.label: notochordal sheath cell
CL:0007007.description: Notochordal cell that is part of the outer epithelium of the notochord and surrounds the vacuolated notochord cells.

CL:0007008.label: notochordal vacuole cell
CL:0007008.description: Notochordal cell that is inner portion of the notochord and becomes vacuolated as development proceeds.

CL:0007011.label: enteric neuron
CL:0007011.description: Neuron that is part of the enteric nervous system.

CL:0007012.label: non-terminally differentiated odontoblast
CL:0007012.description: Odontoblast that non-terminally differentiated, located in the odontogenic papilla and dentine tissue, and transforms from a odontoblast cell.

CL:0007013.label: terminally differentiated odontoblast
CL:0007013.description: Odontoblast that is terminally differentiated and derived from an odontogenic papilla and associated with dentine.

CL:0007014.label: obsolete cell line cell
CL:0007014.description: OBSOLETE: A cultured cell that has been passaged at least one time in culture.
comments:
Obsoleted in July 2013 and replaced by the CLO 'cell line cell' class, as a result of CLO-OBI-CL alignment efforts.

Covers cells actively being cultured or stored in a quiescent state for future use.

CL:0007015.label: obsolete mortal cell line cell
CL:0007015.description: OBSOLETE: A cell line cell that is expected to be capable of replicating a limited number of times in culture before undergoing senescence. Mortal cell line cells cannot be propagated indefinitely (as immortal cell line cells can).
comments:
Obsoleted in July 2013 and replaced by the CLO 'mortal cell line cell' class, as a result of CLO-OBI-CL alignment efforts.

Covers cells actively being cultured or stored in a quiescent state for future use.

CL:0007016.label: adaxial cell
CL:0007016.description: Muscle precursor cell that is adjacent to the notochord and part of the presomitic mesoderm.

CL:0007017.label: Stiftchenzellen
CL:0007017.description: An epidermal cell with apical microvilli or a single apical projection have synaptic associations with nerve fibres in the epidermis.

CL:0007018.label: epidermal ciliary cell
CL:0007018.description: Ciliated cell of the embryonic epidermis and functions in embryonic movements.

CL:0007020.label: bottle cell
CL:0007020.description: Characteristic early embryonic cell with a bottle or flask shape that is first to migrate inwards at the blastopore during gastrulation in amphibians.

CL:0007021.label: alarm substance cell
CL:0007021.description: Secretory cell that produces a chemical mixture that triggers antipredator behavior. The substance is released only upon disruption of the epidermis. [Behavior of teleost fishes, second edition, edited by Pitcher, 1992]

CL:0007022.label: micropylar cell
CL:0007022.description: A specialized pore forming cell of the follicle, located adjacent to the animal pole of the oocyte. The micropylar cell makes the single micropyle (pore) through the chorion through which the sperm fertilizes the egg.

CL:0007023.label: flask cell
CL:0007023.description: Epidermal cell rich in mitochondria. In amphibians, appears during metamorphosis.

CL:0008004.label: somatic muscle cell
CL:0008004.description: A muscle cell that is part of some somatic muscle.

CL:0008005.label: obliquely striated somatic muscle cell
CL:0008005.description: A somatic muscle cell that is obliquely striated and mononucleated. Examples include the somatic muscles of nematodes.

CL:0008006.label: muscle founder cell
CL:0008006.description: A myoblast that detemines the properties (size, shape and attachment to the epidermis) of a `somatic muscle myotube` (CL:0008003) .  It develops into a somatic muscle myotube via fusion with `fusion component myoblasts` (CL:0000621).

CL:0008008.label: striated visceral muscle cell
CL:0008008.description: A visceral muscle cell that is striated.  Examples include the visceral muscle cells of arhtropods.

CL:0008010.label: cranial somatomotor neuron
CL:0008010.description: A cranial motor neuron whose soma is located in the midbrain andor hindbrain and which innervates the skeletal muscles of the eye or tongue.

CL:0008011.label: skeletal muscle satellite stem cell
CL:0008011.description: A skeletal muscle satellite cell that divides by stem cell division.  A proportion of this population undergoes symmetric stem cell division, producing two skeletal muscle satellite stem cells. The rest undergo asymmetric stem cell division - retaining their identity while budding off a daughter cell that differentiates into an adult skeletal muscle myoblast.

CL:0008020.label: skeletal muscle satellite myogenic cell
CL:0008020.description: A skeletal muscle satellite cell that undergoes symmetric division to produce two adult skeleltal muscle myoblasts.

CL:0008012.label: quiescent skeletal muscle satellite cell
CL:0008012.description: A skeletal muscle satellite cell that is mitotically quiescent.  These cells are wedge shaped and have a large nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio with few organelles, a small nucleus and condensed interphase chromatin. Satellite cells typically remain in this state until activated following muscle damage.

CL:0008013.label: cranial visceromotor neuron
CL:0008013.description: A visceromotor motor neuron whose soma is located in the hindbrain, and which synapses to parasympathetic neurons that innervate tear glands, sweat glands, and the smooth muscles of the head.

CL:0008014.label: obsolete excitatory motor neuron
CL:0008014.description: A motor neuron that is capable of directly inducing muscle contraction.
comments: In vertebrates, all motor neurons are excitatory, but various types of inhibitory motor neurons exist in invertebrates.

CL:0008015.label: inhibitory motor neuron
CL:0008015.description: A motor neuron that is capable of directly inhibiting muscle contraction.

CL:0008016.label: activated skeletal muscle satellite cell
CL:0008016.description: A skeletal muscle satellite cell that has become mitotically active - typically following muscle damage.

CL:0008017.label: adult skeletal muscle myoblast
CL:0008017.description: A skeletal muscle myoblast that is part of a skeletal mucle.  These cells are formed following acivation and division of skeletal muscle satellite cells. They form a transient population that is lost when they fuse to form skeletal muscle fibers.

CL:0008021.label: anterior lateral line ganglion neuron
CL:0008021.description: Any peripheral nervous system neuron that has its soma located in some anterior lateral line ganglion.

CL:2000031.label: lateral line ganglion neuron
CL:2000031.description: Any neuron that is part of a lateral line ganglion.

CL:0008022.label: endocardial cushion cell
CL:0008022.description: A mesenchymal cell of the endocardial cushion.   These cells develop via an epithelial to mesenchymal transition when endocardial cells break cell-to-cell contacts and migrate into the cardiac jelly. Cells from this population form the heart septa and valves.

CL:0008023.label: obsolete cardiac fibroblast
comments: Duplicate term.

CL:0008025.label: noradrenergic neuron
CL:0008025.description: A neuron that release noradrenaline (noriphinephrine) as a neurotransmitter.

CL:0008026.label: open tracheal system tracheocyte
CL:0008026.description: An epithelial cell that is part of the epithelium of a tracheal tube in an open tracheal system, such as that found in insects.

CL:0008027.label: rod bipolar cell (sensu Mus)
CL:0008027.description: A bipolar neuron found in the retina that is synapsed by rod photoreceptor cells.  These neurons have axons that arborize and synapse to targets in inner plexiform layers 4 and 5 and depolarize in response to light.

CL:0008029.label: obsolete inhibitory neuron
comments: Consider GABAergic neuron or inhibitory interneuron instead. Do note that not all GABAergic neurons are inhibitory (see PMID:12209121) and replacing inhibitory neuron with GABAergic neuron should be done with caution.

CL:0008030.label: obsolete excitatory neuron
comments: Consider using glutamatergic neuron instead. Do note that not all glutamatergic neurons are excitatory and replacing excitatory neuron with glutamatergic neuron should be done with caution.

CL:0008031.label: cortical interneuron
CL:0008031.description: An interneuron that has its soma located in the cerebral cortex.

CL:0008032.label: rosehip neuron
CL:0008032.description: A GABAergic interneuron in human cortical layer 1 that has large rosehip-shaped axonal boutons and compact arborization.

CL:0010011.label: cerebral cortex GABAergic interneuron
CL:0010011.description: A GABAergic interneuron whose soma is located in the cerebral cortex.

CL:0008033.label: decidual pericyte
CL:0008033.description: A pericyte of the decidual vasculature.

CL:2000078.label: placental pericyte
CL:2000078.description: Any pericyte cell that is part of a placenta.

CL:0008035.label: microcirculation associated smooth muscle cell
CL:0008035.description: Any vascular associated smooth muscle cell that is part of some microcirculatory vessel.

CL:0008036.label: extravillous trophoblast
CL:0008036.description: A trophoblast cell that is not part of a placental villous.

CL:0008047.label: intrafusal muscle fiber
CL:0008047.description: A skeletal muscle fiber that is part of a muscle spindle. These are specialized muscle fibers that serve as proprioceptors, detecting the amount and rate of change in length of a muscle. They are innervated by both sensory neurons and motor neurons (gamma and beta motorneurons, collectively referred to as fusimotor neurons).

CL:0008038.label: alpha motor neuron
CL:0008038.description: A large, multipolar lower motor neuron of the brainstem and spinal cord that innervates the extrafusal muscle fibers of skeletal muscle and are directly responsible for initiating their contraction. While their cell bodies are in the CNS (in the anterior gray horn of the spinal cord), they are part of the somatic nervous system - a branch of the PNS.

CL:0008040.label: squamous endothelial cell of venule
CL:0008040.description: An endothelial cell of the venule that is squamous shaped. This is in contrast to the cubodial shape of high endothelial venule cells.

CL:0008041.label: mesothelial cell of intestine
CL:0008041.description: A mesothelial cell that is part of the intestinal serosa.

CL:0008042.label: tanycyte of subfornical organ
CL:0008042.description: A tanycyte of the subfornical organ (SFO).  These cells extend long and slender fibers extending from their cell bodies in the ependyma toward fenestrated capillaries associated with the SFO, where they form a dense network surrounding these capillaries.

CL:0008044.label: tanycyte of area postrema
CL:0008044.description: A tanycyte of the area postrema (AP).  These cells extend long and slender fibers extending from their cell bodies in the ependyma toward fenestrated capillaries associated with the AP, where they form a dense network surrounding these capillaries.

CL:0008045.label: tanycyte of subcommissural organ
CL:0008045.description: A tanycyte of the subcommisural organ (SCO).  These cells extend long and slender fibers extending from their cell bodies in the ependyma toward fenestrated capillaries associated with the SCO, where they form a dense network surrounding these capillaries.

CL:0008048.label: upper motor neuron
CL:0008048.description: A glutamatergic motor neuron with a soma in the brainstem or cerebral cortex.  They do not synapse directly to muscles but rather to lower motor neurons, which do.  They are the main controllers of voluntary movement.

CL:0008049.label: Betz cell
CL:0008049.description: A giant pyramidal neuron with a soma in layer Vb of the primary motor cortex that sends its axons down the spinal cord via the corticospinal tract, either synapsing directly with alpha motor neurons, or targeting interneurons in the spinal cord. In humans, Betz cells are the largest known in the central nervous system.

CL:2000049.label: primary motor cortex pyramidal cell
CL:2000049.description: Any pyramidal cell that is part of a primary motor cortex.

CL:4023041.label: L5 extratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron
CL:4023041.description: A transcriptomically distinct glutamatergic neuron, with a soma found in the deeper portion of L5, that has long-range axonal projections including deep subcortical targets outside of the telencephalon and, in some cases, the spinal cord. While the L5 ET neuron projections are not limited to ET targets, they are clearly differentiated from the neuron subclasses whose projections are constrained to intratelencephalic (IT) targets.  L5 ET neurons are generally the largest excitatory cortical neurons, typically having a thick apical dendrite with a prominent dendritic tuft in layer 1 and displaying burst-firing physiological characteristics. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: Deep layer (non-IT) excitatory neurons ', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters L5 ET.

CL:0008053.label: circumventricular organ capillary endothelial cell
CL:0008053.description: A capillary endothelial cell that is part of the circumventricular organs (CVOs), characterized by fenestrations that facilitate selective permeability to molecules, distinguishing it from the non-fenestrated endothelial cells of the blood-brain barrier. This cell is integral to the unique vascular structure of CVOs, which lack a traditional blood-brain barrier. It enables bidirectional exchange of polar molecules between blood and neural tissue, supporting neuroendocrine signaling, fluid balance, and immune responses. It is marked by the expression of PLVAP, a component of the fenestral diaphragm, in both rodents and humans.

CL:2000044.label: brain microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000044.description: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of a brain.

CL:0008059.label: GABA-Gly neuron
CL:0008059.description: A neuron that releases both gamma-aminobutyric acid and glycine as vesicular neurotransmitters.  Examples include types of amacrine cell and types of cerebellar inhibitory neurons.

CL:1001509.label: glycinergic neuron
CL:1001509.description: The neurons that utilize glycine as a neurotransmitter.

CL:0008060.label: GABA-Glut neuron
CL:0008060.description: A neuron that releases both gamma-aminobutyric acid and glutamate as vesicular neurotransmitters.

CL:0009000.label: sensory neuron of spinal nerve
CL:0009000.description: A sensory neuron of the spinal nerve that senses body position and sends information about how much the muscle is stretched to the spinal cord.

CL:3000004.label: peripheral sensory neuron
CL:3000004.description: A neuron type that is located in a peripheral nervous system and it transmits sensory information from the peripheral (PNS) to the central nervous system (CNS). A sensory neuron converts physical (light, sound, touch) or chemical (such as taste and smell) stimuli into an electrical signal through a process known as sensory transduction. The function of a sensory neuron is to carry informations from the external environment and internal body conditions to the central nervous system for further processing.

CL:0009001.label: compound eye retinal cell
CL:0009001.description: Any cell in the compound eye, a light sensing organ composed of ommatidia.

CL:0009002.label: inflammatory cell
CL:0009002.description: Any cell participating in the inflammatory response to a foreign substance, e.g. neutrophil, macrophage.

CL:0009003.label: larval midgut cell
CL:0009003.description: Any cell in the midgut (middle subdivision of a digestive tract) of an insect larva.

CL:0009005.label: salivary gland cell
CL:0009005.description: Any cell in a salivary gland.

CL:1001598.label: small intestine secretory cell
CL:1001598.description: A glandular cell found in the epithelium of the small intestine. Example: Enterocytes, Goblet cells, enteroendocrine cells; Paneth cells; M cells; Somatostatin-secreting Cells (D-cells) .

CL:0009007.label: gastrointestinal tract (lamina propria) macrophage of small intestine
CL:0009007.description: A macrophage which is resident in the lamina propria of the small intestine.
synonyms: small intestine lamina propria resident macrophage

CL:0009008.label: gastrointestinal tract (lamina propria) macrophage of large intestine
CL:0009008.description: A macrophage which is resident in the lamina propria of the large intestine.
synonyms: large intestine lamina propria resident macrophage

CL:0009009.label: paneth cell of colon
CL:0009009.description: A paneth cell that is located in the epithelium of the colon.
synonyms: paneth cell of epithelium of colon

CL:0009010.label: transit amplifying cell
CL:0009010.description: Transit-amplifying cells (TACs) are an undifferentiated population in transition between stem cells and differentiated cells.

CL:0009011.label: transit amplifying cell of colon
CL:0009011.description: A rapidly proliferating population of cells that differentiate from stem cells of the intestinal crypt of the colon. Stem cells located in the crypts of Lieberkühn give rise to proliferating progenitor or transit amplifying cells that differentiate into the four major epithelial cell types. These include columnar absorptive cells or enterocytes, mucous secreting goblet cells, enteroendocrine cells and paneth cells.
synonyms: transient amplifying cell of crypt of Lieberkuhn of colon
transit amplifying cell of crypt of Lieberkuhn of colon

CL:0009012.label: transit amplifying cell of small intestine
CL:0009012.description: A rapidly proliferating population of cells that differentiate from stem cells of the intestinal crypt of the small intestine. Stem cells located in the crypts of Lieberkühn give rise to proliferating progenitor or transit amplifying cells that differentiate into the four major epithelial cell types. These include columnar absorptive cells or enterocytes, mucous secreting goblet cells, enteroendocrine cells and paneth cells.
synonyms: transient amplifying cell of crypt of Lieberkuhn of small intestine
transient amplifying cell of small intestine
transit amplifying cell of crypt of Lieberkuhn of small intestine

CL:0009013.label: fetal hepatobiliary progenitor cell
CL:0009013.description: A progenitor cell with hepatic and biliary lineage potential, identified in mouse and human, and anatomically restricted to the ductal plate of fetal liver.

CL:0009015.label: Peyer's patch follicular dendritic cell
CL:0009015.description: A follicular dendritic cell located in the Peyer's patch. These cells from a meshwork in which Peyer's patch B cells reside.

CL:0009016.label: intestinal crypt stem cell of large intestine
CL:0009016.description: An intestinal stem cell that is located in the large intestine crypt of Liberkuhn. These stem cells reside at the bottom of crypts in the large intestine and are highly proliferative. They either differentiate into transit amplifying cells or self-renew to form new stem cells.
synonyms: stem cell of large intestine crypt of Lieberkuhn

CL:0009017.label: intestinal crypt stem cell of small intestine
CL:0009017.description: An intestinal stem cell that is located in the small intestine crypt of Liberkuhn. These stem cells reside at the bottom of crypts in the small intestine and are highly proliferative. They either differentiate into transit amplifying cells or self-renew to form new stem cells.
synonyms: stem cell of small intestine crypt of Lieberkuhn

CL:0009018.label: lymphocyte of large intestine lamina propria
CL:0009018.description: A lymphocyte that resides in the lamina propria of the large intestine.
synonyms: lamina propria lymphocyte of large intestine

CL:0009019.label: nephrogenic zone cell
CL:0009019.description: A kidney cortical cell that is part of the nephrogenic zone.

CL:0009020.label: tuft cell of appendix
CL:0009020.description: An intestinal tuft cell that is a part of a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009021.label: stromal cell of lamina propria of large intestine
CL:0009021.description: A stromal cell found in the lamina propria of the large intestine.

CL:0009022.label: stromal cell of lamina propria of small intestine
CL:0009022.description: A stromal cell found in the lamina propria of the small intestine.

CL:0009023.label: small intestine Peyer's patch T cell
CL:0009023.description: A T cell which resides in the Peyer's patch of the small intestine.
synonyms: T cell of Peyer's patch of small intestine
T cell of small intestine Peyer's patch

CL:0009024.label: mesothelial cell of small intestine
CL:0009024.description: A mesothelial cell that is part of the small intestine.

CL:0009025.label: mesothelial cell of colon
CL:0009025.description: A mesothelial cell that is part of the colon.

CL:0009026.label: enterocyte of appendix
CL:0009026.description: An enterocyte that is a part of a vermiform appendix.

CL:1000405.label: epithelial cell of appendix
CL:1000405.description: An epithelial cell that is part of the appendix.

CL:0009027.label: transit amplifying cell of appendix
CL:0009027.description: A transit amplifying cell that is part of a crypt of Lieberkuhn of large intestine.
synonyms: transit amplifying cell of appendix vermiformis
transit amplifying cell of vermiform appendix

CL:0009028.label: intestinal crypt stem cell of appendix
CL:0009028.description: An intestinal crypt stem cell that is located in the vermiform appendix. These stem cells reside at the bottom of crypts in the appendix and are highly proliferative. They either differentiate into transit amplifying cells or self-renew to form new stem cells.
synonyms: intestinal crypt stem cell of appendix vermiformis
intestinal crypt stem cell of vermiform appendix
stem cell of intestinal crypt of Lieberkuhn of appendix
stem cell of intestinal crypt of Lieberkuhn of appendix vermiformis

CL:0009029.label: mesothelial cell of appendix
CL:0009029.description: A mesothelial cell that is located in a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009030.label: enteroendocrine cell of appendix
CL:0009030.description: An intestinal enteroendocrine cell that is located in a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009031.label: T cell of appendix
CL:0009031.description: A T cell that is located in a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009032.label: B cell of appendix
CL:0009032.description: A B cell that is located in a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009033.label: plasma cell of appendix
CL:0009033.description: A plasma cell that is located in a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009034.label: dendritic cell of appendix
CL:0009034.description: A dendritic cell that is located in a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009035.label: stromal cell of lamina propria of vermiform appendix
CL:0009035.description: A stromal cell found in the lamina propria of the vermiform appendix.
synonyms: stromal cell of appendix lamina propria
stromal cell of lamina propria of appendix vermiformis

CL:0009036.label: appendix macrophage
CL:0009036.description: A macrophage located in the vermiform appendix.

CL:0009037.label: lymph node mantle zone B cell
CL:0009037.description: A B lymphocyte that resides in the mantle zone of the lymph node germinal center. These are generally IgM and IgD positive activated B cells that form a 'corona' around the germinal center and are part of the establishment of a secondary lymphatic follicule.
synonyms: mantle zone B cell of lymph node

CL:0009038.label: colon macrophage
CL:0009038.description: A macrophage that is located in the colon.

CL:0009039.label: colon goblet cell
CL:0009039.description: A goblet cell that is located in the colon.

CL:0011108.label: colon epithelial cell
CL:0011108.description: Epithelial cell that is part of the colon epithelium.

CL:1000320.label: large intestine goblet cell
CL:1000320.description: A goblet cell that is part of the epithelium of large intestine.
synonyms: goblet cell of epithelium of large intestine

CL:0009040.label: stromal cell of lamina propria of colon
CL:0009040.description: A stromal cell found in the lamina propria of the colon.
synonyms: stromal cell of colon lamina propria

CL:0009041.label: tuft cell of colon
CL:0009041.description: A tuft cell that is part of the colonic epithelium, primarily adapted for microbial sensing in the dense colonic microbiota. Unlike its small intestinal counterpart, it does not participate in parasite-driven tuft cell–ILC2 circuits. Instead, it detects bacterial metabolites via taste-signaling pathways (Strine and Craig, 2022). The colonic tuft cell plays a key role in epithelial repair, modulates inflammatory responses through IL-25 secretion, and contributes to intestinal homeostasis by balancing microbiome interactions (Sebastian et al., 2021).

CL:0009043.label: intestinal crypt stem cell of colon
CL:0009043.description: An intestinal crypt stem cell that is located in the crypt of Lieberkuhn of colon.

CL:0009044.label: lymphocyte of small intestine lamina propria
CL:0009044.description: A lymphocyte that resides in the lamina propria of the small intestine. Lamina propria leukocytes and intraepithelial lymphocytes are the effector compartments of the gut mucosal immune system. Lymphocytes circulate through gut associated lymphoid tissues until recruitment by intestinal antigens. They are involved in the gut immune response.
synonyms: gastrointestinal tract (lamina propria) lymphocyte of small intestine
lamina propria lymphocyte of small intestine

CL:0009045.label: B cell of medullary sinus of lymph node
CL:0009045.description: A B cell found in the lymph node medullary sinus.

CL:0009046.label: T cell of medullary sinus of lymph node
CL:0009046.description: A T cell found in the lymph node medullary sinus.

CL:0009047.label: macrophage of medullary sinus of lymph node
CL:0009047.description: A macrophage found in the medullary sinus of the lymph node.

CL:0009048.label: anorectum macrophage
CL:0009048.description: A macrophage that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009049.label: smooth muscle cell of high endothelial venule of lymph node
CL:0009049.description: A layer of smooth muscle cells that forms the outer layer of the high endothelial venule of lymph node and pumps to allow flow of lymph fluid carrying lymphocytes.
synonyms: high endothelial venule of lymph node smooth muscle cell

CL:0009050.label: B cell of anorectum
CL:0009050.description: A B cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009051.label: T cell of anorectum
CL:0009051.description: A T cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009052.label: smooth muscle cell of anorectum
CL:0009052.description: A smooth muscle cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:1000279.label: smooth muscle cell of large intestine
CL:1000279.description: A smooth muscle cell that is part of the large intestine.
synonyms: non-striated muscle fiber of large intestine

CL:0009053.label: stromal cell of anorectum lamina propria
CL:0009053.description: A stromal cell found in the lamina propria of the anorectum.

CL:0009054.label: microfold cell of epithelium proper of anorectum
CL:0009054.description: A microfold cell (M cell) that is part of the anorectum.

CL:1000360.label: microfold cell of epithelium proper of large intestine
CL:1000360.description: A M cell that is part of the epithelium proper of large intestine.

CL:0009055.label: paneth cell of anorectum
CL:0009055.description: A paneth cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009056.label: transit amplifying cell of anorectum
CL:0009056.description: A transit amplifying cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009057.label: anorectum goblet cell
CL:0009057.description: A goblet cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009058.label: enterocyte of anorectum
CL:0009058.description: An enterocyte that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009059.label: plasma cell of medullary sinus of lymph node
CL:0009059.description: A plasma cell that is located in the medullary sinus of the lymph node.

CL:0009060.label: marginal zone B cell of lymph node
CL:0009060.description: A mature B cell located in the marginal zone of the lymph node.
synonyms: lymph node marginal zone B cell

CL:0009061.label: intestinal crypt stem cell of anorectum
CL:0009061.description: An intestinal crypt stem cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009062.label: germinal center T cell
CL:0009062.description: A specialized type of CD4 positive T cell, the follicular helper T cell (TFH cell), that upregulates CXCR5 expression to enable its follicular localization. These specialised T cells reside in the germinal center of the lymph node.
synonyms: T follicular helper cell of germinal center of lymph node
T follicular helper cell of lymph node germinal center
lymph node germinal center T follicular helper cell

CL:0009063.label: enteroendocrine cell of anorectum
CL:0009063.description: An enteroendocrine cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009064.label: lymph node paracortex T cell
CL:0009064.description: A T cell located in the lymph node paracortex, where macrophages and dendritic cells present antigenic peptides to these naïve T cells, stimulating them to become activated helper T cells or cytotoxic T lymphocytes.
synonyms: T cell of lymph node paracortex

CL:0009065.label: tuft cell of anorectum
CL:0009065.description: An intestinal tuft cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009066.label: stratified squamous epithelial cell of anal canal
CL:0009066.description: A stratified squamous epithelial cell that is part of the anal canal.
synonyms: anal canal stratified squamous epithelial cell

CL:0009067.label: vacuolated fetal-type enterocyte
CL:0009067.description: An enterocyte found in the small intestine of newborn mammals and characterized by the presence of an apical canalicular system (ACS) leading to production of large vacuoles, important for colostral macromolecule uptake. After birth, the vacuolated fetal-type enterocytes are replaced with enterocytes lacking an ACS.

CL:0009068.label: CD8aa(I) thymocyte
CL:0009068.description: An unconventional T lymphocyte population within the thymic medulla that is potentially a thymic resident population.

CL:0009069.label: CD8aa(II) thymocyte
CL:0009069.description: An unconventional T lymphocyte population within the thymic medulla that expresses both alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cell signatures.

CL:0009070.label: corticomedullary thymic epithelial cell
CL:0009070.description: A thymic epithelial cell located at the corticomedullary junction.

CL:0009071.label: medullary thymic epithelial cell type 1
CL:0009071.description: A thymic medullary epithelial cell considered to be a pre-AIRE mTEC population.

CL:0009072.label: medullary thymic epithelial cell type 2
CL:0009072.description: A thymic medullary epithelial cell that expresses AIRE or other canonical markers of mature mTECs like Fezf2.

CL:0009073.label: medullary thymic epithelial cell type 3
CL:0009073.description: A thymic medullary epithelial cell considered to be a post-AIRE cell. This group of AIRE-mTECs is heterogeneous and also includes mTECs within Hassall's Corpuscles.

CL:0009074.label: medullary thymic epithelial cell type 4
CL:0009074.description: A thymic medullary epithelial cell that expresses typical tuft cell markers instead of classical mTEC or cTEC markers. This population has a bulbous-like structure.

CL:0009075.label: myo-medullary thymic epithelial cell
CL:0009075.description: A thymic medullary epithelial cell that expresses muscle-specific biomarkers.

CL:0009076.label: neuro-medullary thymic epithelial cell
CL:0009076.description: A thymic medullary epithelial cell that expresses neuroendocrine biomarkers.

CL:0009077.label: subcapsular thymic epithelial cell
CL:0009077.description: A thymic epithelial cell located within the subcapsular region of the thymus.

CL:0009078.label: thymic fibroblast type 1
CL:0009078.description: A fibroblast located in the thymic capsule.

CL:4030001.label: stromal cell of thymus
CL:4030001.description: A stromal cell that is part of the thymus.

CL:0009079.label: thymic fibroblast type 2
CL:0009079.description: A fibroblast located between thymic lobules.

CL:0009080.label: tuft cell of small intestine
CL:0009080.description: A tuft cell located in the small intestine.
synonyms: brush cell of epithelium of small intestine
brush cell of epithelium proper of small intestine
tuft cell of epithelium of small intestine

CL:0009081.label: specified double negative thymocyte (Homo sapiens)
CL:0009081.description: The human equivalent of a DN2 thymocyte; typically contains two phases, in the latter of which these thymocytes begin the process of beta selection.

CL:0009082.label: committed double negative thymocyte (Homo sapiens)
CL:0009082.description: The human equivalent of a DN3 thymocyte; these thymocytes finish the process of beta selection.

CL:0009083.label: rearranging double negative thymocyte (Homo sapiens)
CL:0009083.description: The human equivalent of a DN4 thymocyte.

CL:0009085.label: colony forming unit – Hill cell
CL:0009085.description: An adult endothelial progenitor cell characterised in vivo by homing to ischemic sites and paracrine support of angiogenesis. They may form discrete colonies.

CL:0009086.label: endothelial cell of respiratory system lymphatic vessel
CL:0009086.description: An endothelial cell that is part of a respiratory system lymphatic vessel.

CL:0009087.label: fused extravillous trophoblast
CL:0009087.description: An extravillous trophoblast that is polynuclear.

CL:0009088.label: circulating angiogenic cell
CL:0009088.description: An adult endothelial progenitor cell characterised in vivo by homing to ischemic sites and paracrine support of angiogenesis. These cells do not form colonies.

CL:0009089.label: lung pericyte
CL:0009089.description: A pericyte cell that is part of a lung.

CL:0009090.label: endothelial colony forming cell
CL:0009090.description: An adult endothelial progenitor cell that is resident of adult vasculature and capable of differentiating to regenerate endothelial cell populations. Endothelial colony forming cells are characterised in vivo by clonal proliferative status, de novo vessel formation, homing to ischemic sites and paracrine support of angiogenesis. These cells are phenotypically similar to endothelial cells.

CL:0009092.label: endothelial cell of placenta
CL:0009092.description: An endothelial cell that is part of a placenta.

CL:0009093.label: smooth muscle cell of placenta
CL:0009093.description: A smooth muscle cell that is part of a placenta.

CL:0009094.label: endothelial cell of hepatic portal vein
CL:0009094.description: An endothelial cell that is part of a hepatic portal vein.

CL:0009095.label: endothelial cell of uterus
CL:0009095.description: An endothelial cell that is part of a uterus.

CL:0009096.label: esophagus non-keratinized squamous epithelial cell
CL:0009096.description: Any cell that is part of the esophageal non-keratinized stratified squamous epithelium. In humans, the esophagus, which requires flexibility to accommodate swallowing of a bolus, is covered with a non-keratinized epithelium.
synonyms: non-keratinized squamous epithelial cell of esophagus
non-keratinizing squamous epithelial cell of esophagus
nonkeratinized squamous epithelial cell of esophagus
nonkeratinizing squamous epithelial cell of esophagus

CL:0009097.label: embryonic skeletal muscle fiber
CL:0009097.description: A skeletal muscle fiber found in an embryo. In mammalian embryos, skeletal muscle expresses myosin heavy chain-embryonic (MyHC-emb, encoded by the MYH3 gene), which regulates skeletal muscle development.

CL:0009098.label: fetal and neonatal skeletal muscle fiber
CL:0009098.description: A skeletal muscle fiber found at the fetal and neonatal stages. In mammalian fetuses and neonates, skeletal muscle expresses myosin heavy chain-neonatal (MyHC-neo, encoded by the MYH8 gene). This expression disappears shortly after birth and is replaced by expression of adult heavy chain myosins.

CL:0009099.label: fibro/adipogenic progenitor cell
CL:0009099.description: A progenitor cell that is a tissue-resident mesenchymal cell, important for skeletal muscle regeneration, and able to differentiate into both adipocytes or fibroblasts.

CL:0009100.label: hepatic portal fibroblast
CL:0009100.description: A fibroblast located in the portal triad. Hepatic portal fibroblast are a non-parenchymal cell population located adjacent to bile duct epithelia in liver and are distinct from stellate cells. They differentiate into fibrogenic myofibroblasts during chronic injury states producing high levels of collagen.

CL:0009101.label: fibroblastic reticular cell
CL:0009101.description: A reticular cell involved in directing B cells and T cells to specific regions within a tissue.

CL:0009102.label: lymph node fibroblastic reticular cell
CL:0009102.description: A specialized, fibroblastic reticular cell of mesenchymal origin found in lymph nodes. In human, it expresses several markers common to myofibroblasts (desmin, vimentin, CD73, CD90, α-smooth muscle actin (αSMA)), and can be differentiated from endothelial cells by its lack of CD31 expression. These cells are critical for the overall organization and function of the lymph node. Lymph node fibroblastic reticular cells (FRCs) can be further classified based on their location, function, and unique marker expression.

CL:0009103.label: lymph node marginal reticular cell
CL:0009103.description: A fibroblastic reticular cell found in the lymph node subcapsular sinus.

CL:0009104.label: B cell zone reticular cell
CL:0009104.description: A fibroblastic reticular cell found in the lymph node germinal center dark zone (B cell zone).
synonyms: lymph node germinal center dark zone fibroblastic reticular cell

CL:0009105.label: T cell zone reticular cell
CL:0009105.description: A fibroblastic reticular cell found in the lymph node T cell domain.
synonyms: lymph node T cell domain fibroblastic reticular cell

CL:0009106.label: medullary reticular cell
CL:0009106.description: A specialized fibroblast found in the medulla of lymph node.
synonyms: medullary reticular cell of lymph node

CL:0009107.label: lymphatic endothelial cell of subcapsular sinus ceiling
CL:0009107.description: A lymphatic endothelial cell located in the subcapsular sinus ceiling of a lymph node. In human, it's characterized by a unique marker expression (NT5e+ and Caveolin-1+).
synonyms: lymphatic endothelial cell of subcapsular sinus ceiling of lymph node

CL:0009108.label: lymphatic endothelial cell of subcapsular sinus floor
CL:0009108.description: A lymphatic endothelial cell located in the subcapsular sinus floor of a lymph node. In human, it's characterized by a unique marker expression (TNFRSF9+).
synonyms: lymphatic endothelial cell of subcapsular sinus floor of lymph node

CL:0009109.label: lymphatic endothelial cell of trabecula
CL:0009109.description: A lymphatic endothelial cell located in a lymph node trabecula.
synonyms: lymphatic endothelial cell of lymph node trabecula

CL:0009110.label: lymphatic endothelial cell of medulla ceiling
CL:0009110.description: A lymphatic endothelial cell located in the ceiling part of a lymph node medulla.
synonyms: lymphatic endothelial cell of lymph node medulla ceiling

CL:0009111.label: centrocyte
CL:0009111.description: A germinal center B cell found in a lymph node germinal center light zone.

CL:0009112.label: centroblast
CL:0009112.description: A germinal center B cell found in a lymph node germinal center dark zone.

CL:0009113.label: T follicular regulatory cell
CL:0009113.description: A regulatory T cell present in the B cell follicles and germinal centers of lymphoid tissues. In humans, it is CXCR5+.

CL:0009114.label: monocytoid B cell
CL:0009114.description:
A B cell found in the perisinusoidal area of a lymph node. In humans, monocytoid B cells are a morphologically distinct B cell population
(oval nuclei, abundant cytoplasm, monocyte-like appearance), share many similarities with marginal zone B cells including marker expression, and are increased in disease settings.

CL:0009115.label: lymph node lymphatic vessel endothelial cell
CL:0009115.description: An endothelial cell located in a lymph node lymphatic vessel.

CL:0010000.label: keratinized cell of hair follicle
CL:0010000.description: A hair follicle matrix region cell which synthesizes keratin and undergoes a characteristic change as it moves upward from the hair bulb to become the hair medulla cortex and hair root sheath.

CL:0010002.label: epithelial cell of umbilical artery
CL:0010002.description: An epithelial cell that is part_of a umbilical artery.

CL:0010003.label: obsolete epithelial cell of alveolus of lung
CL:0010003.description: OBSOLETE. An epithelial cell that is part_of a alveolus of lung.
comments: This cell type is exactly the same as 'pulmonary alveolar epithelial cell'.

CL:0010005.label: atrioventricular bundle cell
CL:0010005.description: A specialized cardiomyocyte that transmit signals from the AV node to the cardiac Purkinje fibers.

CL:0010006.label: cardiac blood vessel endothelial cell
CL:0010006.description: Any blood vessel endothelial cell that is part of some heart.

CL:0010007.label: His-Purkinje system cell
CL:0010007.description: Any cell that is part of some His-Purkinje system.

CL:0010010.label: cerebellar stellate cell
CL:0010010.description: A GABAergic interneuron that is located in the molecular layer of the cerebellum. This cell receives excitatory inputs primarily from parallel fibers and plays a crucial role in feed-forward inhibition by suppressing the activity of Purkinje cells and modulating the output of the cerebellar cortex. The stellate cell is part of the local circuitry that contributes to the fine-tuning of motor coordination and a regulator of cerebellar blood flow via neurovascular coupling.

CL:0010015.label: coronet cell
CL:0010015.description: A highly specialized cell type exclusive to and forming neuroepithelium of the Saccus vasculosus, covering the caudal diverticulum of the infundibular recess.

CL:0010016.label: collar cell
CL:0010016.description: A cell with a flagellum surrounded by a collar of microvilli. The motion of the flagellum draws water past the microvilli, serving either a feeding or sensory function. Collar cells are found in multiple animals, including sponges, echinoderms, and cnidarians. They are also found outside animals in the choanoflagellates. Although collar cells are superficially similar, their cytoskeletal structure and functional biology are different in different groups of organisms.

CL:0010020.label: cardiac glial cell
CL:0010020.description: Any glial cell that is part of some heart.

CL:0010022.label: cardiac neuron
CL:0010022.description: A neuron that has its soma in the heart.

CL:0011000.label: dorsal horn interneuron
CL:0011000.description: A CNS interneuron located in the dorsal horn of the spinal cord.

CL:0011002.label: lateral motor column neuron
CL:0011002.description: A motor neuron that is generated only on limb levels and send axons into the limb mesenchyme.

CL:0011003.label: magnocellular neurosecretory cell
CL:0011003.description: A neurosecretory neuron residing mainly in the hypothalamic supraoptic and paraventricular nuclei and in a number of smaller accessory cell groups between these two nuclei, that is capable of secreting the hormones oxytocin or vasopressin, and sometimes both, into the systemic circulation.

CL:0011006.label: Lugaro cell
CL:0011006.description: A cerebellar interneuron characterized by a spindle-shaped or triangular soma, parasagittally oriented and located at the border between the granular layer and the Purkinje cell layer. The Lugaro cell extends dendrites predominantly in the parasagittal plane, forming synaptic interactions with basket, stellate, and Golgi cells. Its axonal projections extend upward into the molecular layer, where they form a parasagittal plexus and emit long transverse collaterals that run parallel to the long axis of the cerebellar folia. The Lugaro cell is capable of co-releasing GABA and glycine, as evidenced by the expression of glutamate decarboxylase (GAD65/67) and the glycine transporter GlyT2.

CL:0011007.label: paraxial cell
CL:0011007.description: A cell in the area of mesoderm in the neurulating embryo that flanks and forms simultaneously with the neural tube. The cells of this region give rise to somites.

CL:0011010.label: lateral mesodermal cell
CL:0011010.description: A cell derived from the mesoderm that is found at the periphery of the embryo.

CL:0011011.label: intermediate mesodermal cell
CL:0011011.description: A cell derived from the mesoderm that is located between the paraxial mesoderm and the lateral plate.

CL:0011013.label: motile sperm cell
CL:0011013.description: A sperm cell that is cabaple of motion (motility).

CL:0011014.label: non-motile sperm cell
CL:0011014.description: A sperm cell that is not cabaple of motion (motility).

CL:0011015.label: amoeboid sperm cell
CL:0011015.description: A motile sperm cell that contain no F-actin, and their motility is powered by a dynamic filament system.

CL:0011016.label: flagellated sperm cell
CL:0011016.description: A motile sperm cell that contains a slender threadlike microscopic appendage that enables motion.

CL:0011017.label: vagal neural crest cell
CL:0011017.description: Cell that is part of the vagal neural crest population. The vagal neural crest arises from the axial level of somites 1-7 and has been described as a hybrid between the head and the trunk populations.

CL:0011018.label: lymphoid tissue–inducer cell
CL:0011018.description: A group 3 innate lymphoid cell that express ROR gamma t and IL-7R alpha in the absence of lineage markers (e.g. CD3, CD19, B220, CD11c, Gr-1), with the functional ability to interact with mesenchymal cells through lymphotoxin and tumor necrosis factor. Lymphoid tissue-inducer cells are key to the development of lymph nodes and Peyer’s patches.

CL:0011019.label: mesothelial cell of epicardium
CL:0011019.description: A mesothelial cell that is part of the epicardium.

CL:0011021.label: fibroblast of upper back skin
CL:0011021.description: A fibroblast that is part of upper back skin.

CL:0011022.label: fibroblast of skin of back
CL:0011022.description: A fibroblast that is part of skin of back.

CL:0011023.label: CD25+ mast cell
CL:0011023.description: A mast cell that is CD25+.

CL:0011024.label: double negative T regulatory cell
CL:0011024.description: A double negative thymocyte that is CD3-positive, CD4-negative, CD8-negative, that that are present in the periphery in very low numbers and predominantly produce INF-gamma, TNF-alpha, and a low amount of TGF-beta, but not IL-2, IL-4, IL-10 or IL-13 upon activation.
synonyms: CD4-negative, CD8-negative, alpha-beta regulatory T cells

CL:0011025.label: exhausted T cell
CL:0011025.description: An effector T cell that displays impaired effector functions (e.g., rapid production of effector cytokines, cytotoxicity) and has limited proliferative potential.

CL:0011027.label: skeletal muscle fibroblast
CL:0011027.description: Any fibroblast that is part of skeletal muscle tissue.

CL:0011028.label: olfactory ensheathing cell
CL:0011028.description: A neural-crest derived glial cell that supports the growth and survival of primary olfactory neuroons from the neuroepithelium in the nasal cavity to the brain by encasing large bundles of numerous unmyelinated axons.

CL:0011029.label: cnidocyte
CL:0011029.description: An explosive cell containing one giant secretory organelle called a cnidocyst (also known as a cnida (plural cnidae) or nematocyst) that contains a toxin responsible for the stings delivered by a cnidarian to other organisms. Cnidae are used to capture prey and as a defense against predators. The presence of cnidocytes defines the phylum Cnidaria (corals, sea anemones, hydrae, jellyfish, etc.).

CL:0011030.label: dermal microvascular endothelial cell
CL:0011030.description: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of the dermis.

CL:0011031.label: monocyte-derived dendritic cell
CL:0011031.description: A dendritic cell that develops from a monocyte.

CL:0011032.label: lysosome-rich enterocyte
CL:0011032.description: An enterocyte that possesses a large supranuclear vacuolar system that preferentially internalizes dietary protein via receptor-mediated and fluid-phase endocytosis for intracellular digestion and trans-cellular transport. In zebrafish these cells are located in the posterior region of the mid intestine throughout life. In mammals they are found in the ileum pre-weaning and later are replaced by mature enterocytes.

CL:0011100.label: galanergic neuron
CL:0011100.description: Neuron that secretes the neurotransmitter galanin.

CL:0011101.label: chorionic trophoblast cell
CL:0011101.description: Cells of the uterine chorion that acquire specialized structural and/or functional features that characterize chorionic trophoblasts. These cells will migrate towards the spongiotrophoblast layer and give rise to syncytiotrophoblasts of the labyrinthine layer.

CL:0011103.label: sympathetic neuron
CL:0011103.description: Sympathetic neurons are part of the sympathetic nervous system and are primarily adrenergic producing the neurotransmitter noradrenalin along with other neuropeptides.

CL:0011104.label: interplexiform cell
CL:0011104.description:
A type of interneuron in the retinal inner nuclear layer which
carries information from the inner plexiform layer and the outer
plexiform layer.

CL:0011105.label: dopamanergic interplexiform cell
CL:0011105.description:
A type of interneuron in the retinal inner nuclear layer which
carries information from the inner plexiform layer and the outer
plexiform layer, using dopamine.

CL:0011106.label: GABAnergic interplexiform cell
CL:0011106.description:

plexiform layer using GABA.

CL:0011107.label: obsolete Muller cell
CL:0011107.description: OBSOLETE: Astrocyte-like radial glial cell that extends vertically throughout the retina, with the nucleus are usually in the middle of the inner nuclear layer.
comments: Term was duplicated, use CL:0000636 instead

CL:0011109.label: hypocretin-secreting neuron
CL:0011109.description: A neuron that releases hypocretin as a neurotransmitter.

CL:0011111.label: hypothalamic gonadotropin-releasing hormone neuron
CL:0011111.description: a specialized neuroendocrine cell that synthesizes and secretes GnRH decapeptide, a key regulator of reproductive function. It originates from the olfactory placode during embryonic development and migrates into the forebrain where it localises predominantly in the hypothalamus and in humans, in extrahypothalamic regions like the basal ganglia (Skrapits et al., 2021). This cell regulates reproduction by secreting GnRH into the pituitary portal vessels to induce the release of gonadotropins into the general circulation. It expresses receptor subunits required for AMPA, NMDA, and kainate receptor signaling and may use glutamate as a neurotransmitter in recurrent collateral innervation.

CL:0011112.label: obsolete magnocellular neurosecretory cell
CL:0011112.description: OBSOLETE: Neurons part of the hypothalamic supraoptic and paraventricular nuclei that secrete the hormones, oxytocin and vasopressin into the systemic circulation from the posterior pituitary gland.
comments: Duplicated term, please see CL:0011003 instead

CL:0011113.description: Neuron found in the spiral ganglion.

CL:0011114.label: segmented neutrophil of bone marrow
CL:0011114.description: A segmented neutrophilic cell of the bone marrow reserve pool that expresses CD11b (integrin alpha-M) and high levels of CD16 (low affinity immunoglobulin gamma Fc region receptor III) on its cell surface.

CL:0013000.description: Any radial glial cell that is part of some forebrain.

CL:0017000.description: An ionocyte that is part of the lung epithelium. The cells from this type are major sources of the CFTR protein in human and mice.

CL:0019015.description: An eosinophil with a ring-shaped nucleus that is resident in the lung parenchyma. In mouse, lung parenchyma resident eosinophils are IL-5-independent Siglec-F(intermediate) CD62L+ CD101(low). In human, they are Siglec-8+ CD62L+ IL-3R(low).

CL:0019020.label: extrahepatic cholangiocyte

CL:0019021.label: endothelial cell of periportal hepatic sinusoid
CL:0019021.description: An endothelial cell found in the periportal region hepatic sinusoid, near the portal triad. The fenestrae of these cells are larger but fewer in number compared with those of endothelial cells near the centrilobular region of the hepatic sinusoid.

CL:0019022.label: endothelial cell of pericentral hepatic sinusoid
CL:0019022.description: An endothelial cell found in the centrilobular region hepatic sinusoid, near the central vein. The fenestrae of these cells are smaller but more numerous compared with those of endothelial cells near the periportal region of the hepatic sinusoid.
synonyms: central venous hepatic sinusoidal endothelial cell

CL:0019026.label: periportal region hepatocyte
CL:0019026.description: Any hepatocyte that is part of the liver lobule periportal region. These cells are primarily involved in oxidative energy metabolism.

CL:0019028.label: midzonal region hepatocyte
CL:0019028.description: Any hepatocyte that is part of the liver lobule midzonal region. These cells have mixed functionality in comparison with those in the other two regions of the liver lobule.

CL:0019029.label: centrilobular region hepatocyte
CL:0019029.description: Any hepatocyte that is part of the liver lobule centrilobular region. These cells are the primary location for the biotransformation of drugs.

CL:0019031.label: intestine goblet cell
CL:0019031.description: Goblet cells reside throughout the length of the small and large intestine and are responsible for the production and maintenance of the protective mucus blanket by synthesizing and secreting high-molecular-weight glycoproteins known as mucins. Human intestinal goblet cells secrete the MUC2 mucin, as well as a number of typical mucus components: CLCA1, FCGBP, AGR2, ZG16, and TFF3.

CL:1000223.label: pulmonary neuroendocrine cell
CL:1000223.description: A neuroendocrine cell that is part of respiratory epithelium of the lung and is involved in the sensory detection of environmental stimuli, including hypoxia, nicotine and air pressure. Ultrastructurally, this cell type is characterized by the presence of cytoplasmic dense core granules, which are considered the storage sites of amine and peptide hormones. Pulmonary neuroendocrine cells are innervated and appear as solitary cells or as clustered masses, localized at airway bifurcation sites, called neuroepithelial bodies that can release serotonin in response to hypoxia and interact with sensory nerve terminals. Pulmonary neuroendocrine cells also function as reserve stem cells that repair the surrounding epithelium after injury.

CL:1001097.label: kidney afferent arteriole smooth muscle cell
CL:1001097.description: A smooth muscle cell found in the wall of the afferent arteriole. This cell contracts and relaxes in response to changes in blood pressure, a process known as a myogenic response, to alter artery diameter and regulate blood flow into the glomeruli.

CL:2000027.label: cerebellar basket cell
CL:2000027.description: A GABAergic inhibitory interneuron located in the molecular layer of the cerebellar cortex. It projects axons that form specialized synaptic structures around Purkinje cells, including pericellular baskets, which wrap around the Purkinje cell soma, and the pinceau: a brush-like terminal that contacts the initial segment of the Purkinje cell axon. The basket cell modulates Purkinje cell activity through both chemical (GABAergic) and non-synaptic (ephaptic) mechanisms. It is arranged in sagittal rows that align with Purkinje cell zones, contributing to the cerebellum's modular and topographically organized architecture. It plays an essential role in regulating motor coordination and potentially cognitive functions.

CL:2000030.label: hypothalamus cell
CL:2000030.description: Any native cell that is part of a hypothalamus.

CL:2000033.label: limb basal cell of epidermis

CL:2000048.description: A lower motor neuron whose soma is located in the anterior horn. Anterior horn motor neurons project from the anterior portion of the grey matter in the spinal cord to some skeletal muscles.

CL:2000053.description: Any endothelial cell that is part of a spleen.

CL:2000054.label: hepatic pit cell
CL:2000054.description: A large, granular, liver specific natural killer cell that adheres to the endothelial cells of the hepatic sinusoid.

CL:2000055.label: liver dendritic cell
CL:2000055.description: Any dendritic cell that is part of a liver.

CL:2000056.label: Meynert cell
CL:2000056.description: Any pyramidal cell that is part of a regional part of cerebral cortex.

CL:2000057.label: femoral osteoblast
CL:2000057.description: Any osteoblast that is part of a femur.

CL:2000058.label: calvarial osteoblast
CL:2000058.description: Any osteoblast that is part of a skull.

CL:2000059.label: prostate gland microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000059.description: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of a prostate gland.

CL:2000060.label: placental villous trophoblast
CL:2000060.description: A trophoblast of placental villi.  These cells fuse to form synctial  trophoplast - the placental side of the interface between the placenta and maternal blood sinusoids in the decidua.

CL:2000061.label: placental amniotic mesenchymal stromal cell
CL:2000061.description: Any mesenchymal stem cell that is part of a placenta.

CL:2000062.label: placental villus capillary endothelial cell
CL:2000062.description: Any capillary endothelial cell that is part of a placenta.

CL:2000063.label: ovarian fibroblast
CL:2000063.description: Any fibroblast that is part of a female gonad.

CL:2000064.label: ovarian surface epithelial cell
CL:2000064.description: A meso-epithelial cell of the ovarian surface epithelium, varying in shape from flat to cuboidal to pseudostratified columnar. This cell plays a crucial role in ovulation by producing proteolytic enzymes in response to gonadotropins, facilitating follicle rupture through tissue breakdown and TNF-alpha signaling. Additionally, this cell contributes to post-ovulatory wound repair (Morris et al., 2022) and exhibits stem cell-like properties (Flesken-Nikitin et al., 2013; Wang et al., 2019).

CL:2000065.label: ovarian microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000065.description: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of a female urethra.

CL:2000066.label: cardiac ventricle fibroblast
CL:2000066.description: Any fibroblast that is part of a cardiac ventricle.

CL:2000067.label: cardiac atrium fibroblast
CL:2000067.description: Any fibroblast that is part of a cardiac atrium.

CL:2000068.description: Any fibroblast that is part of a pericardium.

CL:2000069.description: Any fibroblast that is part of a gallbladder.

CL:2000070.label: optic choroid fibroblast
CL:2000070.description: Any fibroblast that is part of a optic choroid.

CL:2000071.label: mammary microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000071.description: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of a breast.

CL:2000072.label: adipose microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000072.description: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of a adipose tissue.

CL:2000075.label: anterior visceral endoderm cell
CL:2000075.description: Any endodermal cell that is part of a anterior visceral endoderm.

CL:2000076.label: hindlimb stylopod vein endothelial cell
CL:2000076.description: Any vein endothelial cell that is part of a hindlimb stylopod.

CL:2000077.label: skeletal muscle tissue of pectoralis major striated muscle cell
CL:2000077.description: Any striated muscle cell that is part of a skeletal muscle tissue of pectoralis major.

CL:2000079.label: mesenchymal stem cell of femoral bone marrow
CL:2000079.description: Any mesenchymal stem cell of the bone marrow that is part of a femur.

CL:2000080.label: mesenchymal stem cell of abdominal adipose tissue
CL:2000080.description: Any mesenchymal stem cell of adipose tissue that is part of an abdomen.
synonyms: mesenchymal stem cell of abdominal adipose

CL:2000081.label: melanocyte of skin of face
CL:2000081.description: Any melanocyte of skin that is part of a skin of face.

CL:2000082.label: obsolete melanocyte of foreskin
CL:2000082.description: OBSOLETE. Any melanocyte of skin that is part of a skin of prepuce of penis.
comments: Term was merged into foreskin melanocyte CL_2000045

CL:2000083.label: hair follicle dermal papilla cell of scalp
CL:2000083.description: Any hair follicle dermal papilla cell that is part of a scalp.

CL:2000084.label: conjunctiva goblet cell
CL:2000084.description: A goblet cell that is part of the conjunctival epithelium, characterized by apical accumulation of mucin granules (containing MUC5AC in humans; Muc5ac/Muc5b in mice). These gel-forming mucins support tear film stability, ocular lubrication, and pathogen defence. The conjunctival goblet cell forms tight junctions with neighbouring epithelial cells via species-specific claudins (claudin-10 in humans, claudin-2 in mice) and regulates immune homeostasis by facilitating soluble antigen transport to dendritic cells through goblet cell-associated antigen passages (GAPs) (Barbosa et al., 2017). The transcription factor SPDEF is essential for its differentiation.

CL:2000085.label: mononuclear cell of umbilical cord
CL:2000085.description: Any mononuclear cell that is part of a umbilical cord.

CL:2000086.label: neocortex basket cell
CL:2000086.description: Any basket cell that is part of a neocortex.

CL:2000087.label: dentate gyrus of hippocampal formation basket cell
CL:2000087.description: Any basket cell that is part of a dentate gyrus of hippocampal formation.

CL:2000088.label: Ammon's horn basket cell
CL:2000088.description: Any basket cell that is part of a Ammon's horn.

CL:2000089.label: dentate gyrus granule cell
CL:2000089.description: A granule cell that has soma location in the dentate gyrus cell layer of the hippocampal formation and has an elliptical cell body and characteristic cone-shaped tree of spiny apical dendrites. The branches extend throughout the molecular layer and the distal tips of the dendritic tree end just at the hippocampal fissure or at the ventricular surface. The dentate gyrus granule cell is the principal cell type of the dentate gyrus.
synonyms: dentate gyrus of hippocampal formation granule cell

CL:2000090.label: dentate gyrus of hippocampal formation stellate cell
CL:2000090.description: Any stellate cell that is part of a dentate gyrus of hippocampal formation.

CL:2000091.label: endometrial microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000091.description: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of a endometrial blood vessel.

CL:2000092.label: hair follicular keratinocyte
CL:2000092.description: Any keratinocyte that is part of a hair follicle.

CL:2000093.label: bronchus fibroblast of lung
CL:2000093.description: Any fibroblast of lung that is part of a bronchus.

CL:2000094.label: nasal cavity respiratory epithelium epithelial cell of viscerocranial mucosa
CL:2000094.description: Any epithelial cell of viscerocranial mucosa that is part of a nasal cavity respiratory epithelium.

CL:2000095.label: cord blood hematopoietic stem cell
CL:2000095.description: Any hematopoietic stem cell that is part of a umbilical cord blood.

CL:2000096.label: fibroblast of the reticular layer of dermis
CL:2000096.description: Any fibroblast that is part of a reticular layer of dermis.

CL:2000097.label: midbrain dopaminergic neuron
CL:2000097.description: Any dopaminergic neuron that is part of a midbrain.

CL:3000000.label: ciliated epithelial cell of esophagus
CL:3000000.description: A ciliated epithelial cell of the esophagus.

CL:3000001.label: Hofbauer cell
CL:3000001.description: A tissue-resident macrophage that is part of the placenta. A Hofbauer cell expresses high levels of growth factors and metalloproteinases that support vasculogenesis, angiogenesis, branching morphogenesis and tissue remodeling. A Hofbauer cell has a fetal origin, is found in the villous stroma, chorion, and amnion, and is present throughout pregnancy.

CL:3000003.label: sympathetic cholinergic neuron
CL:3000003.description: A type of autonomic neuron that releases acetylcholine.

CL:4006001.label: fibroblast of skin of scalp
CL:4006001.description: A fibroblast that is part of the skin of scalp.

CL:4023000.label: beta motor neuron
CL:4023000.description: A motor neuron that innervates both intrafusal and extrafusal muscle fibers. Low abundancy. They control both muscle contraction and responsiveness of the sensory feedback from muscle spindles.

CL:4023001.label: static beta motor neuron
CL:4023001.description: A beta motor neuron that innervates nuclear chain fibers.

CL:4023002.label: dynamic beta motor neuron
CL:4023002.description: A beta motor neuron that innervates the nuclear bag fibers of muscle spindles.

CL:4023003.label: nuclear chain fiber
CL:4023003.description: A type of intrafusal muscle fiber that has nuclei arranged in a linear row. Unlike nuclear bag fibers, the equatorial region of these fibers (in the centre of the spindle) is not expanded. These fibers are responsible for the detection of changes in muscle length. They are innervated by static gamma motor neurons and are principally associated with type II sensory fibers.

CL:4023004.label: nuclear bag fiber
