CL:4023004.description: A type of intrafusal muscle fiber that lies in the center of a muscle spindle. Nuclei are clustered centrally and give the equatorial region a swollen appearance. They are associated with associated with dynamic gamma motor neurons, and the stretching of the equatorial region of the nuclear bag fibers results in an increase in the firing rate of type Ia sensory fibers.

CL:4023005.label: dynamic nuclear bag fiber
CL:4023005.description: A nuclear bag fiber that is sensitive mainly to the rate of change in muscle length.

CL:4023006.label: static nuclear bag fiber
CL:4023006.description: A nuclear bag fiber that is sensitive only changes in muscle length but not the rate of that change.

CL:4023007.label: L2/3 bipolar VIP GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023007.description: A VIP GABAergic cortical interneuron with bipolar morphology, with a soma found in L2/3. L2/3 bipolar VIP cells have extending axons across all layers (with preferences for layers II/III and Va) and a dendritic tree that is vertically more restricted than deeper layer VIP cells and extend fewer dendrites into the layers outside their home layer (location of soma). L2/3 bipolar VIP cells have great variability in firing patterns, though most are continuous adapting. L2/3 bipolar VIP cells are more depolarized in their resting state, had less fast rectification, and had smaller after hyperpolarization than deeper VIP cells.

CL:4023008.label: intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron
CL:4023008.description: A glutamatergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that projects to structures of telencephalic origins.

CL:4023009.label: extratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron
CL:4023009.description: A glutamatergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that projects to structures not derived from telencephalon.

CL:4023010.label: alpha7 GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023010.description: A GABAergic cortical interneuron that is strongly labelled for α7 nAChRs. These cells have soma found in L1 and have multipolar dendrites with vertically descending axonal collaterals that project deep into the column, usually branching and terminating in L5A.

CL:4023011.label: lamp5 GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023011.description: A transcriptomically distinct GABAergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that expresses Lamp5. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: CGE-derived interneurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters Lamp5.

CL:4023012.label: near-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron
CL:4023012.description: A glutamatergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that projects axons locally rather than distantly.

CL:4023013.label: corticothalamic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron
CL:4023013.description: A glutamatergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that projects to the thalamus.

CL:4023014.label: L5 VIP GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023014.description: A VIP GABAergic cortical interneuron with a soma found in L5. L5 VIP cells have mostly local morphology with some deep-projecting axons. They show only moderate resistance, comparable to that of sst subclass and unlike typical VIP subclass cells that tend to show high input resistance. L5 VIP cells show particularly low resting membrane potential.

CL:4023015.label: sncg GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023015.description: A transcriptomically distinct GABAergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that expresses Gamma-synuclein. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: CGE-derived interneurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters Sncg.

CL:4023016.label: VIP GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023016.description: A transcriptomically distinct cortical GABAergic neuron that expresses the vasocactive intestinal polypeptide and that has its soma located in the cerebral cortex. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: CGE-derived interneurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', cluster Vip.

CL:4023017.label: sst GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023017.description: A transcriptomically distinct GABAergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that expresses somatostatin (sst). The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: MGE-derived interneurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', cluster Sst.

CL:4023018.label: pvalb GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023018.description: A transcriptomically distinct GABAergic interneuron with a soma located in a cerebral cortex and it expresses Parvalbumin. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: MGE-derived interneurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', cluster Pvalb.

CL:4023019.label: L5/6 cck, VIP GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023019.description: A VIP GABAergic cortical interneuron that expresses cck. L5/6 cck cells have soma found mainly in L5 and L6 and have large axonal arborization.

CL:4023020.label: dynamic gamma motor neuron
CL:4023020.description: A gamma motor neuron that innervates dynamic nuclear bag fibers (bag1 fibers) and enhances the sensitivities of Ia sensory neurons. They alter muscle spindle sensitivity and increases its discharge in response to velocity of muscle length (rather than just magnitude).

CL:4023021.label: static gamma motor neuron
CL:4023021.description: A gamma motor neuron that innervates static nuclear bag fibers (bag2 fibers) and increases their firing, in response to an increase in the magnitude of change in length, and controls the static sensitivity of the stretch reflex.

CL:4023022.label: canopy lamp5 GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023022.description: A Lamp5 GABAergic cortical interneuron that has extended axons in the surface of L1. Canopy Lamp5 cells resemble neurogliaform cells in having elongated horizontal axonal arbors largely confined to L1; but the dendritic arbors are wider and have fewer branches, while the axon is less tortuous and extends further from the soma

CL:4023023.label: L5,6 neurogliaform lamp5 GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023023.description: A lamp 5 GABAergic cortical interneuron with neurogliaform morphology with a soma found in L5,6. L5,6 NGC lamp5 have deep afterhyperpolarization (AHP) but narrow action potentials (APs). Unlike other deep neurogliaform cells (which are caudal ganglionic eminence (CGE) derived), L5,6 NGC lamp5 cells are medial ganglionic eminence (MGE)-derived

CL:4023024.label: neurogliaform lamp5 GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023024.description: A lamp5 GABAergic cortical interneuron with layer-adapting morphology. NGC lamp5 cells have a small round soma, short dendrites, and a wide dense axonal arbor that tends to establish a dense axonal mesh with high connection probability both to themselves and L2 pyramidal cells. NGC lamp5 cells have unique synaptic properties that distinguish them from other GABAergic interneurons, including the release of GABA to the extracellular space via volume transmission, and the ability to produce GABA-B responses in connected postsynaptic targets.

CL:4023025.label: long-range projecting sst GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023025.description: A sst GABAergic cortical interneuron that is both an interneuron and a projecting neuron. They are found in all layers from upper L2/3 down to the bottom of L6. They have long-range projections, some with axons fading into white matter. These cells have low rebound potential, low hyperpolarization sag, and high variability in membrane time constant.

CL:4023026.label: direct pathway medium spiny neuron
CL:4023026.description: A medium spiny neuron that expresses dopamine type 1 receptors and projects to the globus pallidus internus or the substantia nigra pars reticulata.

CL:4023027.label: L5 sst T-Martinotti interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023027.description: A sst GABAergic cortical interneuron with a soma found in L5 and possesses 'T-shaped' Martinotti morphologies with local axonal plexus in L5a and translaminar axons restricted to the uppermost part of L1. They show low-threshold spiking patterns with strong rebound firing, and inhibit the L1 apical tuft of nearby pyramidal cells.

CL:4023028.label: L5 non-Martinotti sst GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023028.description: A sst GABAergic cortical interneuron with a soma found in lower L5 with mostly local axonal arborization but with some sparse ascending axons. L5 non-Martinotti sst cells show somatic localization and local axon plexus in L5b and L5b/6 and substantial innervation of L3 and L4, and receive thalamic input from the ventral posteromedial nucleus and specifically target L4 neurons, avoiding L5 pyramidal cells. L5 non-Martinotti sst cells tend to show a higher input resistance and seem to be less stuttering.

CL:4023029.label: indirect pathway medium spiny neuron
CL:4023029.description: A medium spiny neuron that expresses dopamine type 2 receptors and projects to the external globus pallidus.

CL:4023030.label: L2/3/5 fan Martinotti sst GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023030.description: A sst GABAergic cortical interneuron that has "fanning-out' Martinotti morphology that is found in layer 2/3/5 of the cerebral cortex. They have local axon arbor and long ascending axons that spreads horizontally and arborizes significantly in L1.

CL:4023031.label: L4 sst Martinotti interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023031.description: A sst GABAergic cortical interneuron with a soma found in lower L2/3 and upper 5, L4 Sst cells have Martinotti morphology with ascending axons but denser local axons and sparser ‘fanning-out’ projections to L1. L4 sst cells have smaller membrane time constant to calb2 (L2/3/5 fan Martinotti Cell) and non-zero afterdepolarization (ADP).

CL:4023034.label: obsolete L2/3 pvalb-like sst GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mus musculus)
CL:4023034.description: OBSOLETE A sst GABAergic cortical interneuron transcriptomically between the sst and the pvalb families with a soma found in L2/3. Some L2/3 PV-like sst cells have Martinotti morphology while some have basket cell morphology. L2/3 PV-like sst cells have lower AP width and higher firing rate than typical Sst subclass cells. L2/3 PV-like sst cells have high maximum firing rate variability, with many classified as belonging to the pvalb subclass on the basis of electrophysiology.
comments: Moved to PCL. Use PCL:1000002 instead.

CL:4023035.label: lateral ganglionic eminence derived neuron
CL:4023035.description: A neuron that is derived from a precursor cell in the lateral ganglion eminence.

CL:4023036.label: chandelier pvalb GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023036.description: A transcriptomically distinct pvalb GABAergic cortical interneuron that is recognizable by the straight terminal axonal 'cartridges' of vertically oriented strings of synaptic boutons. Chandelier PV cells' boutons target exclusively the axon initial segment (AIS) of pyramidal cells, with a single cell innervating hundreds of pyramidal cells in a clustered manner. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: CGE-derived interneurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters Chandelier.

CL:4023038.label: L6b glutamatergic cortical neuron
CL:4023038.description: A glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 6b. They are transcriptomically related to corticothalamic-projecting neurons but have differential projections to the thalamus or anterior cingulate. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: Deep layer (non-IT) excitatory neuron', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', cluster L6b.

CL:4023039.label: amygdala excitatory neuron
CL:4023039.description: Any neuron that has its soma located in some amygdala and is capable of some glutamate secretion, neurotransmission.

CL:4023040.label: L2/3-6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4023040.description: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layers L2/3-6.

CL:4023042.label: L6 corticothalamic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron
CL:4023042.description: A transcriptomically distinct corticothalamic-projecting neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 6. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: Deep layer (non-IT) excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters L6 CT.

CL:4023043.label: L5/6 near-projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023043.description: A transcriptomically distinct near-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 5/6 of the primary motor cortex. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: Deep layer (non-IT) excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', cluster L5/6 NP.

CL:4023044.label: non-medulla, extratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023044.description: An extratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron located in layer 5b of the primary motor cortex that does not project to the medulla. Non-MY ET cells are large, big-tufted cells with the apical dendrite often bifurcating close to the soma, suggesting they are corticospinal cells. Non-MY ET cells have bigger hyperpolarization sag, lower input resistance, and smaller AP width, compared to L5 IT neurons.

CL:4023045.label: medulla-projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023045.description: An extratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron located in layer 5b of the primary motor cortex that projects to the medulla. MY ET cells are large, big-tufted cells with the apical dendrite often bifurcating close to the soma, suggesting they are corticospinal cells. MY ET cells have bigger hyperpolarization sag, lower input resistance, and smaller AP width, compared to L5 IT neurons.
synonyms: medulla-projecting extratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex

CL:4023046.label: L6b glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023046.description: An excitatory glutamatergic neuron transcriptomically related to the CT subclass, with a soma preferentially located in the bottom of L6 of the primary motor cortex.
synonyms: L6b subplate glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex

CL:4023047.label: L2/3 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023047.description: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 2/3 of the primary motor cortex.

CL:4023048.label: L4/5 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023048.description: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic with a soma located in upper L5 of the primary motor cortex. These cells have thin untufted apical dendrites.

CL:4023049.label: L5 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023049.description: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in L5 of the primary motor cortex.

CL:4023050.label: L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023050.description: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in L6 of the primary motor cortex. These cells are short untufted pyramidal cells, which could be stellate or inverted.

CL:4023051.label: vascular leptomeningeal cell
CL:4023051.description: A transcriptomically distinct type of mesothelial fibroblast that is derived from the neural crest, is localized on blood vessels, and is a key component of the pia and arachnoid membranes surrounding the brain. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: Non-neuronal cells', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters VLMC.

CL:4023052.label: Betz upper motor neuron
CL:4023052.description: A Betz cell that synapses with lower motor neurons directly.

CL:4023053.label: spinal interneuron synapsing Betz cell
CL:4023053.description: A Betz cell that syanpses with spinal interneurons.

CL:4023054.label: mesothelial fibroblast
CL:4023054.description: A mesothelial cell that has undergone mesothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (MMT) to become a fibroblast cell.

CL:4023055.label: corticothalamic VAL/VM projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023055.description: A corticothalamic-projecting glutamatergic neuron that is located in L6 and lower L5 of the primary motor cortex, with a pyramidal morphology and mostly untufted apical dendrites terminating in midcortical layers. CT VAL/VM (ventroanterior-ventrolateral complex/ventromedial nucleus) cells have a near tonic firing pattern and are distinguished from L6 IT neurons by a lower inter-spike interval adaptation index.

CL:4023056.label: vascular leptomeningeal cell (Mmus)
CL:4023056.description: A type of mouse mesothelial fibroblast that is derived from the neural crest, is localized on blood vessels, and is a key component of the pia and arachnoid membranes surrounding the brain.

CL:4023058.label: mesothelial fibroblast of the leptomeninx
CL:4023058.description: A mesothelial fibroblast found in the leptomeninx.

CL:4023060.label: hippocampal CA1-3 neuron
CL:4023060.description: A neuron that has its soma located in CA1-3 of the hippocampus.

CL:4023061.label: hippocampal CA4 neuron
CL:4023061.description: A neuron that has its soma located in CA4 of the hippocampus.

CL:4023062.label: dentate gyrus neuron
CL:4023062.description: A neuron with its soma located in the dentate gyrus of the hippocampus.

CL:4023063.label: medial ganglionic eminence derived interneuron
CL:4023063.description: An interneuron that is derived from the medial ganglionic eminence.

CL:4023064.label: caudal ganglionic eminence derived cortical interneuron
CL:4023064.description: An interneuron that is derived from the caudal ganglionic eminence.
synonyms: caudal ganglionic eminence derived GABAergic cortical interneuron

CL:4023065.label: meis2 expressing cortical GABAergic cell
CL:4023065.description: A GABAergic cell located in the cerebral cortex that expresses meis2.

CL:4023066.label: horizontal pyramidal neuron
CL:4023066.description: A pyramidal neuron which has an apical tree which is oriented parallel to the pia. This is unlike typical pyramidal neurons which have its apical dendrite aligned vertically.

CL:4023067.label: obsolete Martinotti morphology L2/3 pvalb-like sst GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mus musculus)
CL:4023067.description: OBSOLETE A L2/3 pvalb-like sst GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mus musculus) that has Martinotti morphology.
comments: Moved to PCL. Use PCL:1000004 instead.

CL:4023068.label: thalamic excitatory neuron
CL:4023068.description: An excitatory neuron that has its soma located in the thalamic complex. This neuron type can be involved in a series of circuits related to sensory integration, motor integration, pain processing, social behaviour and reward response.

CL:4023069.label: medial ganglionic eminence derived GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023069.description: A GABAergic cortical interneuron that develops from the medial ganglionic eminence and has migrated to the cerebral cortex.

CL:4023070.label: obsolete caudal ganglionic eminence derived GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023070.description: OBSOLETE. A GABAergic cortical interneuron that develops from the caudal ganglionic eminence and has migrated to the cerebral cortex.
comments:
caudal ganglionic eminence derived GABAergic interneuron
and caudal ganglionic eminence derived interneuron are the same cell type. 
The two must be merged and one needs to be defined as obsolete. 
We decided to deprecate the entity with the more specific term and redundant qualities 
in the label. See comments in issue 2357.

CL:4023071.label: L5/6 cck GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023071.description: A GABAergic cortical interneuron that expresses cck. L5/6 cck cells have soma found mainly in L5 and L6 and have large axonal arborization.

CL:4023072.label: brain vascular cell
CL:4023072.description: A cell that is part of the brain vasculature.

CL:4023073.label: obsolete choroid plexus cell
CL:4023073.description: OBSOLETE. A cell that is part of the choroid plexus.

CL:4023074.label: mammillary body neuron
CL:4023074.description: A neuron that has its soma located in the mammillary body.

CL:4023075.label: L6 th sst GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023075.description: A sst GABAergic cortical interneuron found in L6 that expresses tyrosine hydroxylase. L6 Th+ SST cells have mostly local axonal arborization within L6.
synonyms: L6 tyrosine hydroxylase positive sst expressing GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mus musculus)

CL:4023076.label: Martinotti neuron
CL:4023076.description: An interneuron that has Martinotti morphology. These interneurons are scattered throughout various layers of the cerebral cortex, sending their axons up to the cortical layer I where they form axonal arborization.

CL:4023077.label: bitufted neuron
CL:4023077.description: A type of interneuron that has two clusters of dendritic branches that originate directly from the soma and extend in opposite directions and axons that form a plexus which spreads widely. Compared to bipolar neurons, bitufted neurons have branching that occur close to the soma.

CL:4023078.label: obsolete basket morphology L2/3 pvalb-like sst GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mus musculus)
CL:4023078.description: OBSOLETE A L2/3 pvalb-like sst GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mus musculus) that has basket morphology.
comments: Moved to PCL. Use PCL:1000003 instead.

CL:4023079.label: midbrain-derived inhibitory neuron
CL:4023079.description: A GABAergic inhibitory neuron that is derived from the midbrain.

CL:4023080.label: stellate L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Mmus)
CL:4023080.description: a L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex that has stellate pyramidal morphology.

CL:4023081.label: inverted L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Mmus)
CL:4023081.description: a L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex that has inverted pyramidal morphology.

CL:4023083.label: chandelier cell
CL:4023083.description: A GABAergic interneuron that selectively innervates the axon initial segment of pyramidal cells. Their local axonal clusters are formed by high-frequency branching at shallow angles, often ramifying around, above or below their somata with a high bouton density. The characteristic terminal portions of the axon form short vertical rows of boutons, resembling the candlesticks and candles of a chandelier. Chandelier cells can be multipolar or bitufted.

CL:4023086.label: T Martinotti neuron
CL:4023086.description: A Martinotti neuron that has axons that form a horizontal ramification, making it T-shaped.

CL:4023087.label: fan Martinotti neuron
CL:4023087.description: A Martinotti neuron that has axons that form a fan-like plexus.

CL:4023088.label: large basket cell
CL:4023088.description: A basket cell that is large, and typically ascends to give rise to many long horizontally and vertically projecting axon collaterals that traverse neighboring columns and can extend through all cortical layers.

CL:4023089.label: nest basket cell
CL:4023089.description: A basket cell which has simpler dendritic arbors (compared to small or large basket cells), and an axonal plexus of intermediate density, composed of a few long, smooth axonal branches.

CL:4023090.label: small basket cell
CL:4023090.description: A basket cell with axonal arbors composed of frequent, short, curvy axonal branches that tend to be near their somata and within the same layer.

CL:4023092.label: inverted pyramidal neuron
CL:4023092.description: A pyramidal neuron which has an apical tree which is oriented towards the white matter.

CL:4023093.label: stellate pyramidal neuron
CL:4023093.description: A pyramidal neuron which lacks a tuft formation but extends small radial distances forming a star-like shape.

CL:4023094.label: tufted pyramidal neuron
CL:4023094.description: A pyramidal neuron which has a distinctive tuft formation, distal from the soma.

CL:4023095.label: untufted pyramidal neuron
CL:4023095.description: A pyramidal neuron which lacks a clear tuft formation but extends to large radial distances.

CL:4023097.label: arachnoid barrier cell
CL:4023097.description: A mesothelial fibroblast of the arachnoid barrier layer. Arachnoid barrier cells make up the tight-junctioned layer in the leptomeninx that functions as the physiologic barrier between the cerebrospinal fluid in the subarachnoid space and the fenestrated capillaries in the dura.

CL:4023098.label: obsolete L2/3 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Homo sapiens)
CL:4023098.description: OBSOLETE An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 2/3 of the human primary motor cortex.
comments: Made terms species agnostic, use CL:4023047 instead.

CL:4023099.label: obsolete L5 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Homo sapiens)
CL:4023099.description: OBSOLETE. An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 5 of the human primary motor cortex.
comments: Made terms species agnostic, use CL:4023049 instead.

CL:4023100.label: obsolete L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Homo sapiens)
CL:4023100.description: OBSOLETE. An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 6 of the human primary motor cortex.
comments: Made terms species agnostic, use CL:4023050 instead.

CL:4023101.label: obsolete L5/6 near-projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Homo sapiens)
CL:4023101.description: OBSOLETE. A near-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 5/6 of the human primary motor cortex.
comments: Made terms species agnostic, use CL:4023043 instead.

CL:4023102.label: obsolete L5/6 near-projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Callithrix jacchus)
CL:4023102.description: OBSOLETE. A near-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 5/6 of the marmoset primary motor cortex.
comments: Made terms species agnostic, use CL:4023043 instead.

CL:4023103.label: obsolete L2/3 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Callithrix jacchus)
CL:4023103.description: OBSOLETE. An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 2/3 of the marmoset primary motor cortex.
comments: Made terms species agnostic, use CL:4023047 instead.

CL:4023104.label: obsolete L5 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Callithrix jacchus)
CL:4023104.description: OBSOLETE An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 5 of the marmoset primary motor cortex.
comments: Made terms species agnostic, use CL:4023049 instead.

CL:4023105.label: obsolete L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Callithrix jacchus)
CL:4023105.description: OBSOLETE. An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 6 of the marmoset primary motor cortex.
comments: Made terms species agnostic, use CL:4023050 instead.

CL:4023106.label: obsolete meis2 expressing cortical GABAergic cell (Callithrix jacchus)
CL:4023106.description: OBSOLETE. A mouse GABAergic cell located in the marmoset cerebral cortex that expresses meis2.
comments: False

CL:4023107.label: reticulospinal neuron
CL:4023107.description: A neuron with soma location in the reticular formation with axons that extend into the spinal cord such. Reticulospinal neuron activity can lead to a variety of motor behaviors.

CL:4023108.label: oxytocin-secreting magnocellular cell
CL:4023108.description: A magnocellular neurosecretory cell that is capable of producing and secreting oxytocin.

CL:4023109.label: vasopressin-secreting magnocellular cell
CL:4023109.description: A magnocellular neurosecretory cell that is capable of producing and secreting vasopressin.

CL:4023110.label: amygdala pyramidal neuron
CL:4023110.description: A pyramidal neuron with soma located in the amygdala.

CL:4023111.label: cerebral cortex pyramidal neuron
CL:4023111.description: A pyramidal neuron with soma located in the cerebral cortex.

CL:4023112.label: vestibular afferent neuron
CL:4023112.description: An afferent neuron of the vestibular system that innervate the base of the hair cell and increase or decrease their neural firing rate as the receptor cell is excited or inhibited.

CL:4023113.label: bouton vestibular afferent neuron
CL:4023113.description: A vestibular afferent neuron that makes bouton synapses to type II hair cells.

CL:4023114.label: calyx vestibular afferent neuron
CL:4023114.description: A vestibular afferent neuron which posseses a unique postsynaptic terminal, the calyx, which completely covers the basolateral walls of type I hair cells and receives input from multiple ribbon synapses.

CL:4023115.label: type 1 spiral ganglion neuron
CL:4023115.description: A spiral ganglion neuron that innervates inner hair cells. Type 1 spiral ganglion neurons are myelinated and bipolar.

CL:4023116.label: type 2 spiral ganglion neuron
CL:4023116.description: A spiral ganglion neuron that innervates outer hair cells. Type 1 spiral ganglion neurons are unmyelinated and unipolar.

CL:4023118.label: L5/6 non-Martinotti sst GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023118.description: A sst GABAergic interneuron does not have Martinotti morphology with a soma found in L5/6 of the cerebral cortex.
synonyms: L5/6 non-Martinotti morphology sst expressing GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mus musculus)

CL:4023119.label: displaced amacrine cell
CL:4023119.description: A subpopulation of amacrine cell that migrate further than other amacrine cells, and come to lie basal to the inner plexiform layer (IPL) in the ganglion cell layer. Displaced amacrine cells still have their neurites extending apically into the IPL, and therefore exhibit an inverted polarity with respect to the other amacrine cells.

CL:4023121.label: sst chodl GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023121.description: A transcriptomically distinct sst GABAergic cortical interneuron that also expresses Chodl. These neurons are rare and correspond to the only known cortical interneurons with long-range projection. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: MGE-derived interneurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters Sst Chodl.

CL:4023122.label: oxytocin receptor sst GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023122.description: An interneuron located in the cerebral cortex that expresses the oxytocin receptor. These interneurons also express somatostatin.

CL:4023123.label: hypothalamus kisspeptin neuron
CL:4023123.description: A kisspeptin neuron that is located in the hypothalamus. These neurons project to and activate gonadotrophin-releasing hormone neurons (acting via the kisspeptin receptor) in the hypothalamus and stimulate the secretion of gonadotrophin-releasing hormone.

CL:4023124.label: dentate gyrus kisspeptin neuron
CL:4023124.description: A kisspeptin neuron that is located in the dentate gyrus of the hippocampus.

CL:4023125.label: KNDy neuron
CL:4023125.description: A hypothalamus kisspeptin neuron that coexpresses kisspeptin, neurokinin B and dynorphin.
synonyms: kisspeptin, neurokinin B and dynorphin expressing neuron

CL:4023127.label: arcuate nucleus of hypothalamus KNDy neuron
CL:4023127.description: a KNDy neuron that is located in the arcuate nucleus of the hypothalamus.

CL:4023128.label: rostral periventricular region of the third ventricle KNDy neuron
CL:4023128.description: a KNDy neuron that is located in the rostral periventricular region of the third ventricle.

CL:4023129.label: retinoblast
CL:4023129.description: A retinal cell that is immature or undifferentiated.

CL:4023130.label: kisspeptin neuron
CL:4023130.description: A neuron that expresses kisspeptin. These neurons are predominantly located in the hypothalamus, but also found in other parts of the brain including the hippocampal dentate gyrus.

CL:4023158.label: octopus cell of the mammalian cochlear nucleus
CL:4023158.description: A neuron in the posterior ventral cochlear nucleus that is distinguished by their long, thick and tentacle-shaped dendrites that typically emanate from one side of the cell body.

CL:4023159.label: double bouquet cell
CL:4023159.description: An interneuron that has double bouquet morphology.

CL:4023160.label: cartwheel cell
CL:4023160.description: A neuron of the dorsal cochlear nucleus with spiny dendrites that receive input from the axons of granule cells and with axons that release GABA and glycine onto cartwheel, pyramidal and giant cell targets.

CL:4023162.label: bushy cell
CL:4023162.description: A neuron found in the anterior part of the ventral cochlear nucleus that has the appearance of bushes, having short dendrites. Bushy cells give outputs to different parts of the superior olivary complex.

CL:4023163.label: spherical bushy cell
CL:4023163.description: A bushy cell that receives only few large excitatory endbulb synapses from auditory nerves. Spherical bush cells give excitatory input to the lateral and medial parts of the superior olive.

CL:4023164.label: globular bushy cell
CL:4023164.description: A bushy cell that receives a large number of medium-sized synapses, called modified endbulbs. Globular bushy cells extend to the superior olive on both sides of the brainstem where they give input to the bipolar neurons.

CL:4023168.label: somatosensory neuron
CL:4023168.description: A neuron that is part of the somatic sensory system. Somatosensory neurons innervate the skin or integument to detect different types of thermal, chemical, and mechanical touch stimuli.

CL:4023169.label: trigeminal neuron
CL:4023169.description: A neuron that is responsible for sensation in the face or motor functions such as biting and chewing. Trigeminal neurons extend a single axon shaft along the lateral white matter of the hindbrain and spinal cord. The highly branched axons innervate the integument of the head.

CL:4023170.label: trigeminal sensory neuron
CL:4023170.description: A trigeminal neuron that is responsible for sensation in the face.

CL:4023171.label: trigeminal motor neuron
CL:4023171.description: A trigeminal neuron that is responsible for motor functions such as biting and chewing.

CL:4023181.label: hypendymal cell
CL:4023181.description: A neurecto-epithelial cell that is part of the basal layer of the subcommissural organ and specializes in the secretion of proteins into the subarachnoid space. Hypendymal cells have similar characteristics to ependymal cells and express SCO-spondin.

CL:4023187.label: koniocellular cell
CL:4023187.description: A neuron with a small cell body that is located in a koniocellular layer of the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN).

CL:4023188.label: midget ganglion cell of retina
CL:4023188.description: A retinal ganglion cell that originate in the ganglion cell layer of the retina, and project to the parvocellular layers of the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN). These cells are known as midget retinal ganglion cells due to the small sizes of their dendritic trees and cell bodies.

CL:4023189.label: parasol ganglion cell of retina
CL:4023189.description: A retinal ganglion cell located in the ganglion cell layer of the retina. This cell projects to magnocellular cells in the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN). They have large cell bodies and extensive, branching dendritic networks that contribute to their large receptive fields.

CL:4028001.label: pulmonary capillary endothelial cell
CL:4028001.description: Any capillary endothelial cell that is part of a lung.

CL:4028002.label: alveolar capillary type 1 endothelial cell
CL:4028002.description: An alveolar capillary endothelial cell that is located distally to alveolar capillary type 2 endothelial cells.

CL:4028003.label: alveolar capillary type 2 endothelial cell
CL:4028003.description: An alveolar capillary endothelial cell that is located proximally to alveolar capillary type 1 endothelial cells and in close apposition to alveolar type 1 epithelial cells (also known as type I pneumocytes).

CL:4028004.label: alveolar type 1 fibroblast cell
CL:4028004.description: A pulmonary interstitial fibroblast that is part of the alveolus and contains lipid droplets.

CL:4028006.label: alveolar adventitial fibroblast
CL:4028006.description: A pulmonary interstitial fibroblast that is part of the alveolus and localizes to vascular adventitia.

CL:4029001.label: gamete-nursing cell
CL:4029001.description: A cell that supports the development of a gamete by providing it cytoplasmic material (including entire organelles) by direct cross-membrane channels (del Pino, 2021).

CL:4029003.label: somatic nurse-like cell
CL:4029003.description: A gamete-nursing cell that derives from the somatic tissues of the gonad (del Pino, 2021).

CL:4030000.label: choroidal melanocyte
CL:4030000.description: A melanocyte located in the vascular uvea and involved in photoprotection, regulation of oxidative damage and immune responses.

CL:4030003.label: interstitial cell of thymus
CL:4030003.description: A cell that makes up the loose connective tissue of the thymus.

CL:4030004.label: thymic nurse cell
CL:4030004.description: A large epithelial cell found in the thymus. This cell type may internalize thymocytes through extensions of plasma membrane. The cell surface and cytoplasmic vacuoles of a thymic nurse cell express MHC Class I and MHC Class II antigens. The interaction of these antigens with a developing thymocyte determines whether the thymocyte undergoes positive or negative selection.

CL:4030005.label: kidney collecting duct beta-intercalated cell
CL:4030005.description: A renal beta-intercalated cell that is part of the cortical collecting duct. The medullary collecting duct does not contain the renal beta-intercalated cell type.
synonyms: kidney collecting duct intercalated cell type B

CL:4030006.label: fallopian tube secretory epithelial cell
CL:4030006.description: An epithelial cell that is part of the fallopian tube that secretes mucus and oviduct-specific products in response to hormonal stimulation from estrogen and luteinizing hormone. This fallopian tube secretory cell is similar in height to the ciliated cell, but typically exhibits a more narrow, columnar shape. Its nucleus is ovoid and oriented perpendicular to the cell's long axis, with denser chromatin and a smaller nucleolus compared to the ciliated cell.

CL:4030007.label: fallopian tube multiciliated epithelial cell
CL:4030007.description: A multi-ciliated epithelial cell that is part of the fallopian tube, mainly found on the apex of the mucosal folds. This cell exhibits a columnar shape with an oval nucleus and is characterized by the presence of cilia on its surface. The coordinated beating of these cilia, together with peristaltic contractions, contributes to the self-propulsion of spermatozoa, the transport of ovum during ovulation and the transport of the fertilized ovum to the intramural fallopian tube.

CL:4030008.label: pronephric podocyte
CL:4030008.description: A specialized epithelial cell that contains "feet" that interdigitate with the "feet" of other glomerular epithelial cells in the pronephros.

CL:4030009.label: epithelial cell of proximal tubule segment 1
CL:4030009.description: A brush border cell that is part of segment 1 (S1) of the proximal tubule epithelium, located in the renal cortex.
synonyms: epithelial cell of segment 1 of proximal tubule

CL:4030010.label: epithelial cell of proximal tubule segment 2
CL:4030010.description: A brush border cell that is part of segment 2 (S2) of the proximal tubule epithelium, located in the renal cortex. In addition to its reabsorptive functions, it is also specialized in the secretion of organic anions and cations, including para-aminohippurate.
synonyms: epithelial cell of segment 2 of proximal tubule

CL:4030011.label: epithelial cell of proximal tubule segment 3
CL:4030011.description: A brush border cell that is part of segment 3 (S3) of the proximal tubule epithelium, which extends from the medullary rays of the renal cortex into the outer medulla.
synonyms: epithelial cell of segment 3 of proximal tubule

CL:4030012.label: kidney loop of Henle short descending thin limb epithelial cell
CL:4030012.description: Epithelial cell of the descending thin limb of the short loop (cortical) nephron limited to the outer medulla (mainly inner strip). It is known in some mammalian species that the short descending limb of the loop of Henle selectively expresses the serine protease Corin, the homeobox TF Uncx, and the urea channel Slc14a2.
synonyms: epithelial cell of the descending thin limb of the short loop of Henle

CL:4030013.label: kidney loop of Henle long descending thin limb outer medulla epithelial cell
CL:4030013.description: Epithelial cell of the descending thin limb of the long loop (juxtamedullary) nephron that spans the outer medulla (inner stripe). It is known in some mammalian species that the long descending limb of the loop of Henle in the outer medulla selectively expresses the secreted activin-antagonist protein follistatin (Fst), the GPI-linked adhesion protein Cdh13, and the protein kinase Stk32a.
synonyms: epithelial cell of the outer medulla of the long descending limb of the loop of Henle

CL:4030014.label: kidney loop of Henle long descending thin limb inner medulla epithelial cell
CL:4030014.description: Epithelial cell of the descending thin limb of the long loop (juxtamedullary) nephron that spans the inner medulla. It is known in some mammalian species that the long descending limb of the loop of Henle in the inner medulla selectively expresses the nuclear receptor Nr2e3, the Ig kappa chain Igkc, and the secreted protein dermokine (Dmkn). SLC14A2, which expresses a urea transporter, is also expressed in the inner medulla.
synonyms: epithelial cell of the inner medulla of the long descending limb of the loop of Henle

CL:4030015.label: kidney collecting duct alpha-intercalated cell
CL:4030015.description: A renal alpha-intercalated cell that is part of the collecting duct of the renal tubule.
synonyms: kidney collecting duct intercalated cell type A

CL:4030016.label: epithelial cell of early distal convoluted tubule
CL:4030016.description: An epithelial cell located in the early distal convoluted tubule.

CL:4030017.label: epithelial cell of late distal convoluted tubule
CL:4030017.description: An epithelial cell located in the late distal convoluted tubule.

CL:4030018.label: kidney connecting tubule principal cell
CL:4030018.description: A renal principal cell located in the connecting tubule.

CL:4030019.label: kidney connecting tubule intercalated cell
CL:4030019.description: A renal intercalated cell that is part of the renal connecting tubule.

CL:4030020.label: kidney connecting tubule alpha-intercalated cell
CL:4030020.description: A renal alpha-intercalated cell that is part of the renal connecting tubule.
synonyms: kidney connecting tubule intercalated cell type A

CL:4030021.label: kidney connecting tubule beta-intercalated cell
CL:4030021.description: A renal beta-intercalated cell that is part of the renal connecting tubule.
synonyms: kidney connecting tubule intercalated cell type B

CL:4030022.label: renal medullary fibroblast
CL:4030022.description: A fibroblast that is located in the renal medulla interstitium.

CL:4030023.label: respiratory tract hillock cell
CL:4030023.description: A hillock cell that is located in respiratory epithelium. In some mammalian species, this cell type has been noted to express KRT13 and KRT4 and is postulated to play a role in squamous barrier function and immunomodulation.

CL:4030024.label: hillock cell
CL:4030024.description: An epithelial, transitional cell type between basal and secretory; located in stratified, non-ciliated structures (called hillocks) with high cell turnover in epithelium. In some mammalian species, this cell type has been noted to express KRT13 and is postulated to play a role in squamous barrier function and immunomodulation.

CL:4030025.label: renal cortical fibroblast
CL:4030025.description: A fibroblast that is located in the renal cortical interstitium.

CL:4030026.label: BEST4+ enterocyte
CL:4030026.description: An enterocyte of the human intestine expressing bestrophin-4 (BEST4) calcium-activated ion channels.

CL:4030030.label: peripheral blood lymphocyte
CL:4030030.description: A blood lymphocyte located in the flowing, circulating blood of the body.

CL:4030032.label: valve interstitial cell
CL:4030032.description: An interstitial cell that is part of a cardiac valve leaflet. Along with valve endothelial cells, a valve interstitial cell maintains tissue homeostasis for the function of cardiac valves through secreting biochemical signals, matrix proteins and matrix remodeling enzymes.

CL:4030033.label: valve endothelial cell
CL:4030033.description: An endothelial cell that lines a surface of a cardiac valve leaflet. Along with valve interstitial cells, a valve endothelial cell maintains tissue homeostasis for the function of cardiac valves through secreting biochemical signals, matrix proteins and matrix remodeling enzymes.

CL:4030035.label: dental pulp stem cell
CL:4030035.description: A dental pulp cell that possesses stem-cell-like qualities, including self-renewal capability and multi-lineage differentiation.

CL:4030036.label: early spermatid
CL:4030036.description: A spermatid in an early stage of maturation that has a round morphology and is transcriptionally active.

CL:4030037.label: late spermatid
CL:4030037.description: A spermatid in a late stage of maturation that has an elongated morphology and is transcriptionally inert when the acrosome is fully developed.

CL:4030038.label: CD24-positive, CD-133-positive, vimentin-positive proximal tubular cell
CL:4030038.description: A CD24-positive, CD-133-positive, vimentin-positive cell found scattered throughout a renal proximal tubule and that may participate in tubular regeneration. Compared to other proximal tubular cell types, this cell contains less cytoplasm, fewer mitochondria and no brush border.

CL:4030039.label: von Economo neuron
CL:4030039.description: An extratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron that is morphologically-defined with a large, spindle-shaped cell body, thick bipolar dendrites with limited branching and a moderate density of spines, and often an axon initial segment that emanates from the side of the cell body. This cell type is associated with markers POU3F, BMP3 and ITGA4.

CL:4030040.label: endometrial multiciliated epithelial cell
CL:4030040.description: A multi-ciliated cell of the endometrial epithelium. This cell is characterized by the presence of 9+2 motile cilia on its apical surface, which facilitates the movement of mucus across the endometrial surface.

CL:4030041.label: luminal endometrial multiciliated epithelial cell
CL:4030041.description: A ciliated cell of the endometrial luminal epithelium. This cell is characterized by the presence of motile cilia on its apical surface.

CL:4030042.label: glandular endometrial multiciliated epithelial cell
CL:4030042.description: A ciliated cell of the endometrial glandular epithelium. This cell is characterized by the presence of motile cilia on its apical surface.

CL:4030043.label: matrix D1 medium spiny neuron
CL:4030043.description: A DRD1-expressing medium spiny neuron that is part of a matrix compartment of dorsal striatum.

CL:4030047.label: matrix D2 medium spiny neuron
CL:4030047.description: A DRD2-expressing medium spiny neuron that is part of a matrix compartment of dorsal striatum.

CL:4030048.label: striosomal D1 medium spiny neuron
CL:4030048.description: A DRD1-expressing medium spiny neuron that is part of a striosome of dorsal striatum.

CL:4030049.label: striosomal D2 medium spiny neuron
CL:4030049.description: A DRD2-expressing medium spiny neuron that is part of a striosome of dorsal striatum.

CL:4030050.label: D1/D2-hybrid medium spiny neuron
CL:4030050.description: A medium spiny neuron that expresses both DRD1 and DRD2 and is part of an extra-striosomal part of dorsal striatum.

CL:4030051.label: nucleus accumbens shell and olfactory tubercle D1 medium spiny neuron
CL:4030051.description: A DRD1-expressing medium spiny neuron that is part of a nucleus accumbens shell or olfactory tubercle.
synonyms: NAc shell and OT D1 medium spiny neuron

CL:4030052.label: nucleus accumbens shell and olfactory tubercle D2 medium spiny neuron
CL:4030052.description: A DRD2-expressing medium spiny neuron that is part of a nucleus accumbens shell or olfactory tubercle.
synonyms: NAc shell and OT D2 medium spiny neuron

CL:4030053.label: Island of Calleja granule cell
CL:4030053.description: A DRD1-expressing, medium spiny neuron-like granule cell that is part of an Island of Calleja.

CL:4030054.label: RXFP1-positive interface island D1-medium spiny neuron
CL:4030054.description: A DRD1-expressing medium spiny neuron that is part of dense, RXFP1-positive cell islands throughout the nucleus accumbens, putamen, and near the adjacent septal nuclei.

CL:4030055.label: intermediate cell of urothelium
CL:4030055.description: A urothelial cell that is part of the regenerative layer(s) of cells directly superficial to basal cells in urothelium. The layer of intermediate cells in the urothelium ranges from one to several layers thick depending on the species with intermediate cells attached to adjacent cell layers and one another via desmosomes.

CL:4030056.label: umbrella cell of urothelium
CL:4030056.description: A urothelial cell that is terminally differentiated and part of the urothelial apical surface that forms the high-resistance barrier of urothelium. Umbrella cells have been described as the largest of urothelial cell types, highly polarized, and, in some species, multinucleated. In the relaxed state, these cells form a dome-shaped structure at the apical pole and can also cover multiple underlying intermediate cells, leading to the name umbrella cells. In contrast, these cells flatten when the bladder is filled.

CL:4030057.label: eccentric medium spiny neuron
CL:4030057.description: A medium spiny neuron that exhibits transcriptional divergence from direct and indirect spiny projection neurons, for example, enrichment in Casz1, Otof, Cacng5 and Pcdh8 noted in mice. Whilst in general medium spiny neurons have been found to be differentially distributed across the basal ganglia, the eccentric medium spiny neuron cell type has been found to be more evenly distributed throughout cerebral nuclei.

CL:4030058.label: TCR-positive macrophage
CL:4030058.description: A macrophage that expresses the T cell receptor complex at the cell surface.

CL:4030059.label: L2/3 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030059.description: A transcriptomically distinct intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found between cortical layer 2-4. This intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron has thin-tufted apical dendrites and extends its axonal projection into L5 in the neocortex. This neuronal type has a hyperpolarised resting membrane potential. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: IT-projecting excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters L2/3 IT.

CL:4030060.label: L2 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030060.description: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 2.

CL:4030061.label: L3 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030061.description: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 3.

CL:4030062.label: L4/5 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030062.description: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic with a soma located in cortical layer 4/5.

CL:4030063.label: L4 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030063.description: A transcriptomically distinct intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 3-4. This neuron type can have a pyramidal, star-pyramidal or spiny stellate morphology and projects its output to L2/3 and L5A/B. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: IT-projecting excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', L4 IT.

CL:4030064.label: L5 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030064.description: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 5. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: IT-projecting excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', L5 IT.

CL:4030065.label: L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030065.description: A transcriptomically distinct intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in L6 of the primary motor cortex. These cells are short untufted pyramidal cells, which could be stellate or inverted.  The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: IT-projecting excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', L6 IT.

CL:4030066.label: ureteric bud cell
CL:4030066.description: An epithelial cell that is part of a ureteric bud. A ureteric bud cell has the potential to induce metanephric mesenchymal cells to proliferate and convert to epithelia that form renal tubules via: (1) the secretion of multiple diffusible growth factors that rescue renal progenitors from apoptosis and stimulate them to proliferate and (2) contact-dependent mechanisms that induce mesenchymal-epithelial conversion.

CL:4030067.label: L5/6 near-projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030067.description: A near-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 5/6.

CL:4030068.label: L6 intratelencephalic projecting Car3 glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030068.description: A transcriptomically distinct intratelencepalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron that expresses Car3 with a soma found in L6 . The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: IT-projecting excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_cluster', L6 IT Car3.

CL:4032000.label: club-like cell of the urethral epithelium
CL:4032000.description: An epithelial cell of the urethra that has an expression profile similar to lung club cells. Club-like cells of the urethra epithelium are similar to lung club cells in their expression of SCGB1A1 and in their enrichment of immunomodulatory programs.
synonyms: club cell of the urethra epithelium
club-like cell of the prostatic urethra epithelium

CL:4032001.label: reelin GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4032001.description: A GABAergic interneuron located in the cerebral cortex that expresses reelin (rln).

CL:4033000.label: endothelial cell of venule of lymph node
CL:4033000.description: A(n) endothelial cell that is part of a(n) venule of lymph node.

CL:4033001.label: endothelial cell of arteriole of lymph node
CL:4033001.description: A(n) endothelial cell that is part of a(n) arteriole of lymph node.

CL:4033002.label: neuroendocrine cell of epithelium of crypt of Lieberkuhn
CL:4033002.description: A(n) neuroendocrine cell that is part of a(n) epithelium of crypt of Lieberkuhn.

CL:4033003.label: myoepithelial cell of bronchus submucosal gland
CL:4033003.description: A(n) myoepithelial cell that is part of a(n) bronchus submucosal gland.

CL:4033004.label: smooth muscle cell of taenia coli
CL:4033004.description: A(n) smooth muscle cell that is part of a(n) taenia coli.

CL:4033005.label: serous secreting cell of bronchus submucosal gland
CL:4033005.description: A(n) serous secreting cell that is part of a(n) bronchus submucosal gland.

CL:4033006.label: endothelial cell of efferent lymphatic vessel
CL:4033006.description: A(n) endothelial cell that is part of a(n) efferent lymphatic vessel.

CL:4033007.label: brush cell of epithelium of lobar bronchus
CL:4033007.description: A(n) brush cell that is part of a(n) epithelium of lobar bronchus.

CL:4033008.label: vein endothelial cell of respiratory system
CL:4033008.description: A(n) vein endothelial cell that is part of a(n) respiratory system.

CL:4033009.label: goblet cell of epithelium of lobar bronchus
CL:4033009.description: A(n) goblet cell that is part of a(n) epithelium of lobar bronchus.

CL:4033010.label: neuroendocrine cell of epithelium of lobar bronchus
CL:4033010.description: A(n) neuroendocrine cell that is part of a(n) epithelium of lobar bronchus.

CL:4033011.label: smooth muscle cell of large intestine smooth muscle circular layer
CL:4033011.description: A(n) smooth muscle cell that is part of a(n) large intestine smooth muscle circular layer.

CL:4033012.label: smooth muscle cell of large intestine smooth muscle longitudinal layer
CL:4033012.description: A(n) smooth muscle cell that is part of a(n) large intestine smooth muscle longitudinal layer.

CL:4033013.label: suprabasal keratinocyte
CL:4033013.description: A keratinocyte of the epidermis suprabasal layer. This cell may express the differentiation markers keratin 10 and keratin 1.

CL:4033014.label: peg cell
CL:4033014.description: A small, narrow, peg-shaped epithelial cell with little cytoplasm that is part of oviduct epithelium. This cell is rarer than the ciliated and secretory epithelial cells of the fallopian tube epithelium and is often found intercalated between them. Peg cells are generally distributed basally along the epithelium and have been found in high concentrations at the fimbriated, distal end of the fallopian tube in humans. It may have a regenerative/stem-cell function. In humans, markers include EPCAM, CD44, and ITGA6.

CL:4033015.label: retinal astrocyte
CL:4033015.description: A star-shaped glial cell that is part of some retina. This cell links neurons to blood vessels and may provide structural and physiological support to optic nerve head axons.

CL:4033016.label: secondary crest myofibroblast
CL:4033016.description: A myofibroblast that is part of an alveoli during alveolarization. The contractile force of this cell elongates the secondary crest, while producing a framework of elastin and tenascin. During the maturation of the septa, secondary crest myofibroblasts, together with matrix fibroblasts, secrete metalloproteinases and other ECM‐remodeling proteins to thin the septal tip ECM. The secondary crest myofibroblast continues producing elastin, eventually undergoing apoptosis during adulthood.

CL:4033017.label: bronchiolar smooth muscle cell
CL:4033017.description: A smooth muscle cell that is part of a bronchiole.

CL:4033018.label: lung megakaryocyte
CL:4033018.description: A megakaryocyte that is resident in the lung connective tissue.

CL:4033019.label: ON-blue cone bipolar cell
CL:4033019.description: An ON bipolar cell type with dendrites selectively contacting S-cones.

CL:4033020.label: mucus secreting cell of trachea gland
CL:4033020.description: A mucus secreting cell that is part of a submucosal gland of the trachea.

CL:4033021.label: myoepithelial cell of trachea gland
CL:4033021.description: A myoepithelial cell that is part of a submucosal gland of the trachea.

CL:4033022.label: mucus secreting cell of bronchus submucosal gland
CL:4033022.description: A mucus secreting cell of a submucosal gland of the bronchus.

CL:4033023.label: airway submucosal gland collecting duct epithelial cell
CL:4033023.description: An epithelial cell that is part of a collecting duct of an airway submucosal gland.

CL:4033024.label: airway submucosal gland duct basal cell
CL:4033024.description: A basal cell that is part of a duct of an airway submucosal gland.

CL:4033025.label: perichondrial fibroblast
CL:4033025.description: A fibroblast that is part of the fibrous layer of the perichondrium. This cell is responsible for collagen fiber production.

CL:4033026.label: lung perichondrial fibroblast
CL:4033026.description: A perichondrial fibroblast that is part of the lung.

CL:4033027.label: diffuse bipolar 1 cell
CL:4033027.description: An OFF diffuse bipolar cell that makes synaptic contact with both L/M and S-cone photoreceptors and only minimal contact with rod photoreceptors.

CL:4033028.label: diffuse bipolar 2 cell
CL:4033028.description: An OFF diffuse bipolar cell that predominantly connects to ON parasol cells and lateral amacrine cells. This cell contains a large number of synaptic ribbons and a small axon arbor area.

CL:4033029.label: diffuse bipolar 3a cell
CL:4033029.description: An OFF calbindin-positive bipolar cell that has a large dendritic field and stratifies narrowly close to the middle of the inner plexiform layer. Its axon terminal is characterized by regularly branching and varicose processes resembling beads on a string. Most of DB3a contacts with cones are triad-associated.

CL:4033030.label: diffuse bipolar 3b cell
CL:4033030.description: An OFF calbindin-negative bipolar cell that has a large dendritic field and stratifies narrowly close to the middle of the inner plexiform layer. Its axon terminal is characterized by regularly branching and varicose processes resembling beads on a string. Most of DB3b contacts with cones are non-triad-associated.

CL:4033031.label: diffuse bipolar 4 cell
CL:4033031.description: An ON diffuse bipolar cell that predominantly connects to ON parasol cells and lateral amacrine cells.

CL:4033032.label: diffuse bipolar 6 cell
CL:4033032.description: An ON diffuse bipolar cell that has a large dendritic field and large axon terminals, which show little or no overlap. This cell predominantly connects to narrow thorny ganglion cells.

CL:4033033.label: flat midget bipolar cell
CL:4033033.description: An OFF bipolar cell with a small dendritic tree that provides most of the triad-associated basal (flat) contacts at cone pedicles.

CL:4033034.label: invaginating midget bipolar cell
CL:4033034.description: An ON bipolar cell with a small dendritic tree that forms most of the central (invaginating) elements opposite the synaptic ribbon at the cone triad.

CL:4033035.label: giant bipolar cell
CL:4033035.description: An ON bipolar cell that has large dendritic and axonal fields.

CL:4033036.label: OFFx cell
CL:4033036.description: An OFF bipolar cell that is fovea-specific and expresses FEZF1, NXPH1 and NXPH2.

CL:4033037.label: mucus secreting cell of tracheobronchial tree submucosal gland
CL:4033037.description: A mucus secreting cell of a submucosal gland of the tracheobronchial tree.

CL:4033038.label: lung resident memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:4033038.description: An alpha-beta CD4 T cell that resides in the lung.
synonyms: lung resident memory CD4 T cell

CL:4033039.label: lung resident memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:4033039.description: An alpha-beta CD8 T cell that resides in the lung.

CL:4033040.label: lung resident memory CD8-positive, CD103-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:4033040.description: A lung resident memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell that is CD103-positive.
synonyms: lung TRM CD8-positive, integrin alpha E-positive cell
lung resident memory CD8-positive CD103-positive, alpha-beta T cell

CL:4033041.label: CCL3-positive alveolar macrophage
CL:4033041.description: An alveolar macrophage that expresses CCL3.

CL:4033042.label: metallothionein-positive alveolar macrophage
CL:4033042.description: An alveolar macrophage that expresses metallothionein.

CL:4033043.label: lung interstitial macrophage
CL:4033043.description: A macrophage that is part of the lung connective tissue (pulmonary interstitium). This cell performs tissue remodeling and contributes to barrier immunity through antigen presentation.

CL:4033044.label: deuterosomal cell
CL:4033044.description: An epithelial cell part of respiratory tract epithelium that is a precursor of a multi-ciliated cell. This cell actively amplifies centrioles, a required step for multiciliogenesis.

CL:4033045.label: lung migratory dendritic cell
CL:4033045.description: A dendritic cell that captures antigens in a lung and migrates to a lymph node or to the spleen to activate T cells.

CL:4033046.label: ON midget ganglion cell
CL:4033046.description: A midget ganglion cell that depolarizes in response to increased light intensity in the center of its receptive field. The majority of input that this cell receives comes from invaginating midget bipolar cells.

CL:4033047.label: OFF midget ganglion cell
CL:4033047.description: A midget ganglion cell that depolarizes in response to decreased light intensity in the center of its receptive field. The majority of input that this cell receives comes from flat midget bipolar cells.

CL:4033048.label: respiratory tract suprabasal cell
CL:4033048.description: A respiratory epithelial cell derived from a basal cell, with a topographic nuclear position between the basal and luminal cells of the airway epithelium. This non-basal, intermediate progenitor cell has limited proliferative capacity and can differentiate into multiciliated, secretory, or rare airway cells (ionocytes, tuft cells, neuroendocrine cells). It shares some ultrastructural features with basal cells but lacks the defined characteristics of fully differentiated cellular phenotypes.

CL:4033049.label: taste receptor cell of tongue
CL:4033049.description: A taste receptor cell that is part of a taste bud of a tongue.

CL:4033051.label: OFF parasol ganglion cell
CL:4033051.description: A parasol ganglion cell that depolarizes in response to decreased light intensity in the center of its receptive field. The majority of input that this cell receives comes from DB3a bipolar cells.

CL:4033052.label: ON parasol ganglion cell
CL:4033052.description: A parasol ganglion cell that depolarizes in response to increased light intensity in the center of its receptive field. The majority of input that this cell receives comes from DB4 bipolar cells.

CL:4033053.label: small bistratified retinal ganglion cell
CL:4033053.description: A bistratfied retinal ganglion cell with a small dendritic field that has dendrites in the ON and OFF sublamina of the retinal inner plexiform layer and carries blue-ON/yellow-OFF signals. This cell receives bipolar and amacrine input to both the OFF and ON dendritic tree.
synonyms: small bistratified cell, blue-ON/yellow-OFF ganglion cell

CL:4033055.label: airway submucosal gland duct multiciliated cell
CL:4033055.description: A multi-ciliated epithelial cell located in ciliated duct of an airway submucosal gland, characterized by a columnar shape and motile cilia on its apical surface.
synonyms: airway submucosal gland duct ciliated cell

CL:4033056.label: onychocyte
CL:4033056.description: A terminally differentiated, specialized keratinocyte originating primarily from the nail matrix. During onychokeratinization, these cells undergo progressive flattening and produce high levels of hard, disulfide cross-linked keratins (Eckhart et al., 2024) that form the rigid, compact nail plate. Unlike epidermal keratinocytes, onychocytes are firmly integrated into the nail plate and do not desquamate.

CL:4033058.label: luminal hormone-sensing cell of mammary gland
CL:4033058.description: A luminal epithelial cell of the mammary gland that transduces endocrine cues to orchestrate proliferation, architectural remodeling, and differentiation of other cells in the mammary gland via paracrine signaling. This cell expresses high levels of estrogen receptors. In humans, a luminal hormone-sensing cell can be identified by high levels of EpCAM and low levels of CD49f, and in mice it can be identified by low levels of CD29 and high levels of Foxa1, CD133, and Sca1 (Ly6a).

CL:4033059.label: lactocyte type 1
CL:4033059.description: A lactocyte that highly expresses genes associated with transcription, immune cell function, and cellular stress. A lactocyte type 1 also expresses genes involved in milk component biosynthesis (e.g., LALBA and CSNs), albeit at lower levels than a lactocyte type 2.

CL:4033060.label: lactocyte type 2
CL:4033060.description: A lactocyte that highly expresses genes associated with lipid production and milk component biosynthesis.

CL:4033061.label: endothelial cell of central vein of liver
CL:4033061.description: An endothelial cell that is part of a central vein of liver.

CL:4033062.label: interstitial extravillous trophoblast cell
CL:4033062.description: A trophoblast cell that invades the uterine wall to anchor the placenta to the uterus. An interstitial extravillous trophoblast cell differentiates from an extravillous trophoblast cell, becoming hyperchromatic and changing its morphology to a fibroblast-like spindle-shaped cell. In humans, this cell can be distinguished by the expression of placental-specific protein 8, which stimulates migration.

CL:4033063.label: endovascular extravillous trophoblast cell
CL:4033063.description: A trophoblast cell that invades the maternal spiral arteries and replace the endothelial lining, remodeling the vessels and allowing for adequate blood transport into the placenta. An endovascular extravillous trophoblast cell differentiates from an extravillous trophoblast cell. In humans, this cell can be distinguished by the expression of CD56.

CL:4033064.label: uterine resident macrophage
CL:4033064.description: A tissue-resident macrophage that is part of the uterus.

CL:4033065.label: preplasmablast
CL:4033065.description: A mature B cell that serves as an intermediate stage in the differentiation of naive B cells into a plasmablast. A preplasmablast expresses CD30 and IL-6R and lacks expression of CD20, CD23, CD38 and CD138.

CL:4033067.label: mural granulosa cell
CL:4033067.description: A follicular cell of ovary that differentiates from a cuboidal granulosa cell during the secondary follicle stage. Mural granulosa cells line the inner surface of the follicle wall, surrounding the fluid-filled antral cavity. These cells produce oestrogen during the follicular phase in response to follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH), and progesterone after ovulation in response to luteinizing hormone (LH).

CL:4033068.label: cycling B cell
CL:4033068.description: A(n) B cell that is cycling.

CL:4033069.label: cycling T cell
CL:4033069.description: A(n) T cell that is cycling.

CL:4033070.label: cycling dendritic cell
CL:4033070.description: A(n) dendritic cell that is cycling.

CL:4033071.label: cycling natural killer cell
CL:4033071.description: A(n) natural killer cell that is cycling.

CL:4033072.label: cycling gamma-delta T cell
CL:4033072.description: A(n) gamma-delta T cell that is cycling.

CL:4033074.label: cycling CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:4033074.description: A(n) CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell that is cycling.

CL:4033075.label: cycling CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:4033075.description: A(n) CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell that is cycling.

CL:4033077.label: cycling alveolar macrophage
CL:4033077.description: A(n) alveolar macrophage that is cycling.

CL:4033078.label: cycling mononuclear phagocyte
CL:4033078.description: A(n) mononuclear phagocyte that is cycling.

CL:4033079.label: cycling endothelial cell of lymphatic vessel
CL:4033079.description: A(n) endothelial cell of lymphatic vessel that is cycling.
synonyms: proliferating endothelial cell of lymphatic vessel

CL:4033080.label: cycling pulmonary alveolar type 2 cell
CL:4033080.description: A(n) pulmonary alveolar type 2 cell that is cycling.

CL:4033081.label: cycling myeloid cell
CL:4033081.description: A(n) myeloid cell that is cycling.

CL:4033082.label: cycling basal cell
CL:4033082.description: A(n) basal cell that is cycling.

CL:4033083.label: squamous granulosa cell
CL:4033083.description: A granulosa cell that has a squamous morphology and form a single layer around the oocyte in primordial follicles. This cell develops directly into a cuboidal granulosa cell during the primordial-to-primary follicle transition.

CL:4033085.label: diffuse bipolar 5 cell
CL:4033085.description: An ON diffuse bipolar cell that stratifies in the stratum 3 of the inner plexiform layer to make synapses with ON parasol ganglion cells. A diffuse bipolar 5 cell has high expression of MYO16 compared with other bipolar cells.

CL:4033086.label: lipid-associated macrophage
CL:4033086.description: A tissue-resident macrophage that is associated with lipids. This cell responsible of anti-inflammatory functions, lipid accumulation and enhancing phagocytosis (Wculek et al., 2022, Liu et al., 2022). In mice and humans, a lipid-associated macrophage is characterized by the marker Trem2 (Jaitlin et al., 2019).

CL:4033087.label: placental resident macrophage
CL:4033087.description: A tissue-resident macrophage that is part of the placenta. This cell helps preventing immunological rejection of the fetus by modulating the immune environment. A placental resident macrophage has high plasticity to adapt to the changing needs of each phase of pregnancy.

CL:4033088.label: decidual resident macrophage
CL:4033088.description: A resident macrophage that is part of the decidua. Some decidual macrophages are derived from maternal blood monocytes that are recruited to the uterus shortly after conception. The main functions of a decidual macrophage are implantation, placental development, immune regulation and vascular remodeling.

CL:4033089.label: atretic follicular cell of ovary
CL:4033089.description: A follicular cell of ovary that has begun to degenerate and undergo atresia, a specialized apoptosis. This cell is found in an atretic follicle, which is an ovarian follicle that started to mature but failed to reach full development and instead regresses.

CL:4033090.label: atretic granulosa cell
CL:4033090.description: A granulosa cell that is undergoing atresia. This cell type displays distinct morphological alterations compared with a healthy granulosa cell, including pyknosis (nuclear condensation) and cellular shrinkage.

CL:4033091.label: glycinergic-GABAergic amacrine cell
CL:4033091.description: An amacrine cell that uses both GABA and glycine as neurotransmitters.

CL:4033092.label: CD57-positive enterocyte
CL:4033092.description: An enterocyte that is part of a duodenal epithelium and expresses beta-1,3-glucuronyltransferase 1 (B3GAT1), also known as CD57 or HNK-1.

CL:4033093.label: limbal epithelial stem cell of cornea
CL:4033093.description: A stem cell that is part of the corneo-scleral limbus. This cell type resides at the basal layer of the epithelium and has a small size and high nuclear to cytoplasmatic ratio (Secker and Daniels, 2009). A limbal stem cell is responsible for corneal epithelial renewal and repair (Li et al., 2023), and to help maintain a clear corneal surface by preventing conjunctival epithelial cells from migrating onto the cornea (Wang et al., 2023).

CL:4033094.label: age-associated B cell
CL:4033094.description: A transcriptionally distinct memory B cell whose presence increases with age, during infections, and in autoimmune diseases. In humans and mice, this cell type can be identified by the expression of T-bet, CD11c, CD11b, and the lack of CD21. An age-associated B cell responds to TLR stimuli, may produce autoantibodies, and participates in antiviral responses and pathogen clearance.

CL:4033095.label: diffuse bipolar 4a cell
CL:4033095.description: An ON bipolar cell that has high expression of DIRC3, KCNJ3, LINC01915, PTPRK compared with other bipolar cells.

CL:4033096.label: diffuse bipolar 4b cell
CL:4033096.description: An ON bipolar cell that has high expression of NOS1AP compared with other bipolar cells.

CL:4033097.label: Schlemm's canal endothelial cell
CL:4033097.description: A specialised endothelial cell that is part of the canal of Schlemm. This cell type shares characteristics and expresses markers of both blood and lymphatic endothelial cells (Kizhatil et al., 2014) and regulates aqueous humor outflow resistance by modulating pore formation and responding to mechanical strain (Stamer et al., 2016).

CL:4033098.label: inner wall Schlemm's canal endothelial cell
CL:4033098.description: A Schlemm's canal endothelial cell that lines the inner wall of the Schlemm's canal. This cell exhibits a cobblestone appearance due to the significant biomechanical load it experiences, as well as the segmental flow of aqueous humor. The degree of biomechanical stress can lead to the formation of dome-like outpouchings known as giant vacuoles. In addition, the cell contains transcellular pores that mediate aqueous humor transport (Dautriche et al., 2015).
